Mishneh Torah, Foundations of the Torah: Yesod hayesodot veammud hachachmot leda sheyyesh sham matzuy rishon. vehu mamtzi kol nimtza. vechol hannimtzaim mishshamayim vaaretz uma shebbenehem lo nimtzeu ella meamittat himmatzo:
Veim yaale al haddaat shehu eno matzuy en davar acher yachol lehimmatzot:

Veim yaale al haddaat sheen kol hannimtzaim millevaddo metzuyim hu levaddo yihye matzuy. velo yibbatel hu levittulam. shekkol hannimtzaim tzerichin lo vehu baruch hu eno tzarich lahem velo leechad mehem. lefichach en amittato kaamittat echad mehem:

Hu shehannavi omer <small>(yirmeya 10 10)</small> "vaAdonai elohim emet". hu levaddo haemet veen leacher emet kaamittato. vehu shehattora omeret <small>(Devarim 4 la)</small> "en od millevaddo". kelomar en sham matzuy emet millevaddo kemoto:

Hammatzuy hazze hu elohe haolam adon kol haaretz. vehu hammanhig haggalgal bechoach sheen lo ketz vetachlit. bechoach sheen lo hefsek. shehaggalgal sovev tamid vei efshar sheyyissov belo mesabbev. vehu baruch hu hamesabbev oto belo yad uvelo guf:

Vidiat davar ze mitzvat ase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 2)</small> "anochi Adonai elohecha". vechol hammaale al dato sheyyesh sham eloah acher chutz mizze over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 3)</small> "lo yihye lecha elohim acherim al panay". vechofer baikkar shezzehu haikkar haggadol shehakkol taluy bo:

Eloah ze echad hu veeno shenayim velo yeter al shenayim. ella echad. sheen keyichudo echad min haachadim hannimtzaim baolam. lo echad kemin shehu kolel achadim harebe. velo echad keguf shehu nechlak lemachlakot veliktzavot. ella yichud sheen yichud acher kemoto baolam. illu hayu elohut harebe hayu gufin ugeviyyot. mippene sheen hannimnim hashshavin bimtziutan nifradin ze mizze ella bimorain sheyyeeru baggufot vehaggeviyyot. veillu haya hayyotzer guf ugeviyya haya lo ketz vetachlit shei efshar lihyot guf sheen lo ketz. vechol sheyyesh legufo ketz vetachlit yesh lechocho ketz vasof. velohenu baruch shemo hoil vechocho en lo ketz veeno posek shehare haggalgal sovev tamid. en kocho koach guf. vehoil veeno guf lo yeeru lo meorot haggufot kede sheyyehe nechlak venifrad meacher. lefichach i efshar sheyyihye ella echad. vidiat davar ze mitzvat ase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "Adonai elohenu Adonai echad":

Hare meforash battora uvanneviim sheen hakkadosh baruch hu guf ugeviyya shenneemar <small>(Yehoshua 2 11)</small> "ki Adonai elohechem hu elohim bashshamayim mimmaal veal haaretz mittachat". vehagguf lo yihye bishne mekomot. veneemar <small>(Devarim 4 15)</small> "ki lo reitem kol temuna". veneemar <small>(yeshaya 40 25)</small> "veel mi tedammeyuni veeshve". veillu haya guf haya dome lishar gufim:

Im ken mahu ze shekkatuv battora "vetachat raglav". <small>(Shemot lo 18)</small> "ketuvim beetzba elohim". "yad Adonai". "ene Adonai". "azne Adonai". vechayyotze bidvarim haellu. hakkol lefi datan shel bene adam hu sheenan makkirin ella (hannofot) [haggufot] vedibbera tora kilshon bene adam. vehakkol kinnuyim hen. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 32 41)</small> "im shannoti berak charbi". vechi cherev yesh lo uvecherev hu horeg ella mashal vehakkol mashal. reaya laddavar shennavi echad omer sheraa hakkadosh baruch hu <small>(Daniel 7 9)</small> "levusheyih kitlag chivver". veechad raahu <small>(yeshaya 63 1)</small> "chamutz begadim mibbatzra". moshe rabbenu atzmo raahu al hayyam kegibbor ose milchama. uvesinay kishliach tzibbur atuf. lomar sheen lo demut vetzura ella hakkol bemare hannevua uvemachaze. vaamittat haddavar en dato shel adam mevin velo yechola lehassigo ulechakro. veze sheamar hakkatuv <small>(Iyov 11 7)</small> "hacheker eloah timtza im ad tachlit shadday timtza":

Mahu ze shebbikkesh moshe rabbenu lehassig kesheamar <small>(Shemot 33 18)</small> "hareeni na et kevodecha". bikkesh leda amittat himmatzo shel hakkadosh baruch hu ad sheyyihye yadua belibbo kemo yediat echad min haanashim sheraa panav venechkeka tzurato belibbo shennimtza oto haish nifrad bedato mishshear haanashim. kach bikkesh moshe rabbenu lihyot metziut hakkadosh baruch hu nifredet belibbo mishshear hannimtzaim ad sheyyeda amittat himmatzo kaasher hi. veheshivo baruch hu sheen koach bedaat haadam hachay shehu mechubbar migguf venefesh lehassig amittat davar ze al buryo. vehodio baruch hu ma shello yada adam lefanav velo yeda leacharav. ad shehissig meamittat himmatzo davar shennifrad hakkadosh baruch hu bedato mishshear hannimtzaim. kemo sheyyippared echad min haanashim sheraa achorav vehissig kol gufo umalbusho bedato mishshear gufe haanashim. veal davar ze ramaz hakkatuv veamar <small>(Shemot 33 23)</small> "veraita et achoray ufanay lo yerau":

Vechevan shennitbarer sheeno guf ugeviyya yitbarer shello yeera lo echad mimmeorot haggufot. lo chibbur velo perud. lo makom velo midda. lo aliyya velo yerida. velo yamin velo semol. velo panim velo achor. velo yeshiva velo amida. veeno matzuy bizman ad sheyyihye lo reshit veacharit uminyan shanim. veeno mishtanne sheen lo davar sheyyigrom lo shinnuy. veen lo lo mavet velo chayyim kechayye hagguf hachay. velo sichlut velo chachma kechachmat haish hechacham. lo shena velo hakitza. velo kaas velo sechok velo simcha velo atzvut. velo shetika velo dibbur kedibbur bene adam. vechach amru chachamim en lemala lo yeshiva velo amida velo oref velo ippuy:

Vehoil vehaddavar ken hu. kol haddevarim hallalu vechayyotze bahen shenneemru battora uvedivre neviim hakkol mashal umelitza hen. kemo shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 2 4)</small> "yoshev bashshamayim yischak". <small>(Devarim 32 21)</small> "kiasuni behavelehem". <small>(Devarim 28 63)</small> "kaasher sas Adonai" vechayyotze bahen. al hakkol amru chachamim dibbera tora kilshon bene adam. vechen hu omer <small>(yirmeya 7 19)</small> "haoti hem machisim". hare hu omer <small>(Malachi 3 6)</small> "ani Adonai lo shaniti". veillu haya peamim koes ufeamim sameach haya mishtanne. vechol haddevarim haellu enan metzuyin ella laggufim haafelim hashshefalim shochne batte chomer asher beafar yesodam aval hu baruch hu yitbarach veyitromam al kol ze:
Hael hannichbad vehannora hazze mitzva leohovo uleyira oto shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "veahavta et Adonai elohecha". veneemar <small>(Devarim 6 13)</small> "et Adonai elohecha tira":

Veheach hi hadderech leahavato veyirato. beshaa sheyyitbonen haadam bemaasav uveruav hanniflaim haggedolim veyire mehen chachmato sheen lah erech velo ketz miyyad hu ohev umeshabbeach umefaer umitavve taava gedola leda hashshem haggadol. kemo sheamar david <small>(Tehillim 42 3)</small> "tzama nafshi lelohim leel chay". ucheshemmechashshev baddevarim haellu atzman miyyad hu nirta laachorav vifached veyodea shehu beriyya ketanna shefala afela omedet bedaat kalla meuta lifne temim deot. kemo sheamar david <small>(Tehillim 8 4)</small> "ki ere shamecha maase etzbeotecha" <small>(Tehillim 8 5)</small> "ma enosh ki tizkerennu". ulefi haddevarim haellu ani mevaer kelalim gedolim mimmaase ribbon haolamim kede sheyyihyu petach lammevin leehov et hashshem. kemo sheamru chachamim beinyan ahava shemmittoch kach atta makkir et mi sheamar vehaya haolam:

Kol ma shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu beolamo nechlak lishlosha chalakim. mehen beruim shehen mechubbarim miggolem vetzura vehem hoym venifsadim tamid kemo gufot haadam vehabbehema vehatztzemachim vehammattachot. umehen beruim shehen mechubbarim miggolem vetzura aval enan mishtannin migguf leguf umitztzura letzura kemo harishonim ella tzuratan kevua leolam begalmam veenan mishtannin kemo ellu. vehem haggalgallim vehakkochavim shebbahen. veen galmam kishar gelamim velo tzuratam kishar tzurot. umehen beruim tzura belo golem kelal vehem hammalachim. shehammalachim enam guf ugeviyya ella tzurot nifradot zo mizzo:

Umahu ze shehanneviim omrim sherau hammalach esh uvaal kenafayim. hakkol bemare hannevua vederech chida. lomar sheeno guf veeno kaved kaggufot hakkevedim. kemo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 24)</small> "ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu" veeno esh ella mashal. uchemo shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 104 4)</small> "ose malachav ruchot":

Uvamme yippardu hatztzurot zo mizzo vahare enan gufin. lefi sheenan shavin bimtziutan ella kol echad mehen lematta mimmaalato shel chavero. vehu matzuy mikkocho ze lemala mizze vehakkol nimtzaim mikkocho shel hakkadosh baruch hu vetuvo. vezehu sheramaz shelomo bechachmato veamar <small>(Kohelet 5 7)</small> "ki gavoah meal gavoah shomer":

Ze sheamarnu lematta mimmaalato shel chavero enah maalat makom. kemo adam sheyyoshev lemala mechavero. ella kemo sheomrin bishne chachamim sheechad gadol mechavero bechachma shehu lemala mimmaalato shel ze. uchemo sheomrin beilla shehi lemala min healul:

Shinnuy shemot hammalachim al shem maalatam hu. ulefichach nikraim chayyot hakkodesh vehem lemala min hakkol veofannim veerellim vechashmallim userafim umalachim velohim uvene elohim ucheruvim veishim. kol ellu asara hashshemot shennikreu bahen hammalachim al shem eser maalot shellahen hen, umaala sheen lemala mimmenna ella maalat hael baruch hu hi maalat hatztzura shennikret chayyot. lefichach neemar bannevua shehen tachat kisse hakkavod. umaala asirit hi maalat hatztzura shennikret ishim vehem hammalachim hamedabberim im hanneviim venirim lahem bemare hannevua. lefichach nikreu ishim shemmaalatam kerova lemaalat daat bene adam:

Vechol hatztzurot haellu chayyim umakkirin et habbore veyodim oto dea gedola ad limod. kol tzura vetzura lefi maalatah lo lefi gadlah. afillu maala harishona enah yechola lehassig amittat habbore kemo shehu ella datah ketzara lehassig veleda aval masseget veyodaat yoter mimma shemmasseget veyodaat tzura shellematta mimmenna. vechen kol maala umaala ad maala asirit gam hi yodaat habbore dea sheen koach bene haadam hamechubbarim miggolem vetzura yachol lehassig veleda kemotah. vehakkol enan yodin habbore kemo shehu yodea atzmo:

Kol hannimtzaim chutz min habbore mitztzura harishona ad yattush katan sheyyihye betabbur haaretz hakkol mikkoach amittato nimtzeu. ulefi shehu yodea atzmo umakkir gedullato vetifarto vaamittato hu yodea hakkol veen davar neelam mimmennu:

Hakkadosh baruch hu makkir amitto veyodea otah kemo shehi. veeno yodea bedea shehi chutz mimmennu kemo sheanu yodin. sheen anu vedatenu echad aval habbore yitbarach hu vedato vechayyav echad mikkol tzad umikkol pinna uvechol derech yichud. sheilmale haya chay bachayyim veyodea bedea chutz mimmennu hayu sham elohut harebe hu vechayyav vedato, veen haddavar ken ella echad mikkol tzad umikkol pinna uvechol derech yichud. nimtzeta atta omer hu hayyodea vehu hayyadua vehu haddea atzmah hakkol echad. vedavar ze en koach bappe leamro velo baozen leshamo velo belev haadam lehakkiro al buryo. ulefichach omer che faro veche nafshecha veen omer che Adonai ella chay Adonai. sheen habbore vechayyav shenayim kemo chayye haggufim hachayyim o kechayye hammalachim. lefichach eno makkir habberuim veyodam mechamat habberuim kemo sheanu yodin otam ella mechamat atzmo yedaem. lefichach mippene shehu yodea atzmo yodea hakkol shehakkol nismach lo bahavayato:
Devarim ellu sheamarnu beinyan ze bishne perakim ellu kemo tippa min hayyam hem mimma shetztzarich levaer beinyan ze. uveur kol haikkarim shebbishne perakim ellu hu hannikra maase merkava:

Tziuu chachamim harishonim shello lidrosh bidvarim ellu ella leish echad bilvad vehu sheyyihye chacham umevin middato veachar kach mosrin lo rashe happerakim umodiin oto shemetz min haddavar vehu mevin middato veyeda sof haddavar veamko. udevarim ellu devarim amukkim hem ad limod veen kol daat vedaat reuya lesavlan. vaalehem amar shelomo bechachmato derech mashal <small>(Mishlei 27 26)</small> "kevasim lilvushecha" kach amru chachamim beferush mashal ze devarim shehen kivshono shel olam yihyu lilvushecha kelomar lecha levaddecha veal tidrosh otam barabbim. vaalehem amar <small>(Mishlei 5 17)</small> "yihyu lecha levaddecha veen lezarim ittach". vaalehem amar <small>(Shir HaShirim 4 11)</small> "devash vechalav tachat leshonech", kach pershu chachamim harishonim devarim shehen kidvash vechalav yihyu tachat leshoncha:

Haggalgalim hem hannikraim shamayim verakia uzevul vaaravot. vehem tisha galgallim. galgal hakkarov mimmennu hu galgal hayyareach. vehashsheni shellemala mimmennu hu galgal shebbo hakkochav hannikra kochav. vegalgal shelishi shellemala mimmennu shebbo noga. vegalgal revii shebbo chamma. vegalgal chamishi shebbo maadim. vegalgal shishshi shebbo kochav tzedek. vegalgal shevii shebbo shabbetay. vegalgal shemini shebbo shear kol hakkochavim shennirim barakia. vegalgal teshii hu galgal hachozer bechol yom min hammizrach lammaarav vehu hammakkif umesabbev et hakkol. veze shettire kol hakkochavim keillu hem kullam begalgal echad veaf al pi sheyyesh bahen ze lemala mizze. mippene shehaggalgallim tehorim vezakkim kizchuchit uchesappir lefichach nirim hakkochavim shebbaggalgal hashshemini mittachat galgal harishon:
Kol galgal vegalgal mishshemona haggalgallim shebbahen hakkochavim nechlak legalgallim harebe ze lemala mizze kemo gilde betzalim. mehen galgallim sovvim mimmaarav lemizrach. umehen sovvim mimmizrach lemaarav kemo haggalgal hatteshii hachozer mimmizrach lemaarav. vechullan en benehem makom panuy:
Kol haggalgallim enan lo kallim velo kevedim veen lahem lo ayin adom velo ayin shachor velo shear enot. veze sheanu roin otam keen hattechelet lemarit haayin bilvad hu lefi gova haavir. vechen en lahem lo taam velo reach lefi sheen ellu hameorain metzuyin ella baggufot shellematta mehen:
Kol haggalgallim haellu hammakkifin et haolam hen agullin kechaddur vehaaretz teluya baemtza. veyesh lemiktzat min hakkochavim galgallim ketannim shehen kevuim bahen veen otam haggalgallim makkifin et haaretz ella galgal katan sheeno makkif kavua baggalgal haggadol hammakkif:
Mispar kol haggalgallim hammakkifin et kol haolam shemona asar. umispar haggalgallim hakketannim sheenan makkifin shemona. umimmahalach hakkochavim vidiat shiur sevivatan bechol yom uvechol shaa uminnetiyyatan meruach darom leruach tzafon umeruach tzafon leruach darom umiggavhan meal haaretz ukerivatan yivadda mispar kol ellu haggalgallim vetzurat halichatan vederech hakkafatan. vezo hi chachmat cheshbon tekufot umazzalot. usefarim rabbim chibberu bahen chachme yavan:
Galgal hatteshii shehu makkif et hakkol chillekuhu hachachamim hakkadmonim lishnem asar chalakim. kol chelek vechelek heelu lo shem al shem tzura zo shetterae bo min hakkochavim shellematta mimmennu shehem mechuvvanim tachtav. vehem hammazzalot sheshshemotam tale. shor. teomim. sartan. arye. betula. moznayim. akrav. keshet. gedi. deli. dagim:
Galgal hatteshii atzmo en bo lo chaluka velo tzura mikkol hatztzurot haellu velo kochav. ella bechibbur hakkochavim shebbaggalgal hashshemini hu sheyyerae bechochavim gedolim shebbo tavnit hatztzurot haellu o karov mehen. veellu hashshenem asar tzurot lo hayu mechuvvanot keneged otan hachalakim ella bizman hammabbul sheaz heelu lahen shemot ellu. aval bazzeman hazze kevar savvu meat. lefi shekkol hakkochavim shebbegalgal shemini kullam sovvim kemo hashshemesh vehayyareach ella shehen sovvin bichvedut. vechelek sheyyithallech hashshemesh vehayyareach kenegdo beyom echad yelech kenegdo kol kochav mehen bekeruv mishshivim shana:
Kol hakkochavim hannirim yesh mehen kochavim ketannim shehaaretz gedola meechad mehen. veyesh mehen kochavim gedolim shekkol echad mehen gadol min haaretz kamma peamim. vehaaretz gedola min hayyareach kemo arbaim peamim. vehashshemesh gedola min haaretz kemo mea veshivim peamim. nimtza hayyareach echad mishsheshet alafim ushemone meot min hashshemesh bekeruv. veen bechol hakkochavim kochav gadol min hashshemesh velo katan mikkochav shebbaggalgal hashsheni:
Kol hakkochavim vehaggalgallim kullan baale nefesh vedea vehasekel hem. vehem chayyim veomdim umakkirin et mi sheamar vehaya haolam. kol echad veechad lefi gadlo ulefi maalato meshabbechim umefaarim leyotzram kemo hammalachim. ucheshem shemmakkirin hakkadosh baruch hu kach makkirin et atzman umakkirin et hammalachim shellemala mehen. vedaat hakkochavim vehaggalgallim meuta middaat hammalachim ugedola middaat bene adam:
Bara hael lematta miggalgal hayyareach golem echad sheeno kegolem haggalgallim. uvara arba tzurot legolem ze veenan ketzurat haggalgallim venikba kol tzura vetzura bemiktzat golem ze. tzura rishona tzurat haesh nitchabbera bemiktzat golem ze venihya mishshenehen guf haesh. vetzura sheniyya tzurat haruach nitchabbera bemiktzato venihya mishshenehen guf haruach. vetzura shelishit tzurat hammayim nitchabbera bemiktzato venihya mishshenehem guf hammayim. vetzura reviit tzurat haaretz nitchabbera bemiktzato venihya mishshenehem guf haaretz. nimtza lematta min harakia arbaa gufin muchlakin ze lemala mizze vechol echad veechad makkif et shellematta mimmennu mikkol ruchotav kemo galgal. hagguf harishon hassamuch legalgal hayyareach hu guf haesh. lematta mimmennu guf haruach. lematta mimmennu guf hammayim. lematta mimmennu guf haaretz. veen benehem makom panuy belo guf kelal:
Arbaa gufot haellu enam baale nefesh veenam yodim velo makkirim ella kegufim metim. veyesh lechol echad veechad mehem minhag sheeno yodo velo massigo veeno yachol leshannoto. veze sheamar david <small>(Tehillim 148 7)</small> "halelu et Adonai min haaretz tanninim vechol tehomot" <small>(Tehillim 148 8)</small> "esh uvarad sheleg vekitor". uveur inyan haddevarim haleluhu bene adam miggevurotav shettiru baesh uvabbarad uvishar beruim shettiru lematta min harakia sheggevuratam tamid nikkeret lakkatan velaggadol:

Arbaa gufim hallalu shehem esh veruach umayim veeretz hem yesodot kol hannivraim lematta min harakia. vechol sheyyihye meadam umibbehema veof veremes vedag vetzemach umattechet vaavanim tovot umargaliyyot ushear avne binyan veharim vegushe afar hakkol galman mechubbar mearbaa yesodot hallalu. nimtzeu kol haggufim shellematta min harakia chutz mearbaa yesodot haellu mechubbarim miggolem vetzura. vegolem shellahem mechubbar mearbaa yesodot haellu. aval kol echad mearbaa hayesodot eno mechubbar ella miggolem vetzura bilvad:

Derech haesh veharuach lihyot mahalacham mimmatta mittabbur haaretz lemala kelappe harakia. vederech hammayim vehaaretz lihyot mahalacham mittachat harakia lematta ad laemtza. sheemtza harakia hu hammatta sheen lematta mimmennu. veen hillucham lo bedatam velo becheftzam ella minhag shennikba bahen veteva shennitba bahen. teva haesh cham veyavesh vehu kal mikkullam. veharuach cham velach. vehammayim karim velachim. vehaaretz yevesha vekara. vehi keveda mikkullam vehammayim kallim mimmenna lefichach nimtzaim lemala al haaretz. veharuach kal min hammayim lefichach hu merachef al pene hammayim. vehaesh kal min haruach. umippene shehem yesodot lechol gufim shettachat harakia yimmatze kol guf veguf meadam uvehema vechayya veof vedag vetzemach umattechet veeven galmo mechubbar meesh veruach umayim veafar. vearbatan yitarvu beyachad veyishtannu kol echad mehem beet haeruv ad sheyyimmatze hamechubbar mearbatan eno dome leechad mehen keshehu levaddo. veen bamorav mehen afillu chelek echad shehu esh bifne atzmo o mayim bifne atzman o eretz bifne atzmah o ruach bifne atzmah ella hakkol nishtannu venaasu guf echad. vechol guf veguf hamechubbar mearbatan yimmatze bo kor vechom lach veyavesh keechad. aval yesh mehem gufim sheyyihye bahem chazka misod haesh kemo baale nefesh chayya. lefichach yerae bahem hachom yater. veyesh mehen gufin sheyyihye bahen chazka misod haaretz kemo haavanim. lefichach yerae bahem hayyovesh harebe. veyesh mehen gufin sheyyihye bahen chazka misod hammayim. lefichach yerae bahem hallach yater. veal hadderech hazze yimmatze guf cham yeter migguf acher cham. veguf yavesh yeter migguf acher yavesh. vechen yimmatzu gufim sheyyerae bahen hakkor bilvad. vegufim yerae bahen hallach bilvad. vegufim yerae bahen hakkor vehayyovesh keechad beshave. o hakkor vehallach keechad beshave. o hachom vehayyovesh keechad beshave. o hachom vehallach keechad beshave. lefi rov hayesod shehaya beikkar hattaarovet yerae maase oto hayesod vetivo bagguf hameorav:

Vechol hamechubbar mearbaa yesodot ellu hu nifrad bassof. yesh shehu nifrad leachar yamim achadim. veyesh shehu nifrad leachar shanim rabbot. vechol shennitchabber mehem i efshar shello yippared lahen. afillu hazzahav vehaodem i efshar shello yippased veyachazor lisodotav. veyashuv miktzato laesh. umiktzato lammayim. umiktzato laruach. umiktzato laaretz:

Hoil vechol hannifsad yippared lisodot ellu lamma neemar laadam <small>(Bereshit 3 19)</small> "veel afar tashuv". lefi sherov binyano min heafar. velo kol hannifsad kesheyyippased miyyad yachazor learbaa hayesodot. ella yippased veyachazor ledavar acher vedavar acher ledavar acher vesof haddevarim yachazor laysodot venimtzeu kol haddevarim chozrin chalila:

Arbaa yesodot haellu mishtannim ze laze tamid bechol yom uvechol shaa miktzatan lo kol gufan. ketzad. miktzat haaretz hakkerova min hammayim mishtannet umitporeret venaaset mayim. vechen miktzat hammayim hassemuchim laruach mishtannin umitmasmesin vehovin ruach. vechen haruach miktzato hassamuch laesh mishtanne umitcholel venaase esh. vechen haesh miktzatah hassamuch laruach mitcholel mishtanne umitkannes venaase ruach. vechen haruach miktzato hassamuch lammayim mishtanne umitkannes venaase mayim. vechen hammayim miktzato hassamuch laaretz mishtanne umitkannes venaase eretz. veshinnuy ze meat meat ulefi orech hayyamim. veen kol hayesod mishtanne ad sheyyease kol hammayim ruach o kol haruach esh. shei efshar sheyyibbatel echad min hayesodot haarbaa. ella miktzat yishtanne meesh leruach umiktzat yishtanne meruach leesh. vechen ben kol echad vachavero yimmatze hashshinnuy ben arbatan vechozrot chalila leolam:

Veshinnuy ze yihye bisvivat haggalgal umissevivato yitchabberu arbatan veyihye mehen shear galme bene adam venefesh chayya tzemach veeven umattechet. vehael noten lechol golem vegolem tzura reuya lo al yede malach haasiri shehi hatztzura hannikret ishim:

Leolam en atta roe golem belo tzura o tzura belo golem. ella lev haadam hu shemmechallek guf hannimtza bedato veyodea shehu mechubbar miggolem vetzura. veyodea sheyyesh sham gufim sheggalmam mechubbar mearbaat hayesodot. vegufim sheggalmam pashut veeno mechubbar miggolem acher. vehatztzurot sheen lahem golem enan nirin laayin ella been hallev hen yeduin. kemo sheyyadanu adon hakkol belo reiyyat ayin:

Nefesh kol basar hi tzurato shennatan lo hael vehaddaat hayetera hammetzuya benafsho shel adam hi tzurat haadam hashshalem bedato. veal tzura zo neemar battora naase adam betzalmenu kidmutenu kelomar shettihye lo tzura hayyodaat umasseget haddeot sheen lahem golem kemo hammalachim shehem tzura belo golem ad sheyyidme lahen. veeno omer al tzura zo hannikkeret laenayim shehi happe vehachotem vehallesatot ushear roshem hagguf shezzo toar shemah. veenah hannefesh hammetzuya lechol nefesh chayya shebbah ochel veshote umolid umargish umeharher. ella haddea shehi tzurat hannefesh uvetzurat hannefesh hakkatuv medabber betzalmenu kidmutenu. ufeamim rabbot tikkare zot hatztzura nefesh veruach. ulefichach tzarich lehizzaher bishmotan shello yite adam bahen. vechol shem veshem yillamed meinyano:

En tzurat hannefesh hazzot mechubberet min hayesodot kede shettippared lahem, veenah mikkoach hanneshama ad shettehe tzericha lanneshama kemo shehanneshama tzericha lagguf. ella meet Adonai min hashshamayim hi. lefichach kesheyyippared haggolem shehu mechubbar min hayesodot vetovad hanneshama mippene sheenah metzuya ella im hagguf utzericha lagguf bechol maaseha lo tikkaret hatztzura hazzot. lefi sheenah tzericha lanneshama bemaaseha. ella yodaat umasseget haddeot happerudot min haggelamim veyodaat bore hakkol veomedet leolam uleolme olamim. hu sheamar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Kohelet 12 7)</small> "veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah":

Kol haddevarim haellu sheddibbarnu beinyan ze kemar middeli hem udevarim amukkim hem. aval enam keinyan omek perek rishon vesheni. uveur kol ellu haddevarim shebbeferek shelishi urevii hu hannikra maase bereshit. vechach tziuu hachachamim harishonim sheen dorshin baddevarim haellu barabbim ella leadam echad modiin devarim ellu umelammedin otan:

Uma ben inyan maase merkava leinyan maase bereshit. sheinyan maase merkava afillu leechad en dorshim bo ella im ken haya chacham umevin middato mosrin lo rashe happerakim. veinyan maase bereshit melammedin oto leyachid af al pi sheeno mevin oto middato umodiim oto kol ma sheyyachol leda middevarim ellu. velamma en melammedin oto larabbim. lefi sheen kol adam yesh lo daat rechava lehassig perush uveur kol haddevarim al buryan:

Bizman sheadam mitbonen baddevarim haellu umakkir kol habberuim mimmalach vegalgal veadam kayyotze bo veyire chachmato shel hakkadosh baruch hu bechol hayetzurim vechol habberuim. mosif ahava lammakom vetitzma nafsho veyichma besaro leehov hammakom baruch hu. veyira veyifchad mishshifluto vedalluto vekalluto kesheyyaarich atzmo leechad mehaggufot hakkedoshim haggedolim. vechol shekken leachat mehatztzurot hattehorot hannifradot min haggelamim shello nitchabberu baggolem kelal. veyimtza atzmo shehu kichli male busha uchelimma rek vechaser:

Veinyene arbaa perakim ellu shebbechamesh mitzvot haellu hem shechachamim harishonim korin oto pardes kemo sheamru arbaa nichnesu lappardes. veaf al pi sheggedole yisrael hayu vachachamim gedolim hayu lo kullam haya bahen koach leda ulehassig kol haddevarim al buryan. vaani omer sheen rauy letayyel bappardes ella mi shennitmalle kereso lechem uvasar. velechem uvasar hu leda haasur vehammuttar vechayyotze bahem mishshear hammitzvot. veaf al pi sheddevarim ellu davar katan karu otan chachamim shehare amru chachamim davar gadol maase merkava vedavar katan havayot deabbayye verava. af al pi chen reuyin hen lehakediman. shehen meyashshevin dato shel adam techilla. veod shehem hattova haggedola shehishpia hakkadosh baruch hu leyishshuv haolam hazze kede linchol chayye haolam habba. veefshar sheyyedaem hakkol katan vegadol ish veishsha baal lev rachav uvaal lev katzar:

Kol bet yisrael metzuvvin al kiddush hashshem haggadol hazze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 32)</small> "venikdashti betoch bene yisrael". umuzharin shello lechallelo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 32)</small> "velo techallelu et shem kadshi". ketzad. kesheyyaamod oved kochavim veyeenos et yisrael laavor al achat mikkol mitzvot haamurot battora o yahargennu yaavor veal yehareg shenneemar bammitzvot <small>(Vayikra 18 5)</small> "asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem". vachay bahem velo sheyyamut bahem. veim met velo avar hare ze mitchayyev benafsho:

Bamme devarim amurim bishar mitzvot chutz meavodat kochavim vegilluy arayot ushefichat damim. aval shalosh averot ellu im yomar lo avor al achat mehen o tehareg. yehareg veal yaavor. bamme devarim amurim bizman shehaoved kochavim mitkavven lahanaat atzmo. kegon sheanaso livnot lo beto beshabbat o levashshel lo tavshilo. o anas ishsha levoolah vechayyotze baze. aval im nitkavven lehaaviro al hammitzvot bilvad. im haya beno leven atzmo veen sham asara miyyisrael yaavor veal yehareg. veim anaso lehaaviro baasara miyyisrael yehareg veal yaavor. vaafillu lo nitkavven lehaaviro ella al mitzva mishshear mitzvot bilvad:

Vechol haddevarim haellu shello bishat haggezera aval bishat haggezera vehu sheyyaamod melech rasha kinvuchadnetztzar vachaverav veyigzor gezera al yisrael levattel datam o mitzva min hammitzvot. yehareg veal yaavor afillu al achat mishshear mitzvot ben neenas betoch asara ben neenas beno leven ovde kochavim:

Kol mi shenneemar bo yaavor veal yehareg veneherag velo avar hare ze mitchayyev benafsho. vechol mi shenneemar bo yehareg veal yaavor veneherag velo avar hare ze kiddesh et hashshem. veim haya baasara miyyisrael hare ze kiddesh et hashshem barabbim kedaniyyel chananya mishael vaazarya verabbi akiva vachaverav. veellu hen haruge malchut sheen maala al maalatan. vaalehen neemar <small>(Tehillim 44 23)</small> "ki alecha horagnu chol hayyom nechshavnu ketzon tivcha". vaalehem neemar <small>(Tehillim 50 5)</small> "isfu li chasiday korte veriti ale zavach". vechol mi shenneemar bo yehareg veal yaavor veavar velo neherag hare ze mechallel et hashshem. veim haya baasara miyyisrael hare ze chillel et hashshem barabbim uvittel mitzvat ase shehi kiddush hashshem veavar al mitzvat lo taase shehi chillul hashshem. veaf al pi chen mippene sheavar beones en malkin oto veen tzarich lomar sheen memitin oto bet din afillu harag beones. sheen malkin umemitin ella leover birtzono uveedim vehateraa shenneemar benoten mizzaro lammolech <small>(Vayikra 20 5)</small> "(venatatti) [vesamti] ani et panay baish hahu". mippi hashshemua lamdu hahu lo anus velo shogeg velo mute. uma im avodat kochavim shehi chamura min hakkol haoved otah beones eno chayyav karet veen tzarich lomar mitat bet din. kal vachomer lishar mitzvot haamurot battora. uvaarayot hu omer <small>(Devarim 22 26)</small> "velannaara lo taase davar". aval im yachol lemallet nafsho velivroach mittachat yad hammelech harasha veeno ose hinne hu kechelev shav al keo. vehu nikra oved avodat kochavim bemezid vehu nitrad min haolam habba veyored lammadrega hattachtona shel gehinnom:

Nashim sheamru lahem ovde kochavim tenu lanu achat mikken unetamme otah veim lav netamme et kullechen yittamu kullan veal yimseru lahem nefesh achat miyyisrael. vechen im amru lahem ovde kochavim tenu lanu echad mikkem venahargennu veim lav naharog kullechem. yehargu kullam veal yimseru lahem nefesh achat miyyisrael. veim yichaduhu lahem veamru tenu lanu peloni o naharog et kullechem. im haya mechuyyav mita kesheva ben bichri yittenu oto lahem. veen morin lahem ken lechattechilla. veim eno chayyav mita yehargu kullan veal yimseru lahem nefesh achat miyyisrael:

Kainyan sheamru boonasin kach amru bocholaim. ketzad. mi shechala venata lamut veamru harofim sherfuato bedavar peloni meissurin shebbattora osin. umitrappein bechol issurin shebbattora bimkom sakkana chutz meavodat kochavim vegilluy arayot ushefichat damim sheafillu bimkom sakkana en mitrappein bahen. veim avar venitrappe onshin oto bet din onesh harauy lo:

Uminnayin sheafillu bimkom sakkanat nefashot en ovrin al achat mishshalosh averot ellu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha uvechol meodecha" afillu hu notel et nafshecha. vaharigat nefesh miyyisrael lerappeot nefesh acheret o lehatztzil adam miyyad annas davar shehaddaat nota lo hu sheen meabbedin nefesh mippene nefesh. vaarayot hukkeshu linfashot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 26)</small> "ki kaasher yakum ish al reehu uretzacho nefesh ken haddavar hazze":

Bamme devarim amurim sheen mitrappein bishar issurim ella bimkom sakkana. bizman shehen derech hanaatan kegon shemmaachilin et hachole shekatzim uremasim o chametz befesach o shemmaachilin oto beyom hakkippurim. aval shello derech hanaatan kegon sheosin lo retiyya o melugema mechametz o mearla. o shemmashkin oto devarim sheyyesh bahen mar meorav im issure maachol shehare en bahen hanaa lachech hare ze muttar vaafillu shello bimkom sakkana. chutz mikkile hakkerem uvasar bechalav shehen asurim afillu shello derech hanaatan. lefichach en mitrappein mehen afillu shello derech hanaatan ella bimikom sakkana:

Mi shennatan enav beishsha vechala venata lamut veamru harofim en lo refua ad shettibbael lo. yamut veal tibbael lo afillu hayta penuya. vaafillu ledabber immah meachore haggader en morin lo bechach veyamut velo yoru ledabber immah meachore haggader shello yehu benot yisrael hefker veyavou bidvarim ellu lifrotz baarayot:

Kol haover middato belo ones al achat mikkol mitzvot haamurot battora bishat benefesh lehacheis hare ze mechallel et hashshem. ulefichach neemar bishvuat sheker <small>(Vayikra 19 12)</small> "vechillalta et shem elohecha ani Adonai". veim avar baasara miyyisrael hare ze chillel et hashshem barabbim. vechen kol happoresh meavera o asa mitzva lo mippene davar baolam lo pachad velo yira velo levakkesh kavod ella mippene habbore baruch hu kimniat yosef hatztzaddik atzmo meeshet rabbo hare ze mekaddesh et hashshem:

Veyesh devarim acherim shehen bichlal chillul hashshem. vehu sheyyaase otam adam gadol battora umefursam bachasidut devarim shehabberiyyot merannenim acharav bishvilam. veaf al pi sheenan averot hare ze chillel et hashshem kegon shellakach veeno noten deme hammikkach lealtar. vehu sheyyesh lo venimtzeu hammochrim tovin vehu makkifan. o sheyyarbe bischok o baachila ushetiyya etzel amme haaretz uvenehen. o sheddibburo im habberiyyot eno benachat veeno mekabbelan besever panim yafot ella baal ketata vechaas. vechayyotze baddevarim haellu hakkol lefi gadlo shel chacham tzarich sheyyedakdek al atzmo veyaase lifnim mishshurat haddin. vechen im dikdek hechacham al atzmo vehaya dibburo benachat im habberiyyot vedato meorevet immahem umekabbelam besever panim yafot veneelav mehem veeno olvam. mechabbed lahen vaafillu lamkillin lo. venose venoten beemuna. velo yarbe baarichut amme haaretz vishivatan. velo yerae tamid ella osek battora atuf betzitzit muchtar bitfillin veose bechol maasav lifnim mishshurat haddin. vehu shello yitrachek harebe velo yishtomem. ad sheyyimmatzu hakkol mekallesin oto veohavim oto umitavvim lemaasav. hare ze kiddesh et Adonai vealav hakkatuv omer <small>(yeshaya mat 3)</small> "vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar":

Kol hameabbed shem min hashshemot hakkedoshim hattehorim shennikra bahem hakkadosh baruch hu loke min hattora. shehare hu omer baavodat kochavim <small>(gemara shabbat 120 2)</small> "veibbadtem et shemam min hammakom hahu lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem":
Veshiva shemot hem. hashshem hannichtav yod hei vav hei vehu hashshem hameforash. o hannichtav adonay. veel. eloah. velohim. velohe. veshadday. utzevaot. kol hammochek afillu ot achat mishshiva ellu loke:
Kol hannitpal lashshem millefanav muttar lemochoko kegon lamed millaAdonai uvet mibbelohim vechayyotze bahen enan kikdushshat hashshem. vechol hannitpal lashshem meacharav kegon ch shel elohecha vechem shel elohechem vechayyotze bahen enam nimchakim vahare hem kishar otiyyot shel shem mippene shehashshem mekaddesham. veaf al pi shennitkaddeshu veasur lemochokam hammochek ellu haotiyyot hannitpalot eno loke. aval makkin oto makkat mardut:
Katav alef lamed melohim, yod hei meAdonai, eno nimchak. veen tzarich lomar yah shehu shem bifne atzmo. mippene shezze hashshem miktzat shem hameforash hu. aval hakkotev shin dalet mishshadday, tzaddi bet mitztzevaot, hare ze nimchak:
Shear hakkinnuyin shemmeshabbechin bahen et hakkadosh baruch hu kegon channun verachum haggadol haggibbor vehannora hanneeman kanno vechazak vechayyotze bahen hare hen kishar kitve hakkodesh umuttar lemochokan:
Keli shehaya shem katuv alav kotzetz et mekom hashshem vegonzo. vaafillu haya hashshem chakuk bichle mattachot o bichle zechuchit vehittich hakkeli hare ze loke ella chotech et mekomo vegonzo. vechen im haya shem katuv al besaro hare ze lo yirchatz velo yasuch velo yaamod bimkom hattinnofet. nizdammena lo tevila shel mitzva korech alav gemi vetovel. veim lo matza gemi mesabbev bivgadav velo yehaddek kede shello yachotz. shello amru lichroch alav ella mippene sheasur laamod bifne hashshem keshehu arom:
Hassoter afillu even achat derech hashechata min hammizbeach o min hahechol o mishshear haazara loke shenneemar baavodat kochavim <small>(Shemot 34 13)</small> "ki et mizbechotam tittotzun" vechatuv <small>(Devarim 12 4)</small> "lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem". vechen hassoref atze hakkodesh derech hashechata loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 3)</small> "vaasherehem tisrefun baesh" uchetiv lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem: 
Kitve hakkodesh kullan uferushehen uveurehen asur lesarfam o leabbedam bayyad vehameabbedan bayyad makkin oto makkat mardut. bamme devarim amurim bechitve hakkodesh shekketavam yisrael bikdushsha aval eppikoros yisrael shekkatav sefer tora sorfin oto im haazkarot shebbo. mippene sheeno maamin bikdushshat hashshem velo ketavo lishmo ella shehu maale bedato shezze kishar haddevarim vehoil vedato ken lo nitkaddesh hashshem. umitzva lesarfo kede shello lehanniach shem laeppikorosim velo lemaasehem. aval oved kochavim shekkatav et hashshem gonzin oto. vechen kitve hakkodesh shebbalu o shekketavan oved kochavim yigganzu:
Kol hashshemot haamurim beavraham kodesh af ze shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 18 3)</small> "adonay im na matzati chen" hare hu kodesh. kol hashshemot haamurim belot chol chutz mizze <small>(gemara shavuot la 2)</small> "al na adonay hinne na matza avdecha chen". kol hashshemot haamurim begivat binyamin kodesh. kol hashshemot haamurim bemicha chol. kol hashshemot haamurim benavot kodesh. kol shelomo haamur beshir hashshirim kodesh vahare hu kishar hakkinnuyin chutz mizze <small>(Shir HaShirim 8 12)</small> "haelef lecha shelomo". kol malchayya haamur bedaniyyel chol chutz mizze <small>(Daniel 2 37)</small> "ant malka melech malchayya" vahare hu kishar hakkinnuyin:

Misode haddat leda shehael menabbe et bene haadam. veen hannevua chala ella al chacham gadol bachachma, gibbor bemiddotav, velo yehe yitzro mitgabber alav bedavar baolam ella hu mitgabber bedato al yitzro tamid. vehu baal dea rechava nechona ad meod. adam shehu memulla bechol hammiddot haellu shalem begufo, kesheyyikkanes lappardes veyimmashech beotan hainyanim haggedolim harchokim, vetihye lo dea nechona lehavin ulehassig vehu mitkaddesh veholech uforesh middarche kelal haam haholchim bemachashakke hazzeman, veholech umezarez atzmo umelammed nafsho shello tihye lo machashava kelal beechad middevarim betelim velo mehavele hazzeman vetachbulotav, ella dato penuya tamid lemala keshura tachat hakkisse lehavin beotan hatztzurot hakkedoshot hattehorot, umistakkel bechachmato shel hakkadosh baruch hu kullah mitztzura rishona ad tabbur haaretz veyodea mehen gadlo, miyyad ruach hakkodesh shora alav. uveet shettanuach alav haruach titarev nafsho bemaalat hammalachim hannikraim ishim veyehafech leish acher veyavin bedato sheeno kemot shehaya ella shennitalla al maalat shear bene adam hachachamim, kemo shenneemar beshaul <small>(Shmuel 1 10 6)</small> "vehitnabbita immam venehpachta leish acher":

Hanneviim maalot maalot hen. kemo sheyyesh bachachma chacham gadol mechavero kach bannevua navi gadol minnavi. vechullan en roin mare hannevua ella bachalom bechezyon layla. o bayyom achar shettippol alehen tardema kemo shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 12 6)</small> "bammara elav etvadda bachalom adabber bo". vechullan keshemmitnabbeim evrehen mizdazein vechoach hagguf kashel veeshtonotehem mittarfot vetishshaer haddaat penuya lehavin ma shettire. kemo shenneemar beavraham <small>(Bereshit 15 12)</small> "vehinne ema chashecha gedola nofelet alav". uchemo shenneemar bedaniyyel <small>(Daniel 10 8)</small> "vehodi nehpach alay lemashchit velo atzarti koach":

Haddevarim shemmodiim lannavi bemare hannevua derech mashal modiin lo umiyyad yechakek belibbo pitron hammashal bemare hannevua veyeda ma hu. kemo hassullam sheraa yaakov avinu umalachim olim veyordim bo vehu haya mashal lemalchuyyot veshibudan. uchemo hachayyot sheraa yechezkel vehassir nafuach umakkel shaked sheraa yirmeya vehammegilla sheraa yechezkel vehaefa sheraa zecharya. vechen shear hanneviim. mehem omrim hammashal ufitrono kemo ellu. veyesh shehen omrim happitron bilvad. ufeamim omrim hammashal bilvad belo pitron kemiktzat divre yechezkel uzecharya vechullan bemashal vederech chida hem mitnabbeim:

Kol hanneviim en mitnabbein bechol et sheyyirtzu ella mechavvenim datam veyoshvim semechim vetove lev umitboddim. sheen hannevua shora lo mittoch atzvut velo mittoch atzlut ella mittoch simcha. lefichach bene hanneviim lifnehem nevel vetof vechalil vechinnor vehem mevakkeshim hannevua. vezehu shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 10 5)</small> "vehemma mitnabbeim" kelomar mehallechin bederech hannevua ad sheyyinnavu kemo sheatta omer peloni mitgaddel:
Ellu shehem mevakkeshin lehitnabbe hem hannikraim bene hanneviim. veaf al pi shemmechavvenim datam efshar shettishre shechina alehen veefshar shello tishre:

Kol haddevarim sheamarnu hem derech nevua lechol hanneviim harishonim vehaacharonim chutz mimmoshe rabbenu rabban shel kol hanneviim. uma hefresh yesh ben nevuat moshe lishar kol hanneviim. shekkol hanneviim bachalom o bemare umoshe rabbenu mitnabbe vehu er veomed shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 7 89)</small> "uvevo moshe el ohel moed ledabber itto vayyishma et hakkol middabber elav". kol hanneviim al yede malach. lefichach roim ma shehem roim bemashal vechida. moshe rabbenu lo al yede malach shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 12 8)</small> "pe el pe adabber bo". veneemar <small>(Shemot 33 11)</small> "vedibber Adonai el moshe panim el panim". veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 12 8)</small> "utemunat Adonai yabbit" kelomar sheen sham mashal ella roe haddavar al buryo belo chida uvelo mashal. hu shehattora meida alav <small>(Bamidbar 12 8)</small> "bemare velo bechidot" sheeno mitnabbe bechida ella bemare sheroe haddavar al buryo. kol hanneviim yereim venivhalim umitmoggin umoshe rabbenu eno chen hu, shehakkatuv omer <small>(Shemot 33 11)</small> "kaasher yedabber ish el reehu", kelomar kemo sheen adam nivhal lishmoa divre chavero kach haya koach bedato shel moshe rabbenu lehavin divre hannevua vehu omed al amdo shalem. kol hanneviim en mitnabbeim bechol et sheyyirtzu. moshe rabbenu eno chen ella kol zeman sheyyachpotz ruach hakkodesh lovashto unevua shora alav veeno tzarich lechavven dato ulehizdammen lah shehare hu mechuvvan umezumman veomed kemalache hashsharet. lefichach mitnabbe bechol et shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 9 8)</small> "imdu veeshmea ma yetzavve Adonai lachem". uvaze hivticho hael shenneemar <small>(gemara yevamot sav 1)</small> "lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem veatta po amod immadi". ha lamadta shekkol hanneviim keshehannevua mistalleket mehem chozrim leoholam shehu tzarche hagguf kullam kishar haam. lefichach en porshin minneshotehem. umoshe rabbenu lo chazar leoholo harishon lefichach perash min haishsha leolam umin haddome lo venikshera dato letzur haolamim velo nistallek mealav hahod leolam vekaran or panav venitkaddesh kemalachim:

Hannavi efshar shettihye nevuato leatzmo bilvad leharechiv libbo ulehosif dato ad sheyyeda ma shello haya yodea meotan haddevarim haggedolim. veefshar sheyyeshullach leam meamme haaretz o leanshe ir o mamlacha lechonen otam ulehodiam ma yaasu o lemanam mimmaasim haraim shebbidehem. ucheshemmeshallechim oto notnin lo ot umofet kede sheyyedu haam shehael shelacho beemet. velo kol haose ot umofet maaminim lo shehu navi. ella adam shehayinu yodim bo mittechillato shehu rauy linvua bechachmato uvemaasav shennitalla bahen al kol bene gilo vehaya mehallech bedarche hannevua bikdushshatah uvifrishutah veachar kach ba veasa ot umofet veamar shehael shelacho mitzva lishmoa mimmennu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 15)</small> "elav tishmaun". veefshar sheyyaase ot umofet veeno navi. veze haot yesh lo devarim bego. veaf al pi chen mitzva lishmoa lo hoil veadam gadol vechacham verauy linvua [hu] maamidim oto al chezkato. shebbechach nitztavvenu kemo shennitztavvenu lachtoch et haddin al pi shene edim kesherim veaf al pi sheefshar sheheidu besheker hoil uchesherim hem etzlenu maamidin otan al kashrutan. uvaddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahen neemar <small>(Devarim 29 28)</small> "hannistarot laAdonai elohenu vehanniglot lanu ulevanenu". veneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 16 7)</small> "ki haadam yire laenayim vaAdonai yire lallevav":

Moshe rabbenu lo heeminu bo yisrael mippene haotot sheasa. shehammaamin al pi haotot yesh belibbo dofi sheefshar sheyyaase haot belat vechishshuf. ella kol haotot sheasa moshe bammidbar lefi hatztzorech asaam. lo lehavi reaya al hannevua. haya tzarich lehashekia et hammitzriyyim kara et hayyam vehitzlilan betocho. tzarachnu lemazon horid lanu et hamman. tzamu baka lahen et haeven. kafru bo adat korach bala otan haaretz. vechen shear kol haotot. uvamme heeminu bo. bemaamad har sinay sheenenu rau velo zar veaznenu shamu velo acher haesh vehakkolot vehallappidim vehu niggash el haarafel vehakkol middabber elav veanu shomim moshe moshe lech emor lahen kach vechach. vechen hu omer <small>(Devarim 5 4)</small> "panim befanim dibber Adonai immachem". veneemar <small>(Devarim 5 3)</small> "lo et avotenu karat Adonai et habberit hazzot". uminnayin shemmaamad har sinay levaddo hi haraya linvuato shehi emet sheen bo dofi shenneemar <small>(Shemot 19 9)</small> "hinne anochi ba elecha beav heanan baavur yishma haam bedabberi immach vegam becha yaaminu leolam". michlal shekkodem davar ze lo heeminu bo neemanut shehi omedet leolam ella neemanut sheyyesh achareha hirhur umachashava:

Nimtzeu ellu sheshullach lahen hem haedim al nevuato shehi emet veeno tzarich laasot lahen ot acher. shehem vehu edim baddavar kishne edim sherau davar echad beyachad shekkol echad mehen ed lachavero shehu omer emet veen echad mehen tzarich lehavi reaya lachavero. kach moshe rabbenu kol yisrael edim lo achar maamad har sinay veeno tzarich laasot lahem ot. vezehu sheamar lo lehakkadosh baruch hu bitchillat nevuato beet shennatan lo haotot laasotan bemitzrayim veamar lo <small>(Shemot 3 18)</small> "veshamu leklecha". yada moshe rabbenu shehammaamin al pi haotot yesh bilvavo dofi umeharher umechashshev vehaya nishmat millelech veamar <small>(Shemot 4 1)</small> "vehen lo yaaminu li". ad shehodio hakkadosh baruch hu sheellu haotot enan ella ad sheyyetzu mimmitzrayim veachar sheyyetzu veyaamdu al hahar hazze yistallek hirhur shemmeharharin acharecha sheani noten lecha kan ot sheyyedu sheani shelachticha beemet mittechilla velo yishshaer belibbam hirhur. vehu shehakkatuv omer <small>(Shemot 3 12)</small> "veze lecha haot ki anochi shelachticha behotziacha et haam mimmitzrayim taavdun et haelohim al hahar hazze". nimtzeta omer shekkol navi sheyyaamod achar moshe rabbenu en anu maaminim bo mippene haot levaddo kede shennomar im yaase ot nishma lo lechol ma sheyyomar. ella mippene hammitzva shetztzivva moshe battora veamar im natan ot <small>(Devarim 18 15)</small> "elav tishmaun". kemo shetztzivvanu lachtoch haddavar al pi shenayim edim veaf al pi sheen anu yodin im heidu emet im sheker. kach mitzva lishmoa mizze hannavi af al pi sheen anu yodim im haot emet o bechishshuf velat:

Lefichach im amad hannavi veasa otot umoftim gedolim uvikkesh lehachechish nevuato shel moshe rabbenu en shomin lo veanu yodin beveur sheotan haotot belat vechishshuf hen. lefi shennevuat moshe rabbenu enah al pi haotot kede shennaaroch otot ze leotot ze. ella beenenu reinuha uveaznenu shemaanuha kemo sheshshama hu. ha lema haddavar dome leedim sheheidu laadam al davar sheraa beenav sheeno kemo sheraa sheeno shomea lahen ella yodea bevadday shehen ede sheker. lefichach amra tora sheim ba haot vehammofet <small>(Devarim 13 4)</small> "lo tishma el divre hannavi hahu". shehare ze ba elecha beot umofet lehachechish ma sheraita beenecha vehoil veen anu maaminim bemofet ella mippene hammitzvot shetztzivvanu moshe heach nekabbel meot ze shebba lehachechish nevuato shel moshe sherainu vesheshshamanu:

Davar barur umeforash battora shehi mitzva omedet leolam uleolme olamim en lah lo shinnuy velo geraon velo tosefet shenneemar (Devarim 13 1) "et kol haddavar asher anochi metzavve etchem oto tishmerun laasot lo tosef alav velo tigra mimmennu". veneemar <small>(Devarim 29 28)</small> "vehanniglot lanu ulevanenu ad olam laasot et kol divre hattora hazzot". ha lamadta shekkol divre tora metzuvvin anu laasotan ad olam. vechen hu omer chukkat olam ledorotechem. veneemar <small>(Devarim 30 12)</small> "lo vashshamayim hi". ha lamadta sheen navi rashshay lechaddesh davar meatta. lefichach im yaamod ish ben min haummot ben miyyisrael veyaase ot umofet veyomar she shelacho lehosif mitzva o ligroa mitzva o lefaresh bemitzva min hammitzvot perush shello shamanu mimmoshe. o sheamar sheotan hammitzvot shennitztauu bahen yisrael enan leolam uledore dorot ella mitzvot lefi zeman hayu. hare ze nevi sheker shehare ba lehachechish nevuato shel moshe. umitato bechenek al shehezid ledabber beshem Adonai asher lo tzivvahu. shehu baruch shemo tzivva lemoshe shehammitzva hazzot lanu ulevanenu ad olam <small>(Bamidbar 23 19)</small> velo ish el vichazzev":

Im ken lamma neemar battora <small>(Devarim 18 18)</small> "navi akim lahem mikkerev achehem kamocha". lo laasot dat hu ba ella letzauot al divre hattora ulehazhir haam shello yaavru aleha. kemo sheamar haacharon shebbahen <small>(Malachi 3 22)</small> "zichru torat moshe avdi". vechen im tzivvanu bedivre harshut kegon lechu lemakom peloni o al telchu. asu milchama hayyom o al taasu. benu choma zo o al tivnuha. mitzva lishmoa lo. vehaover al devarav chayyav mita bide shamayim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 19)</small> "vehaya haish asher lo yishma el devaray asher yedabber bishmi anochi edrosh meimmo":

Vechen navi sheavar al divre atzmo vehakkovesh nevuato chayyav mita bide shamayim uvishlashtan neemar <small>(Devarim 18 19)</small> "anochi edrosh meimmo". vechen im yomar lanu hannavi shennoda lanu shehu navi laavor al achat mikkol mitzvot haamurot battora o al mitzvot harebe ben kallot ben chamurot lefi shaa mitzva lishmoa lo. vechen lamadnu mechachamim rishonim mippi hashshemua bechol im yomar lecha hannavi avor al divre tora keeliyyahu behar hakkarmel shema lo chutz meavodat kochavim. vehu sheyyihye haddavar lefi shaa. kegon eliyyahu behar hakkarmel shehikriv ola bachutz virushalayim nivcheret lechach vehammakriv bachutz chayyav karet. umippene shehu navi mitzva lishmoa lo vegam baze neemar <small>(Devarim 18 15)</small> "elav tishmaun". veillu shaalu et eliyyahu veamru lo heach naakor ma shekkatuv battora <small>(Devarim 12 13)</small> "pen taale olotecha bechol makom". haya omer lo neemar ella hammakriv bachutz leolam chayyav karet kemo shetztzivva moshe. aval ani akriv hayyom bachutz bidvar Adonai kede lehachechish nevie habbaal. veal hadderech hazzot im tziuu kol hanneviim laavor lefi shaa mitzva lishmoa lahem. veim amru shehaddavar neekar leolam mitato bechenek shehattora amra <small>(Devarim 29 28)</small> "lanu ulevanenu ad olam":

Vechen im akar davar middevarim shellamadnu mippi hashshemua o sheamar bedin middine tora she tzivva lo shehaddin kach hu vahalacha kedivre peloni hare ze nevi hashsheker veyechanek. af al pi sheasa ot. shehare ba lehachechish hattora sheamra <small>(Devarim 30 12)</small> "lo vashshamayim hi". aval lefi shaa shomin lo bakkol:

Bamme devarim amurim bishar mitzvot. aval baavodat kochavim en shomin lo vaafillu lefi shaa. vaafillu asa otot umoftim gedolim veamar she tzivvahu shetteaved avodat kochavim hayyom bilvad o beshaa zo bilvad hare ze dibber sara al Adonai. veal ze tzivva hakkatuv veamar <small>(Devarim 13 3)</small> "uva haot vehammofet" <small>(Devarim 13 4)</small> "lo tishma el divre hannavi hahu" <small>(Devarim 13 6)</small> "ki dibber sara al Adonai elohechem". shehare ba lehachechish nevuato shel moshe. ulefichach neda bevadday shehu nevi sheker vechol ma sheasa belat vechishshuf asa veyechanek:

Kol navi sheyyaamod lanu veyomar she shelacho eno tzarich laasot ot keechad meotot moshe rabbenu o keotot eliyyahu veelisha sheyyesh bahem shinnuy minhago shel olam. ella haot shello sheyyomar devarim haatidim lihyot baolam veyeamnu devarav shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 21)</small> "vechi tomar bilvavecha echa neda et haddavar" vegomer. lefichach kesheyyavo adam harauy linvua bemalachot hashshem velo yavo lehosif velo ligroa ella laavod et Adonai bemitzvot hattora en omrin lo kera lanu hayyam o hachaye met vechayyotze beellu veachar kach naamin becha. ella omrim lo im navi atta emor devarim haatidim lihyot vehu omer veanu mechakkim lirot hayavou devarav im lo yavou. vaafillu nafal davar katan beyadua shehu nevi sheker. veim bau devarav kullan yihye beenenu neeman:
Uvodkin oto peamim harebe. im nimtzeu devarav neemanim kullan hare ze nevi emet. kemo shenneemar bishmuel <small>(Shmuel 1 3 20)</small> "vayyeda kol yisrael middan vead beer shava ki neeman shemuel lenavi laAdonai":
Vahalo hameonnim vehakkosmim omrim ma sheatid lihyot. uma hefresh yesh ben hannavi uvenam. ella shehameonnim vehakkosmim vechayyotze bahen miktzat divrehem mitkayyemin umiktzatan en mitkayyemin. kainyan shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 47 13)</small> "yaamdu na veyoshiuch hovre shamayim hachozim bakkochavim modiim lechodashim measher yavou alayich". measher velo kol asher. veefshar shello yitkayyem middivrehem kelum ella yitu bakkol kainyan shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 44 25)</small> "mefer otot baddim vekosmim yeholel". aval hannavi kol devarav kayyamin shenneemar <small>(Melachim 2 10 10)</small> "ki lo yippol middevar Adonai artza". vechen hu omer <small>(yirmeya 23 28)</small> "hannavi asher itto chalom yesapper chalom vaasher devari itto yedabber divre emet ma latteven et habbar neum Adonai". kelomar sheddivre hakkosmim vehachalomot keteven shennitarev bo meat bar udevar Adonai kevar sheen bo teven kelal. uvaddavar hazze hakkatuv hivtiach veamar sheotan haddevarim shemmodiin hameonnim vehakkosmim laummot umechazzevin hannavi yodia lachem divre emet veen attem tzerichin limonen vekosem vechayyotze bo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 10)</small> "lo yimmatze vecha maavir beno uvitto baesh" vegomer <small>(Devarim 18 14)</small> "ki haggoyim haelle" vegomer. veamar <small>(Devarim 18 15)</small> "navi mikkirbecha meachecha" vegomer. ha lamadta sheen hannavi omed lanu ella lehodienu devarim haatidim lihyot baolam missova veraav milchama veshalom vechayyotze bahen. vaafillu tzarche yachid modia lo. keshaul sheavda lo aveda vehalach lannavi lehodio mekomah. vechayyotze beellu haddevarim hu sheyyomar hannavi lo sheyyaase dat acheret o yosif mitzva o yigra:
Divre happuranut shehannavi omer kegon sheyyomar peloni yamut o shana pelonit raav o milchama vechayyotze bidvarim ellu im lo amdu devarav en baze hachechasha linvuato. veen omrim hinne dibber velo ba. shehakkadosh baruch hu erech appayim verav chesed venicham al haraa veefshar sheasu teshuva venislach lahem keanshe ninve. o shettala lahem kechizkiyya. aval im hivtiach al tova veamar sheyyihye kach vechach velo baa hattova sheamar beyadua shehu nevi sheker. shekkol devar tova sheyyigzor hael afillu al tenay eno chozer. velo matzinu shechazar bidvar tova ella bechurban rishon keshehivtiach latztzaddikim shello yamutu im harshaim vechazar bidvarav. veze meforash bemassechet shabbat. ha lamadta shebbedivre hattova bilvad yibbachen hannavi. hu sheyyirmeyahu amar bitshuvato lachananya ben azzur keshehaya yirmeya mitnabbe leraa vachananya letova. amar lo lachananya im lo yaamdu devaray en baze reaya sheani nevi sheker aval im lo yaamdu devarecha yivvada sheatta nevi sheker. shenneemar <small>(yirmeya koach 7)</small> "ach shema na et haddavar hazze" vegomer hannavi asher yedabber shalom bevo devar hannavi yivvada hannavi asher shelacho Adonai beemet: 
Navi sheheid lo navi acher shehu navi hare hu bechezkat navi veen ze hashsheni tzarich chakira. shehare moshe rabbenu heid lihoshua veheeminu bo kol yisrael kodem sheyyaase ot. vechen ledorot. navi shennoda nevuato veheeminu bidvarav paam achar paam o sheheid lo navi vehaya holech bedarche hannevua asur lachshov acharav uleharher binvuato shemma enah emet. veasur lenassoto yoter midday velo nihye holchim umenassim leolam shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 16)</small> "lo tenassu et Adonai elohechem kaasher nissitem bammassa" sheamru <small>(Shemot 17 7)</small> "hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im ayin". ella meachar shennoda shezze navi yaaminu veyedu ki Adonai bekirbam velo yeharharu velo yachshevu acharav. kainyan shenneemar <small>(Yechezkel 2 5)</small> "veyadu ki navi haya vetocham":
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 1:
Deot harebe yesh lechol echad veechad mibbene adam vezo meshunna mizzo urechoka mimmennah beyoter. yesh adam shehu baal chema koes tamid. veyesh adam sheddato meyushshevet alav veeno koes kelal veim yichas yichas kaas meat bechamma shanim. veyesh adam shehu geva lev beyoter. veyesh shehu shefal ruach beyoter. veyesh shehu baal taava lo tisba nafsho mehaloch betaava. veyesh shehu baal lev tahor meod velo yitavve afillu lidvarim meattim shehagguf tzarich lahen. veyesh baal nefesh rechava shello tisba nafsho mikkol mamon haolam, kainyan shenneemar <small>(Kohelet 5 9)</small> "ohev kesef lo yisba kesef". veyesh mekatztzer nafsho sheddayyo afillu davar meat shello yaspik lo velo yirdof lehassig kol tzarko. veyesh shehu mesaggef atzmo beraav vekovetz al yado veeno ochel peruta mishshello ella betzaar gadol. veyesh shehu meabbed kol mamono beyado ledato. veal derachim ellu shear kol haddeot kegon meholel veonen vechilay veshoa veachzari verachaman verach levav veammitz lev vechayyotze bahen:
Veyesh ben kol dea vedea harchoka mimmenna bakkatze haacher deot benoniyyot zo rechoka mizzo. vechol haddeot yesh mehen deot shehen laadam mittechillat beriyyato lefi teva gufo. veyesh mehen deot shettivo shel adam ze mechuvvan veatid lekabbel otam bimhera yoter mishshear haddeot. veyesh mehen sheenan laadam mittechillat beriyyato ella lamad otam meacherim o shennifna lahen meatzmo lefi machashava shealta belibbo. o sheshshama shezzo haddea tova lo uvah rauy lelech vehinhig atzmo bah ad shennikbea belibbo:
Shete ketzavot harchokot zo mizzo shebbechol dea vedea enan derech tova veen rauy lo laadam lalechet bahen velo lelammedan leatzmo. veim matza tivo note leachat mehen o muchan leachat mehen o shekkevar lamed achat mehen venahag bah yachazir atzmo lammutav veyelech bederech hattovim vehi hadderech hayeshara:
Hadderech hayeshara hi midda benonit shebbechol dea vedea mikkol haddeot sheyyesh lo laadam. vehi haddea shehi rechoka mishshete hakketzavot richuk shave veenah kerova lo lazo velo lazo. lefichach tziuu chachamim harishonim sheyyehe adam sham deotav tamid umeshaer otam umechavvin otam badderech haemtzait kede sheyyehe shalem begufo. ketzad. lo yehe baal chema noach lichos velo kemet sheeno margish ella benoni. lo yichos ella al davar gadol sherauy lichos alav kede shello yease kayyotze bo paam acheret. vechen lo yitavve ella lidvarim shehagguf tzarich lahen vei efshar lihyot bezulatan kainyan shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 13 25)</small> "tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho". vechen lo yihye amel beisko ella lehassig davar shetztzarich lo lechayye shaa kainyan shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 37 16)</small> "tov meat latztzaddik". velo yikpotz yado beyoter. velo yefazzer mamono ella noten tzedaka kefi missat yado umalve karauy lemi shetztzarich. velo yehe meholel vesochek velo atzev veonen ella sameach kol yamav benachat besever panim yafot. vechen shear deotav. vederech zo hi derech hachachamim. kol adam sheddeotav deot (benonit) [benoniyyot] memutztzaot nikra chacham:
Umi shehu medakdek al atzmo beyoter veyitrachek middea benonit meat letzad ze o letzad ze nikra chasid. ketzad. mi sheyyitrachek miggova hallev ad hakkatze haacharon veyihye shefal ruach beyoter nikra chasid vezo hi middat chasidut. veim nitrachek ad haemtza bilvad veyihye anav nikra chacham vezo hi middat chachma. veal derech zo shear kol haddeot. vachasidim harishonim hayu mattin deot shellahen midderech haemtzait keneged shete hakketzavot. yesh dea shemmattin otah keneged hakkatze haacharon veyesh dea shemmattin otah keneged hakkatze harishon. vezehu lifnim mishshurat haddin. umetzuvvin anu lalechet badderachim haellu habbenonim vehem hadderachim hattovim vehayesharim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 28 9)</small> "vehalachta bidrachav":
Kach lamdu beferush mitzva zo. ma hu nikra channun af atta heye channun. ma hu nikra rachum af atta heye rachum. ma hu nikra kadosh af atta heye kadosh. veal derech zo karu hanneviim lael bechol otan hakkinnuyin erech appayim verav chesed tzaddik veyashar tamim gibbor vechazak vechayyotze bahen. lehodia shehen derachim tovim visharim vechayyav adam lehanehig atzmo bahen ulehiddammot elav kefi kocho:
Vechetzad yargil adam atzmo bedeot ellu ad sheyyikkavu bo. yaase veyishne vishallesh bammaasim sheose al pi haddeot haemtzaiyyot veyachazor bahem tamid ad sheyyihyu maasehem kallim alav velo yihye bahem torach alav veyikkavu haddeot benafsho. ulefi shehashshemot haellu nikra bahen hayyotzer vehem hadderech habbenonit sheanu chayyavin lalechet bah. nikret derech zo derech Adonai. vehi shellimmed avraham avinu levanav shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 18 19)</small> "ki yedativ lemaan asher yetzavve" vegomer. vehaholech bederech zo mevi tova uveracha leatzmo shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 18 19)</small> "lemaan havi Adonai al avraham et asher dibber alav":
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 2:
Chole hagguf toamim hammar matok umatok mar. veyesh min hacholim mi shemmitavve vetaev lemaachalot sheenan reuyin laachila kegon heafar vehappecham vesone hammaachalot hattovim kegon happat vehabbasar hakkol lefi rov hacholi. kach bene adam shennafshotehem cholot mitavvim veohavim haddeot haraot vesonim hadderech hattova umitatztzelim lalechet bah vehi keveda alehem limod lefi chalyam. vechen yeshayahu omer baanashim hallalu <small>(yeshaya 5 20)</small> "hoy haomrim lara tov velattov ra samim choshech leor veor lechoshech samim mar lematok umatok lemar". vaalehem neemar <small>(Mishlei 2 13)</small> "haozvim archot ysher lalechet bedarche chshech". uma hi takkanat chole hannefashot. yelchu etzel hachachamim shehen rofe hannefashot virappeu chalyam baddeot shemmelammedin otam ad sheyyachazirum ladderech hattova. vehammakkirim baddeot haraot shellahem veenam holchim etzel hachachamim lerappe otam alehem amar shelomo <small>(Mishlei 1 7)</small> "chachma umusar evilim bazu":
Vechetzad hi refuatam. mi shehu baal chema omrim lo lehanehig atzmo sheim hukka vekullal lo yargish kelal. veyelech bederech zo zeman merubbe ad sheyyitakker hachema millibbo. veim haya geva lev yanhig atzmo bevizzayon harebe veyeshev lematta min hakkol veyilbash beloye sechavot hamevazzot et lovshehem vechayyotze bidvarim ellu ad sheyyaakor gova hallev mimmennu veyachazor ladderech haemtzait shehu derech hattova. velichsheyyachazor ladderech haemtzait yelech bah kol yamav. veal kav ze yaase bishar kol haddeot im haya rachok lakkatze haechad yarchik atzmo lakkatze hashsheni veyinhog bo zeman rav ad sheyyachazor bo ladderech hattova vehi midda benonit shebbechol dea vedea:
Veyesh deot sheasur lo laadam linhog bahen bevenonit ella yitrachek min hakkatze haechad ad hakkatze haacher. vehu gova lev. sheen derech hattova sheyyihye adam anav bilvad ella sheyyihye shefal ruach vetihye rucho nemucha limod. ulefichach neemar bemoshe rabbenu <small>(Bamidbar 12 3)</small> "anav meod" velo neemar anav bilvad. ulefichach tziuu chachamim meod meod heve shefal ruach. veod amru shekkol hammagbiah libbo kafar baikkar shenneemar <small>(Devarim 8 14)</small> "veram levavecha veshachachta et Adonai elokecha". veod amru beshammata man deit beh gassut haruach vaafillu miktzatah. vechen hakkaas midda raa hi ad limod verauy laadam sheyyitrachek mimmenna ad hakkatze haacher. vilammed atzmo shello yichos vaafillu al davar sherauy lichos alav. veim ratza lehattil ema al banav uvene beto o al hatztzibbur im haya parnas veratza lichos alehen kede sheyyachzeru lammutav yare atzmo bifnehem shehu koes kede leyasseram vetihye dato meyushshevet beno leven atzmo keadam shehu medamme koes bishat kaaso vehu eno koes. amru chachamim harishonim kol hakkoes keillu oved avodat kochavim. veamru shekkol hakkoes im chacham hu chachmato mistalleket mimmennu veim navi hu nevuato mistalleket mimmennu. uvaale kaas en chayyehem chayyim. lefichach tziuu lehitrachek min hakkaas ad sheyyanhig atzmo shello yargish afillu laddevarim hammachisim vezo hi hadderech hattova. vederech hatztzaddikim hen aluvin veenan olvin shomim cherpatam veenam meshivin osin meahava usemechim beyissurim. vaalehem hakkatuv omer <small>(Shoftim 5 lo)</small> "veohavav ketzet hashshemesh bigvurato": 
Leolam yarbe adam bishtika velo yedabber ella o bidvar chachma o bidvarim shetztzarich lahem lechayye gufo. amru al rav talmid rabbenu hakkadosh shello sach sicha betela kol yamav. vezo hi sichat rov kol adam. vaafillu betzarche hagguf lo yarbe adam devarim. veal ze tziuu chachamim veamru kol hammarbe devarim mevi chet. veamru <small>(mishna avot 1 17)</small> "lo matzati lagguf tov ella shetika". vechen bedivre tora uvedivre chachma yihyu divre haadam meattim veinyenehem merubbim. vehu shetztziuu chachamim veamru <small>(gemara fesachim 3 2)</small> "leolam yishne adam letalmidav derech ketzara". aval im hayu haddevarim merubbin vehainyan muat hare zo sichlut veal ze neemar <small>(Kohelet 5 2)</small> "ki ba hachalom berov inyan vekol kesil berov devarim":
<small>(Mishna avot 3 13)</small> "seyag lachachma shetika". lefichach lo yemaher lehashiv velo yarbe ledabber. vilammed lattalmidim beshuva vanachat belo tzeaka uvelo arichut lashon. hu sheamar shelomo <small>(Kohelet 9 17)</small> "divre chachamim benachat nishmaim":
Asur laadam lehanehig atzmo bedivre chalakot ufittuy. velo yihye echad bappe veechad ballev ella tocho kevaro vehainyan shebballev hu haddavar shebbappe. veasur lignov daat habberiyyot vaafillu daat hannachri. ketzad. lo yimkor lenachri besar nevela bimkom besar shechuta. velo minal shel meta bimkom minal shel shechuta. velo yesarhev bachavero sheyyochal etzlo vehu yodea sheeno ochel. velo yarbe lo betikrovet vehu yodea sheeno mekabbel. velo yiftach lo chaviyyot shehu tzarich lefatchan lemachran kede lefattoto shebbishvil kevodo patach vechen kol kayyotze bo. vaafillu milla achat shel pittuy veshel genevat daat asur, ella sefat emet veruach nachon velev tahor mikkol amal vehauot:
Lo yehe adam baal sechok umahatallot velo atzev veonen ella sameach. kach amru chachamim sechok vekallut rosh margilin et haadam leerva. vetziuu shello yehe adam parutz bitzchok velo atzev umitabbel ella mekabbel et kol haadam besever panim yafot. vechen lo yihye baal nefesh rechava nivhal lahon velo atzev uvatel mimmelacha. ella baal ayin tova memaet beesek veosek battora. veoto hammeat shehu chelko yismach bo. velo baal ketata velo baal kina velo baal taava velo rodef achar hakkavod. kach amru chachamim hakkina vehattaava vehakkavod motziin et haadam min haolam. kelalo shel davar yelech bammidda habbenonit shebbechol dea vedea ad sheyyihyu kol deotav mechuvvanot baemtzaut. vehu sheshshelomo amar <small>(Mishlei 4 26)</small> "palles magal raglecha vechol derachecha yikkonu":
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 3: Shemma yomar adam hoil vehakkina vehattaava vehakkavod vechayyotze bahem derech raa hen umotziin et haadam min haolam. efrosh mehen beyoter veetrachek latztzad haacharon. ad shello yochal basar velo yishte yayin velo yissa ishsha velo yeshev bedira naa velo yilbash malbush nae ella hassak vehatztzemer hakkashe vechayyotze bahen kegon kohane haovde kochavim. gam ze derech raa hi veasur lelech bah. hamehallech bederech zo nikra chote. shehare hu omer benazir <small>(Bamidbar 6 11)</small> "vechipper alav measher chata al hannafesh". amru chachamim uma im nazir shello perash ella min hayyayin tzarich kappara hammonea atzmo mikkol davar vedavar al achat kamma vechamma. lefichach tziuu chachamim shello yimna adam atzmo ella middevarim shemmenato hattora bilvad. velo yehe oser atzmo bindarim uvishvuot al devarim hammuttarim. kach amru chachamim lo dayyecha ma sheasra tora ella sheatta oser alecha devarim acherim. uvakkelal hazze ellu shemmitannin tamid enan bederech tova. veasru chachamim sheyyehe adam mesaggef atzmo betaanit. veal kol haddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahen tzivva shelomo veamar <small>(Kohelet 7 16)</small> "al tehi tzaddik harebe veal titchakkam yoter lamma tishshomem":

Tzarich haadam sheyyechavvin libbo vechol maasav kullam leda et hashshem baruch hu bilvad, veyihye shivto vekumo vedibburo hakkol leummat ze haddavar. ketzad? kesheyyissa veyitten o yaase melacha littol sachar, lo yihye belibbo likbotz mamon bilvad, ella yaase devarim haellu kede sheyyimtza devarim shehagguf tzarich lahem meachila ushetiyya vishivat bayit unesiat ishsha. vechen kesheyyochal veyishte veyivol lo yasim belibbo laasot devarim haellu kede lehanot bilvad ad shennimtza sheeno ochel veshote ella hammatok lachech veyivol kede lehanot, ella yasim al libbo sheyyochal veyishte kede lehaverot gufo veevarav bilvad. lefichach lo yochal kol shehachech mitavve kechelev vachamor ella yochal devarim hammoilim lagguf im marim im metukim. velo yochal devarim haraim lagguf af al pi shehen metukim lachech. ketzad? mi shehaya besaro cham lo yochal basar velo devash velo yishte yayin, kainyan sheamar shelomo derech mashal <small>(Mishlei 25 27)</small> "achl devash" vegomer. veshote me hoolashin af al pi shehu mar shennimtza shote veochel derech refua bilvad kede sheyyavri veyaamod shalem hoil vei efshar laadam lichyot ella baachila ushetiyya. vechen kesheyyivol lo yivol ella kede lehaverot gufo uchede lekayyem et hazzera. lefichach eno boel kol zeman sheyyitavve ella kol et sheyyeda shehu tzarich lehotzi shichvat zera kemo derech harfua o lekayyem et hazzera:

Hammanhig atzmo al pi harfua. im sam al libbo sheyyihye kol gufo veevarav shelemim bilvad vesheyyihyu lo banim osin melachto vaamelin letzarko en zo derech tova. ella yasim al libbo sheyyehe gufo shalem vechazak kede shettihye nafsho yeshara ladaat et Adonai. shei efshar sheyyavin veyistakkel bachachmot vehu raev vechole o echad meevarav koev. veyasim al libbo sheyyihye lo ben ulay yihye chacham vegadol beyisrael. nimtza hamehallech bederech zo kol yamav oved et Adonai tamid. afillu beshaa shennose venoten vaafillu beshaa shebboel. mippene shemmachashavto bakkol kede sheyyimtza tzerachav ad sheyyihye gufo shalem laavod et Adonai. vaafillu beshaa shehu yashen im yashen ledaat kede shettanuach dato alav veyanuach gufo kede shello yechele velo yuchal laavod et Adonai vehu chole, nimtzet shena shello avoda lammakom baruch hu. veal inyan ze tziuu chachamim veamru <small>(mishna avot 2 12)</small> "vechol maasecha yihyu leshem shamayim". vehu sheamar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Mishlei 3 6)</small> "bechol derachecha daehu vehu yeyashsher orchotecha":
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 4: Hoil veheyot hagguf bari veshalem middarche hashshem hu. shehare i efshar sheyyavin o yeda davar midiat habbore vehu chole. lefichach tzarich leharechik adam atzmo middevarim hameabbedin et hagguf. ulehanhig atzmo bidvarim hammavrin vehammachalimim. veellu hen: leolam lo yochal adam ella keshehu raev. velo yishte ella keshehu tzame. veal yashhe nekavav afillu rega echad. ella kol zeman shetztzarich lehashetin o lehasech et raglav yaamod miyyad:

Lo yochal adam ad shettitmalle kereso ella yifchot kemo revia missavato. velo yishte mayim betoch hammazon ella meat umazug beyayin. uchesheyyatchil hammazon lehitakkel bemeav shote ma shehu tzarich lishtot. velo yarbe lishtot mayim vaafillu kesheyyitakkel hammazon. velo yochal ad sheyyivdok atzmo yafe yafe shemma yihye tzarich linkavav. lo yochal adam ad sheyyelech kodem achila ad sheyyatchil gufo lachom. o yaase melachto o yityaggea beyega acher. kelalo shel davar yeanne gufo veyiga kol yom babboker ad sheyyatchil gufo lachom veyishkot meat ad shettityashshev nafsho veochel. veim rachatz bechammin achar sheyyaga hare ze tov veachar kach shohe meat veochel:

Leolam kesheyyochal adam yeshev bimkomo o yitte al semol. velo yehallech velo yirkav velo yiga velo yezaazea gufo velo yetayyel ad sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav. vechol hametayyel achar achilato o sheyyagea hare ze mevi al atzmo cholaim raim vekashim:

Hayyom vehallayla 24 shaot. day lo laadam lishon shelishan shehu shemone shaot. veyihyu besof hallayla kede shettihye mittechillat shenato ad shettaale hashshemesh shemone shaot. venimtza omed mimmittato kodem shettaale hashshemesh:

Lo yishan adam lo al panav velo al arpo ella al tziddo. bitchillat hallayla al tzad semol. uvesof hallayla al tzad yamin. velo yishan samuch laachila ella yamtin achar achila kemo shalosh o arba shaot. velo yishan bayyom:

Devarim hameshalshelin et bene meayim kegon anavim uteenim vetutim vaagassim vaavattichim umine hakkishshuim umine melaffonot ochel otam haadam battechilla kodem achila. velo yearvem im hammazon. ella shohe meat ad sheyyetzu mibbeten haelyon veochel mezono. udevarim shemmeammetzin et bene meayim kegon rimmonim uferishim vetappuchim ukerostomolin ochel otan techef limzono. velo yarbe leechol mehen:

Kesheyyirtze adam leechol besar of uvesar behema keechad. ochel battechilla besar haof. vechen betzim uvesar of ochel battechilla betzim. besar behema dakka uvesar behema gassa ochel battechilla besar dakka. leolam yakdim adam davar hakkal umeacher hakkaved:

Bimot hachamma ochel maachalim hakkarim velo yarbe bitvalim veochel et hachometz. uvimot haggeshamim ochel maachalim hachammim umarbe bitvalim veochel meat min hachardal umin hachiltit. veal derech zo holech veose bammekomot hakkarim uvammekomot hachammim bechol makom umakom harauy lo:

Yesh maachalot shehem raim beyoter ad meod verauy laadam shello leachlan leolam. kegon haddagim haggedolim hammeluchim hayeshanim. vehaggevina hammelucha hayeshana. vehakkemehin ufitriyyot vehabbasar hammaliach hayyashan. veyayin miggitto. vetavshil sheshshaha ad shennadaf recho. vechen kol maachol sherecho ra o mar beyoter. hare ellu lagguf kemo sam hammavet. veyesh maachalot shehen raim aval enan kemo harishonim leroa. lefichach rauy laadam shello leechol mehen ella meat veachar yamim harebe. velo yargil atzmo lihyot mezono mehem o leachlan im mezono tamid. kegon dagim gedolim ugevina vechalav sheshshaha achar shennechlav 24 shaot. uvesar shevarim gedolim uteyashim gedolim vehappol vehaadashim vehassappir velechem seorim velechem matztzot vehakkeruv vehechatzir vehabbetzalim vehashshumim vehachardal vehatztzenon. kol ellu maachalim raim hem en rauy laadam leechol meellu ella meat ad meod uvimot haggeshamim. aval bimot hachamma lo yochal mehen kelal. vehappol vehaadashim bilvad en rauy leachlan lo bimot hachamma velo bimot haggeshamim. vehaddeluin ochlin mehen bimot hachamma:

Veyesh maachalot shehem raim veenan kemo ellu. vehem of hammayim uvene yona hakketannim vehattemarim velechem kaluy beshemen o lechem shennillosh beshemen vehassolet shennippu otah kol tzarkah ad shello nishara bah reach muresan. vehatztzir vehammureyays. en rauy leharebot maachalot ellu. veadam shehu chacham vechovesh et yitzro velo yimmashech achar taavato velo yochal min hannizkarim kelum ella im nitzrach lahem lirfua hare ze gibbor:

Leolam yimna adam atzmo mipperot hailanot. velo yarbe mehen vaafillu yeveshin veen tzarich lomar retubbim. aval kodem sheyyitbashshelu kol tzarkan hare hen kacharavot lagguf. vechen hacharuvim raim leolam. vechol happerot hachamutzin raim veen ochlin mehen ella meat bimot hachamma uvammekomot hachammim. vehatteenim vehaanavim vehashshekedim leolam tovim ben retubbin ben yeveshin veochel adam mehem kol tzarko. velo yatmid achilatam af al pi shehen tovim mikkol peri hailanot:
Haddevash vehayyayin ra lakketannim veyafe lazzekenim vechol shekken bimot haggeshamim. vetzarich adam leechol bimot hachamma shene shelishim ma shehu ochel bimot haggeshamim:

Leolam yishtaddel adam sheyyihyu meav rafin kol yamav veyihye karov leshilshul meat. veze kelal gadol barfua kol zeman shehari nimna o yotze bekoshi cholaim raim baim. uvamme yarpe adam meav im yitammetzu meat. im haya bachur yochal babboker babboker meluchim shelukim metubbalin beshemen zayit uvemureyays uvemelach belo pat. o yishte me shelek shel teradin o keruv beshemen zayit umureyays umelach. veim haya zaken yishte devash mazug bemayim chammim babboker veyishhe kemo arba shaot veachar kach yochal seuddato. veyaase chen yom echad o shelosha o arbaa yamim im tzarich lechach ad sheyyirpu meav:
Veod kelal acher amru bivriut hagguf. kol zeman sheadam mitammel veyagea harebe veeno savea umeav rafin en choli ba alav vechocho mitchazzek. vaafillu ochel maachalot haraim:

Vechol mi shehu yoshev lavetach veeno mitammel. o mi shemmashhe nekavav. o mi shemmeav kashin. afillu achal maachalot tovim veshamar atzmo al pi harfua. kol yamav yihyu machovim vechocho tashesh. vaachila gassa leguf kol adam kemo sam hammavet. vehu ikkar lechol hecholaim. verov hecholaim shebbaim al haadam enam ella o mippene maachalim raim. o mippene shehu memalle bitno veochel achila gassa afillu mimmaachalim tovim. hu sheshshelomo amar bechachmato <small>(Mishlei 21 23)</small> "shomer piv uleshono shomer mitztzarot nafsho". kelomar shomer piv milleechol maachol ra o millisboa uleshono milledabber ella bitzrachav:

Derech harchitza. sheyyikkanes adam lammerchatz mishshiva yamim leshiva yamim. velo yikkanes samuch laachila. velo keshehu raev. ella kesheyyatchil hammazon lehitakkel. verochetz kol gufo bechammin sheen hagguf nichve bahen. verosho bilvad bechammin shehagguf nichve bahen. veachar kach yirchatz gufo befoshrin veachar kach befoshrin min happoshrin ad sheyyirchatz betzonen. velo yaavor al rosho mayim lo poshrin velo tzonen. velo yirchatz betzonen bimot haggeshamim. velo yirchatz ad sheyyazzia vifarech kol gufo. velo yaarich bammerchatz ella kesheyyazzia vifarech gufo yishtattef veyetze. uvodek atzmo kodem sheyyikkanes lammerchatz veachar sheyyetze shemma yehe tzarich linkavav. vechen bodek adam atzmo tamid kodem achila veachar achila. vekodem beila veachar beila. vekodem sheyyiga veyitammel veachar sheyyiga veyitammel. vekodem sheyyishan veachar sheyyishan. uveshiur hakkol asara:

Kesheyyetze adam min hammerchatz yilbash begadav vichasse rosho babbayit hachitzon kede shello tishlot bo ruach kara. vaafillu bimot hachamma tzarich lehizzaher. veyishhe achar sheyyetze ad shettityashshev nafsho veyanuach gufo vetasur hachamimut veachar kach yochal. veim yashen meat kesheyyetze min hammerchatz kodem achila hare ze yafe meod. velo yishte mayim karim betzeto min hammerchatz veen tzarich lomar shello yishte bammerchatz. veim tzame kesheyyatza min hammerchatz veeno yachol limnoa atzmo yearev hammayim beyayin o bidvash veyishte. veim sach beshemen bammerchatz bimot haggeshamim achar sheyyishtattef hare ze tov:

Lo yargil adam lehakkiz dam tamid. velo yakkiz ella im yihye tzarich lo beyoter. velo yakkiz lo bimot hachamma velo bimot haggeshamim ella meat bime nisan umeat bime tishre. umeachar chamishshim shana lo yakkiz kelal. velo yakkiz adam dam veyikkanes lammerchatz bo bayyom. velo yakkiz veyetze ladderech. velo beyom sheyyavo min hadderech. veyochal veyishte beyom hahakkaza pachot mimma shehu ragil. veyanuach beyom hahakkaza velo yiga velo yitammel velo yetayyel:

Shichvat zera hi koach hagguf vechayyav umeor haenayim vechol shettetze beyoter hagguf kale vechocho kale vechayyav ovdim. hu sheamar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Mishlei lo 3)</small> "al titten lannashim chelecha". kol hashshatuf bivila zikna kofetzet alav. vechocho tashesh. veenav kehot. vereach ra nodef mippiv umishshechyo. usear rosho vegabbot enav verise enav noshrot. usear zekano veshechyo usear raglav rabbe. shinnav noflot. veharebe keevim chutz meellu baim alav. amru chachme harofim echad meelef met bishar cholaim vehaelef merov hattashmish. lefichach tzarich adam lehizzaher bedavar ze im ratza lichyot betova. velo yivol ella kesheyyimmatze gufo bari vechazak beyoter vehu mitkashshe harebe shello ledato. umassiach atzmo ledavar acher vehakkishshuy bo keshehaya. veyimmatze koved mimmatnav ulematta ucheillu chute habbetzim nimshachim uvesaro cham. ze tzarich livol urefua lo sheyyivol. lo yivol adam vehu savea velo raev ella achar sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav. veyivdok nekavav kodem beila uleachar beila. velo yivol meummad velo meyushshav. velo bevet hammerchatz velo beyom sheyyikkanes lammerchatz. velo beyom hakkaza. velo beyom yetzia ladderech o bia min hadderech lo lifnehem velo leacharehem:

Kol hammanhig atzmo bidrachim ellu shehorinu ani arev lo sheeno ba lide choli kol yamav ad sheyyazkin harebe veyamut veeno tzarich lerofe. veyihye gufo shalem veomed al buryo kol yamav. ella im ken haya gufo ra mittechillat beriyyato. o im haya ragil beminhag min hamminhagot haraim mittechillat moladto. o im tavo makkat dever o makkat batztzoret laolam:
