Vechol hamminhagot hattovim haellu sheamarnu en rauy linhog bahen ella habbari. aval hachole o mi sheechad meevarav chole o mi shennahag minhag ra shanim rabbot. yesh lechol echad mehem derachim acherim vehanehagot kefi chalyo kemo sheyyitbaer besefer harfuot. veshinnuy veset techillat choli:
Kol makom sheen bo rofe. echad habbari veechad hachole en rauy lo lazuz mikkol hadderachim haellu shenneemru beferek ze. shekkol echad mehen leacharit tova mevi:

Kol ir sheen bah asara devarim haellu en talmid chacham rashshay ladur betochah. veellu hen: rofe. veumman. uvet hammerchatz. uvet hakkisse. umayim metzuyin kegon nahar umayan. uvet hakkeneset. umelammed tinokot. velavlar. vegabbay tzedaka. uvet din makkim vechovshim:
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 5: Keshem shehechacham nikkar bechachmato uvedeotav vehu muvdal bahem mishshear haam. kach tzarich sheyyihye nikkar bemaasav bemaachalo uvemashkehu uvivilato uvaasiyyat tzerachav uvedibburo uvehillucho uvemalbusho uvechilkul devarav uvemassao uvemattano. veyihyu kol hammaasim haellu naim umetukkanim beyoter. ketzad. talmid chacham lo yihye gargeran ella ochel maachol harauy lehaverot gufo. velo yochal mimmennu achila gassa. velo yehe rodef lemalleot bitno keellu shemmitmallein mimmaachol umishte ad shettippach keresam. vaalehem meforash bakkabbala <small>(Malachi 2 3)</small> "vezeriti feresh al penechem". amru chachamim ellu bene adam sheochlin veshotin veosin kol yemehem kechaggim. vehem haomrim <small>(yeshaya 22 13)</small> "achol veshato ki machar namut". vezehu maachal harshaim. veshulchanot ellu hem shegginna hakkatuv veamar <small>(yeshaya koach 8)</small> "ki kol shulchanot malu ki tzoa beli makom". aval hechacham eno ochel ella tavshil echad o shenayim veochel mimmennu kede chayyav vedayyo. hu sheamar shelomo <small>(Mishlei 13 25)</small> "tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho":

Keshehechacham ochel meat ze harauy lo lo yochlennu ella beveto al shulchano. velo yochal bachanut velo bashshuk ella mippene tzorech gadol. kede shello yitganne bifne habberiyyot. velo yochal etzel amme haaretz velo al otan hashshulchanot hammeleim ki tzoa. velo yarbe seuddotav bechol makom vaafillu im hachachamim. velo yochal bisuddot sheyyesh bahen kibbutz harebe. veen rauy lo leechol ella bisudda shel mitzva bilvad kegon seuddat erusin venissuin. vehu sheyyihye talmid chacham shennasa bat talmid chacham. vehatztzaddikim vehachasidim harishonim lo achlu misseudda sheenah shellahen:

Keshehechacham shote yayin eno shote ella kede lishrot achila shebbemeav. vechol hammishtakker hare ze chote umegunne umafsid chachmato. veim nishtakker bifne amme haaretz hare ze chillel et hashshem. veasur lishtot yayin batztzohorayim vaafillu meat ella im haya bichlal haachila. shehashshetiyya shehi bichlal haachila enah meshakkeret. veen nizharin ella miyyayin shelleachar hammazon:

Af al pi sheishto shel adam mutteret lo tamid. rauy lo letalmid chacham sheyyanhig atzmo bikdushsha velo yehe matzuy etzel ishto ketarnegol ella millele shabbat lelele shabbat im yesh bo koach. ucheshehu mesapper immah lo yesapper bitchillat hallayla keshehu savea uvitno male. velo besof hallayla keshehu raev. ella beemtza hallayla kesheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav. velo yakel berosho beyoter velo yenabbel et piv bedivre havay vaafillu beno levenah. hare hu omer bekabbala maggid leadam ma secho. amru chachamim afillu sicha kalla shebben adam leishto atid litten aleha et haddin. velo yihyu shenehem lo shikkorim velo atzlanim velo atzbanim, velo echad mehen. velo tihye yeshena. velo yeenos otah vehi enah rotza ella birtzon shenehem uvesimchatam. yesapper veyischak meat immah kede shettityashshev nafshah veyivol bevusha velo beazzut veyifrosh miyyad:

Kol hannoheg minhag ze lo day lo shekkiddesh nafsho vetiher atzmo vetikken deotav ella sheim hayu lo banim yihyu naim uvayshanim reuyin lechachma velachasidut. vechol hannoheg beminhagot shear haam haholchim bachoshech yihyu lo banim kemo otam haam:

Tzeniut gedola nohagim talmide chachamim beatzman. lo yitbazzu velo yitgallu roshan velo gufan. vaafillu beshaa sheyyikkanes levet hakkisse yehe tzanua velo yegalle begadav ad sheyyeshev. velo yekanneach beyamin. veyitrachek mikkol adam. veyikkanes cheder lifnim mecheder meara lifnim min hammeara venifne. veim nifne achore haggader yitrachek kede shello yishma chavero kolo im nitattesh. veim nifne bevika yarchik kede shello yire chavero peruo. velo yedabber keshehu nifne afillu letzorech gadol. uchederech shennoheg tzeniut bayyom bevet hakkisse kach noheg ballayla. uleolam yelammed adam atzmo lehippanot shacharit vearvit bilvad kede shello yitrachek:

Talmid chacham lo yehe tzoek vetzoveach bishat dibburo kivhemot vechayyot. velo yagbiah kolo beyoter ella dibburo benachat im kol habberiyyot. uchesheyyedabber benachat yizzaher shello yitrachek ad sheyyerae kedivre gasse haruach. umakdim shalom lechol haadam kede shettehe ruchan nocha hemennu. vedan et kol haadam lechaf zechut. mesapper beshevach chavero velo bignuto kelal. ohev shalom verodef shalom. im roe sheddevarav moilim venishmaim omer veim lav shotek. ketzad. lo yeratztze chavero bishat kaaso. velo yishal lo al nidro beshaa shennadar ad shettitkarer dato veyanuach. velo yenachamennu beshaa shemmeto muttal lefanav mippene shehu bahul ad sheyyikberehu. vechen kol kayyotze beellu. velo yire lachavero bishat kalkalato ella yaalim enav mimmennu. velo yeshanne bedibburo. velo yosif velo yigra ella bedivre shalom vechayyotze bahen. kelalo shel davar eno medabber ella bedivre chachma o bigmilut chasadim vechayyotze bahen. velo yesapper im ishsha bashshuk vaafillu hi ishto o achoto o bitto:

Lo yelech talmid chacham bekoma zekufa vegaron natuy kainyan shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 3 16)</small> "vattelachna netuyot garon umesakkerot enayim". velo yehallech akev betzad gudal benachat kemo hannashim vegasse haruach kainyan shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 3 16)</small> "haloch vetafof telachna uveraglehem teakkasna". velo yarutz birshut harabbim keminhag meshuggaim. velo yichpof komato kevaale chatoteret. ella mistakkel lematta kemo shehu omed bitfilla. umehallech bashshuk keadam shehu tarud baasakav. gam mimmahalacho shel adam nikkar im chacham uvaal dea hu o shote vesachol. vechen amar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Kohelet 10 3)</small> "vegam badderech keshessachol holech libbo chaser veamar lakkol sachol hu". hu modia lakkol al atzmo shehu sachol:

Malbush talmid chacham malbush nae venaki. veasur lo sheyyimmatze bevigdo ketem o shamnunit vechayyotze bahen. velo yilbash lo malbush melachim kegon bigde zahav veargaman shehakkol mistakkelin bahen. velo malbush aniyyim shehu mevazze et lovshav ella begadim benonim naim. velo yehe besaro nire mittachat maddav kemo bigde happishtan hakkallim beyoter sheosim bemitzrayim. velo yihyu begadav sechuvin al haaretz kemo bigde gasse haruach ella ad akevo uvet yad shello ad rashe etzbeotav. velo yeshalshel tallito mippene shennire kegassut haruach ella beshabbat bilvad im en lo lehachalif. velo yinal minalim metullaim telay al gabbe telay bimot hachamma. aval bimot haggeshamim muttar im haya ani. lo yetze mevussam lashshuk velo bivgadim mevussamim velo yasim boshom bisaro. aval im mashach besaro bevoshom kede lehaavir et hazzuhama muttar. vechen lo yetze yechidi ballayla. ella im ken haya lo zeman kavua latzet bo letalmudo. kol ellu mippene hachashad:

Talmid chacham mechalkel devarav bemishpat. ochel veshote vezan et anshe beto kefi mamono vehatzelachato. velo yatriach al atzmo yoter midday. tziuu chachamim bederech eretz shello yochal adam basar ella leteavon. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 20)</small> "ki teavve nafshecha leechol basar". dayyo labbari leechol basar meerev shabbat leerev shabbat. veim haya ashir kede leechol basar bechol yom ochel. tziuu chachamim veamru leolam yochal adam pachot min harauy lo lefi mamono veyilbash karauy lo vichabbed ishto uvanav yoter min harauy lo:

Derech baale dea sheyyikba lo adam melacha hamefarneset oto techilla. veachar kach yikne bet dira. veachar kach yissa ishsha. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20 6)</small> "mi haish asher nata kerem velo chillelo". <small>(Devarim 20 5)</small> "mi haish asher bana vayit chadash velo chanacho". <small>(Devarim 20 7)</small> "mi haish asher eras ishsha velo lekachah". aval hattippeshin matchilin lissa ishsha veachar kach im timtza yado yikne bayit veachar kach besof yamav yechazzer levakkesh ummanut o yitparnes min hatztzedaka. vechen hu omer bakkelalot <small>(Devarim 28 30)</small> "ishsha teares" <small>(Devarim 28 30)</small> "bayit tivne" <small>(Devarim 28 30)</small> "kerem titta". kelomar yihyu maasecha hafuchin kede shello tatzliach et derachecha. uvabberacha hu omer <small>(Shmuel 1 18 14)</small> "vayhi david lechol derachav maskil vaAdonai immo":

Veasur lo laadam lehafekir o lehakedish kol nechasav veyatriach al habberiyyot. velo yimkor sade veyikne bayit velo bayit veyikne mittaltelin o yaase sechora bidme beto. aval mocher hu mittaltelin vekone sade. kelalo shel davar yasim megammato lehatzeliach nechasav ulehachalif hakkale bekayyam. velo tihye kavvanato lehanot meat lefi shaa o lehanot meat veyafsid harebe:

Massao umattano shel talmid chacham beemet uveemuna. omer al lav lav veal hen hen. medakdek al atzmo becheshbon venoten umevatter laacherim kesheyyikkach mehen velo yedakdek alehen. venoten deme hammikkach lealtar veeno naase lo arev velo kabbelan velo yavo behareshaa. (eno) mechayyev atzmo bedivre mikkach umimkar bemakom shello chiyyeva oto tora. kede sheyyaamod bedibburo velo yeshannehu. veim nitchayyevu lo acherim baddin maarich umochel lahen umalve vechonen. velo yered letoch ummanut chavero. velo yatzer leadam leolam bechayyav. kelalo shel davar yihye min hannirdafim velo min harodfim min hanneelavim velo min haolvim. veadam sheose kol hammaasim haellu vechayyotze bahen alav hakkatuv omer vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar:
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 6: Derech beriyyato shel adam lihyot nimshach bedeotav uvemaasav achar reav vachaverav venoheg keminhag anshe medinato. lefichach tzarich adam lehitchabber latztzaddikim vileshev etzel hachachamim tamid kede sheyyilmad mimmaasehem. viyitirachek min harshaim haholchim bachoshech kede shello yilmod mimmaasehem. hu sheshshelomo omer <small>(Mishlei 13 20)</small> "holech et chachamim yechkam veroe chesilim yeroa". veomer ashre haish vegomer. vechen im haya bimdina shemminhagoteha raim veen anasheha holchim bederech yeshara yelech lemakom sheanasheha tzaddikim venohagim bederech tovim. veim hayu kol hammedinot shehu yodam veshomea shemuatan nohagim bederech lo tova kemo zemannenu. o sheeno yachol lalechet limdina shemminhagoteha tovim mippene haggeyasot o mippene hacholi yeshev levaddo yechidi kainyan shenneemar <small>(Eicha 3 28)</small> "yeshev badad veyiddom". veim hayu raim vechattaim sheen menichim oto leshev bammedina ella im ken nitarev immahen venoheg beminhagam hara yetze lammearot velachavachim velammidbarot. veal yanhig atzmo bederech chattaim kainyan shenneemar <small>(yirmeya 9 1)</small> "mi yitteneni vammidbar melon orchim":

Mitzvat ase lehiddavek bachachamim vetalmidehem kede lilmod mimmaasehem kainyan shenneemar uvo tidbak. vechi efshar laadam lehiddavek bashshechina. ella kach amru chachamim beferush mitzva zo, hiddavek bachachamim vetalmidehem. lefichach tzarich adam lehishtaddel sheyyissa bat talmid chacham veyassi bitto letalmid chacham veleechol velishtot im talmide chachamim velaasot perakmatya letalmid chacham ulehitchabber lahen bechol mine chibbur shenneemar uledavka bo. vechen tziuu chachamim veamru <small>(mishna avot 1 4)</small> "veheve mitabbek baafar raglehem veshote batztzama et divrehem":

Mitzva al kol adam leehov et kol echad veechad miyyisrael kegufo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 18)</small> "veahavta lereacha kamocha". lefichach tzarich lesapper beshivcho velachus al mamono kaasher hu chas al mamon atzmo verotze bichvod atzmo. vehammitkabbed biklon chavero en lo chelek laolam habba:

Ahavat hagger shebba venichnas tachat kanfe hashshechina shete mitzvot ase. achat mippene shehu bichlal reim veachat mippene shehu ger vehattora amra <small>(Devarim 10 19)</small> "vaahavtem et hagger". tzivva al ahavat hagger kemo shetztzivva al ahavat atzmo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "veahavta et Adonai elohecha". hakkadosh baruch hu atzmo ohev gerim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 10 18)</small> "veohev ger":

Kol hassone echad miyyisrael belibbo over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 17)</small> "lo tisna et achicha bilvavecha". veen lokin al lav ze lefi sheen bo maase. velo hizhira tora ella al sina shebballev. aval hammakke et chavero vehamecharfo af al pi sheeno rashshay eno over mishshum lo tisna:

Kesheyyechta ish leish lo yistemennu veyishtok kemo shenneemar barshaim <small>(Shmuel 2 13 22)</small> "velo dibber avshalom et amnon meuma lemera vead tov ki sane avshalom et amnon". ella mitzva alav lehodio velomar lo lamma asita li kach vechach velamma chatata li bedavar peloni. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 17)</small> "hocheach tochiach et amitecha". veim chazar uvikkesh mimmennu limchol lo tzarich limchol. velo yehe hammochel achzari shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 20 17)</small> "vayyitpallel avraham el haelohim":

Haroe chavero shechata o shehalach bederech lo tova mitzva lehachaziro lammutav ulehodio shehu chote al atzmo bemaasav haraim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 17)</small> "hocheach tochiach et amitecha". hammochiach et chavero. ben bidvarim shebbeno leveno. ben bidvarim shebbeno leven hammakom. tzarich lehochicho beno leven atzmo. vidabber lo benachat uvelashon rakka veyodio sheeno omer lo ella letovato lahavio lechayye haolam habba. im kibbel mimmennu mutav veim lav yochichennu paam sheniyya ushelishit. vechen tamid chayyav adam lehochicho ad sheyyakkehu hachote veyomar lo eni shomea. vechol sheefshar beyado limchot veeno moche hu nitpas baavon ellu kevan sheefshar lo limchot bahem:

Hammochiach et chavero techilla lo yedabber lo kashot ad sheyyachlimennu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 17)</small> "velo tissa alav chet". kach amru chachamim yachol atta mochicho ufanav mishtannot talmud lomar velo tissa alav chet. mikkan sheasur laadam lehachelim et yisrael vechol shekken barabbim. af al pi shehammachlim et chavero eno loke alav avon gadol hu. kach amru chachamim <small>(gemara sanhedrin 107 1)</small> "hammalbin pene chavero barabbim en lo chelek laolam habba". lefichach tzarich adam lehizzaher shello levayyesh chavero barabbim ben katan ben gadol. velo yikra lo beshem shehu bosh mimmennu. velo yesapper lefanav davar shehu bosh mimmennu. bamme devarim amurim bidvarim shebben adam lachavero. aval bedivre shamayim im lo chazar bo basseter machlimin oto barabbim umefarsemim cheto umecharfim oto befanav umevazzin umekallelin oto ad sheyyachazor lammutav kemo sheasu kol hanneviim beyisrael:

Mi shechata alav chavero velo ratza lehochicho velo ledabber lo kelum mippene shehaya hachote hedyot beyoter. o shehayta dato meshubbeshet. umachal lo belibbo velo setamo velo hochicho hare zo middat chasidut. lo hikpida tora ella al hammastema:

Chayyav adam lehizzaher bitomim vealmanot mippene shennafshan shefala limod verucham nemucha af al pi shehen baale mamon. afillu almanato shel melech vitomav muzharim anu alehen shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 21)</small> "kol almana veyatom lo teannun". veheach nohagin immahen. lo yedabber alehem ella rakkot. velo yinhog bahen ella minhag kavod. velo yachiv gufam baavoda velibbam bidvarim kashim. veyachus al mamonam yoter mimmamon atzmo. kol hammaknitan o machisan o hichiv lahen o rada bahen o ibbed mamonan hare ze over belo taase vechol shekken hammakke otam o hamekallelan. velav ze af al pi sheen lokin alav hare ansho meforash battora <small>(Shemot 22 23)</small> "vechara appi veharagti etchem becharev". berit karat lahen mi sheamar vehaya haolam shekkol zeman shehem tzoakim mechamas hem naanim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 22)</small> "ki im tzaok yitzak elay shamoa eshma tzaakato". bamme devarim amurim bizman sheinna otan letzorech atzmo. aval inna otam harav kede lelammedan tora o ummanut o leholichan bederech yeshara hare ze muttar. veaf al pi chen lo yinhog bahen minhag kol adam ella yaase lahem hefresh vinahalem benachat uverachamim gedolim vechavod shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 22 23)</small> "ki Adonai yariv rivam". echad yatom meav veechad yatom meem. vead ematay nikraim yetomim leinyan ze. ad shello yihyu tzerichin leadam gadol lehissamech alav uleamnan ulehittafel bahen ella yihye ose kol tzarche atzmo leatzmo kishar kol haggedolim:
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 7: Hameraggel bachavero over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 16)</small> "lo telech rachil beammecha". veaf al pi sheen lokin al davar ze avon gadol hu vegorem laharog nefashot rabbot miyyisrael. lechach nismach lo <small>(Vayikra 19 16)</small> "velo taamod al dam reecha". tze ulemad ma era ledoeg haadomi:

E zehu rachil. ze shettoen devarim veholech mizze laze veomer kach amar peloni kach vechach shamati al peloni. af al pi shehu emet hare ze machariv et haolam. yesh avon gadol mizze ad meod vehu bichlal lav ze vehu lashon hara. vehu hamesapper bignut chavero af al pi sheomer emet. aval haomer sheker nikra motzi shem ra al chavero. aval baal lashon hara ze sheyyoshev veomer kach vechach asa peloni vechach vechach hayu avotav vechach vechach shamati alav veamar devarim shel genay. al ze amar hakkatuv <small>(Tehillim 12 4)</small> "yachret Adonai kol sifte chalakot lashon medabberet gedolot":

Amru chachamim shalosh averot nifrain min haadam baolam hazze veen lo chelek laolam habba. avodat kochavim vegilluy arayot ushefichut damim. velashon hara keneged kullam. veod amru chachamim kol hamesapper belashon hara keillu kofer baikkar. shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 12 5)</small> "asher amru lilshonenu nagbir sefatenu ittanu mi adon lanu". veod amru chachamim shelosha lashon hara horeget. haomro. vehamekabbelo. veze sheomer alav. vehamekabbelo yoter min haomro:

Veyesh devarim shehen avak lashon hara. ketzad. mi yomar lifloni sheyyihye kemot shehu atta. o sheyyomar shitku mippeloni eni rotze lehodia ma era ume haya. vechayyotze baddevarim haellu. vechol hamesapper betovat chavero bifne sonav hare ze avak lashon hara shezze gorem lahem sheyyesapperu bignuto. veal ze hainyan amar shelomo <small>(Mishlei 27 14)</small> "mevarech reehu bekol gadol babboker hashekem kelala techashev lo". shemmittoch tovato ba lide raato. vechen hamesapper belashon hara derech sechok vederech kallut rosh kelomar sheeno medabber besina. hu sheshshelomo amar bechachmato <small>(Mishlei 26 18)</small> "kemitlahleah hayyore zikkim chitztzim vamavet" <small>(Mishlei 26 19)</small> "veamar halo mesachek ani". vechen hamesapper lashon hara derech rammaut vehu sheyyesapper letummo keillu eno yodea sheddavar ze sheddibber lashon hara hu ella keshemmemachin bo omer eni yodea sheddavar ze lashon hara o sheellu maasav shel peloni:

Echad hamesapper belashon hara bifne chavero o shello befanav, vehamesapper devarim sheggormim im nishmeu ish mippi ish lehazzik chavero begufo o bemamono, vaafillu lehatzer lo o lehafechido, hare ze lashon hara. veim neemru devarim ellu bifne shelosha kevar nishma haddavar venoda. veim sipper haddavar echad min hashshelosha paam acheret en bo mishshum lashon hara. vehu shello yitkavven lehaavir hakkol ulegalloto yoter:
Kol ellu hem baale lashon hara sheasur ladur bishchunatam vechol shekken leshev immahem velishmoa divrehem. velo nechtam gezar din al avotenu bammidbar ella al lashon hara levad:

Hannokem mechavero over belo taase shenneemar lo tikkom. veaf al pi sheeno loke alav dea raa hi ad meod. ella rauy lo laadam lihyot maavir al middotav al kol divre haolam shehakkol etzel hammevinim divre hevel vahavay veenan keday linkom alehem. ketzad hi hannekima. amar lo chavero hasheileni kardumcha, amar lo eni mashilcha. lemachar tzarich lishol mimmennu, amar lo chavero hasheileni kardumcha, amar lo eni mashilcha kederech shello hishaltani kesheshshaalti mimmecha, hare ze nokem. ella kesheyyavo lo lishol yitten belev shalem velo yigmol lo kaasher gemalo. vechen kol kayyotze baellu. vechen amar david bedeotav hattovot <small>(Tehillim 7 5)</small> "im gamalti sholmi ra vaachalletza" vegomer:

Vechen kol hannoter leechad miyyisrael over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 18)</small> "velo tittor et bene ammecha". ketzad hi hannetira. reuven sheamar leshimon haseker li bayit ze o hasheileni shor ze velo ratza shimon. leyamim ba shimon liruven lishol mimmennu o liskor mimmennu veamar lo reuven he lecha hareni mashilcha veeni kemotcha lo ashallem lecha kemaasecha. haose kaze over belo tittor. ella yimche haddavar millibbo velo yitterennu. shekkol zeman shehu noter et haddavar vezochro shemma yavo linkom. lefichach hikpida tora al hannetira ad sheyyimche heavon millibbo velo yizkerennu kelal. vezo hi haddea hannechona sheefshar sheyyitkayyem bah yishshuv haaretz umassaam umattanam shel bene adam ze im ze:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 1:
Nashim vaavadim uketannim peturim mittalmud tora. aval katan aviv chayyav lelammedo tora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 11 19)</small> "velimmadtem otam et benechem ledabber bam". veen haishsha chayyevet lelammed et benah. shekkol hachayyav lilmod chayyav lelammed: 
Keshem shechayyav adam lelammed et beno kach hu chayyav lelammed et ben beno shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 9)</small> "vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha". velo beno uven beno bilvad ella mitzva al kol chacham vechacham miyyisrael lelammed et kol hattalmidim af al pi sheenan banav. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 7)</small> "veshinnantam levanecha" mippi hashshemua lamdu banecha ellu talmidecha shehattalmidim keruyin banim shenneemar <small>(Melachim 2 2 3)</small> "vayyetzu vene hanneviim". im ken lamma nitztavva al beno veal ben beno. lehakedim beno leven beno uven beno leven chavero:
Vechayyav liskor melammed livno lelammedo. veeno chayyav lelammed ben chavero ella bechinnam. mi shello limmedo aviv chayyav lelammed et atzmo kesheyyakkir shenneemar <small>(Devarim 5 1)</small> "ulemadtem otam ushemartem laasotam". vechen atta motze bechol makom shehattalmud kodem lammaase mippene shehattalmud mevi lide maase veen hammaase mevi lide talmud:
Haya hu rotze lilmod tora veyesh lo ben lilmod tora hu kodem livno. veim haya beno navon umaskil lehavin ma sheyyilmod yoter mimmennu beno kodem. veaf al pi shebbeno kodem lo yibbatel hu. shekkeshem shemmitzva alav lelammed et beno kach hu metzuvve lelammed atzmo:
Leolam yilmod adam tora veachar kach yissa ishsha sheim nasa ishsha techilla en dato penuya lilmod. veim haya yitzro mitgabber alav ad shennimtza sheen libbo panuy yissa veachar kach yilmod tora:
Meematay aviv chayyav lelammedo tora. mishsheyyatchil ledabber melammedo <small>(Devarim 33 4)</small> "tora tzivva lanu mshe" u<small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema yisrael", veachar kach melammedo meat meat pesukim pesukim ad sheyyihye ben shesh o ben sheva hakkol lefi buryo. umolicho etzel melammed hattinokot:
Haya minhag hammedina likkach melammed hattinokot sachar noten lo secharo. vechayyav lelammedo besachar ad sheyyikra tora shebbichtav kullah. makom shennahagu lelammed tora shebbichtav besachar muttar lelammed besachar. aval tora shebbeal pe asur lelammedah besachar shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 5)</small> "ree limmadti etchem chukkim umishpatim kaasher tzivvani Adonai" vegomer ma ani bechinnam lamadti af attem lemadtem bechinnam mimmenni vechen keshettelammedu ledorot lammedu bechinnam kemo shellemadtem mimmenni. lo matza mi sheyyelammedo bechinnam yelammedo besachar shenneemar emet kene. yachol yelammed laacherim besachar. talmud lomar <small>(Mishlei 23 23)</small> "veal timkor". ha lamadta sheasur lo lelammed besachar af al pi shellimmedo rabbo besachar:
Kol ish miyyisrael chayyav betalmud tora ben ani ben ashir ben shalem begufo ben baal yissurin ben bachur ben shehaya zaken gadol shettashash kocho afillu haya ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka umechazzer al happetachim vaafillu baal ishsha uvanim chayyav likboa lo zeman letalmud tora bayyom uvallayla shenneemar <small>(Yehoshua 1 8)</small> "vehagita bo yomam valayla":
Gedole chachme yisrael hayu mehen chotve etzim umehen shoave mayim umehen sumim veaf al pi chen hayu oskin betalmud tora bayyom uvallayla vehem mikkelal matike hashshemua ish mippi ish mippi moshe rabbenu:
Ad ematay chayyav lilmod tora ad yom moto shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 9)</small> "ufen yasuru millevavcha kol yeme chayyecha". vechol zeman shello yaasok belimmud hu shocheach:
Vechayyav leshallesh et zeman lemidato. shelish battora shebbichtav. ushelish battora shebbeal pe. ushelish yavin veyaskil acharit davar mereshito veyotzi davar middavar vidamme davar ledavar veyavin bammiddot shehattora nidreshet bahen ad sheyyeda heach hu ikkar hammiddot veheach yotzi haasur vehammuttar vechayyotze bahen middevarim shellamad mippi hashshemua. veinyan ze hu hannikra gemara:
Ketzad. haya baal ummanut vehaya osek bimlachto shalosh shaot bayyom uvattora tesha. otan hattesha kore beshalosh mehen battora shebbichtav uveshalosh battora shebbeal pe uveshalosh acherot mitbonen bedato lehavin davar middavar. vedivre kabbala bichlal tora shebbichtav hen uferushan bichlal tora shebbeal pe. vehainyanim hannikraim pardes bichlal haggemara hen. bamme devarim amurim bitchillat talmudo shel adam aval kesheyyagdil bechachma velo yehe tzarich lo lilmod tora shebbichtav velo laasok tamid battora shebbeal pe yikra beittim mezummanim tora shebbichtav vedivre hashshemua kede shello yishkach davar middivre dine tora veyifne kol yamav laggemara bilvad lefi rochav sheyyesh belibbo veyishshuv dato:
Ishsha shellamda tora yesh lah sachar aval eno kischar haish. mippene shello nitztavvet. vechol haose davar sheeno metzuvve alav laasoto en secharo kischar hametzuvve sheasa ella pachot mimmennu. veaf al pi sheyyesh lah sachar tziuu chachamim shello yelammed adam et bitto tora. mippene sherov hannashim en datam mechuvvenet lehitlammed ella hen motziot divre tora ledivre havay lefi aniyyut datan. amru chachamim kol hamelammed et bitto tora keillu limmedah tiflut. bamme devarim amurim betora shebbeal pe aval tora shebbichtav lo yelammed otah lechattechilla veim limmedah eno kimlammedah tiflut:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 2: Moshivin melammede tinokot bechol medina umedina uvechol pelech ufelech uvechol ir vair. vechol ir sheen bah tinokot shel bet rabban machrimin et anshe hair ad shemmoshivin melammede tinokot. veim lo hoshivu machrimin et hair. sheen haolam mitkayyem ella behevel pihem shel tinokot shel bet rabban:

Machnisin et hattinokot lehitlammed keven shesh keven sheva lefi koach habben uvinyan gufo. ufachot mibben shesh en machnisim oto. umakke otan hamelammed lehattil alehem ema. veeno makke otam makkat oyev makkat achzari. lefichach lo yakke otam beshotim velo bemaklot ella birtzua ketanna. veyoshev umelammedan kol hayyom kullo umiktzat min hallayla kede lechannechan lilmod bayyom uvallayla. velo yibbatlu hattinokot kelal chutz mearve shabbatot veyamim tovim besof hayyamim uveyamim tovim. aval beshabbat en korin battechilla aval shonin barishon. veen mevattelin hattinokot vaafillu levinyan bet hammikdash:

Melammed hattinokot shehu meniach hattinokot veyotze o shehu ose melacha acheret immahen o shehu mitrashshel belimmudan hare ze bichlal <small>(yirmeya moach 10)</small> "arur ose melechet Adonai remiyya". lefichach en rauy lehoshiv melammed ella baal yira mahir likrot uledakdek:
Umi sheen lo ishsha lo yelammed tinokot mippene immotehem habbaot etzel benehem. vechol ishsha lo telammed tinokot mippene avotehem shehem baim etzel habbanim:

Esrim vachamishsha tinokot lemedim etzel melammed echad. hayu yoter al esrim vachamishsha ad arbaim moshivin immo acher lesayyeo belimmudam. hayu yoter al arbaim maamidin lahem shene melammede tinokot:

Molichin et hakkatan mimmelammed limlammed acher shehu mahir mimmennu ben bemikra ben bedikduk. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu shenehem beir achat velo haya hannahar mafsik benehem. aval meir leir o mitztzad hannahar letziddo afillu beotah hair en molichin et hakkatan ella im ken haya binyan bari al gabbe hannahar binyan sheeno rauy lippol bimhera:

Echad mibbene mavoy shebbikkesh leheasot melammed, afillu echad mibbene hechatzer, en yecholin shechenav limchot beyado. vechen melammed tinokot shebba chavero ufatach bayit lelammed tinokot betziddo kede sheyyavou tinokot acherim lo o kede sheyyavou mittinokot shel ze etzel ze, eno yachol limchot beyado, shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 42 21)</small> "Adonai chafetz lemaan tzidko yagdil tora veyadir":
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 3: Bishlosha ketarim nichteru yisrael. keter tora vecheter kehunna vecheter malchut. keter kehunna zacha bo aharon shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 25 13)</small> "vehayta lo ulezaro acharav berit kehunnat olam". keter malchut zacha bo david shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 89 37)</small> "zaro leolam yihye vechiso chashshemesh negdi". keter tora hare munnach veomed umuchan lechol yisrael. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 33 4)</small> "tora tzivva lanu moshe morasha kehillat yaakov". kol mi sheyyirtze yavo veyittol. shemma tomar sheotam hakketarim gedolim mikketer tora. hare hu omer <small>(Mishlei 8 15)</small> "bi melachim yimlochu veroznim yechokku tzedek" <small>(Mishlei 8 16)</small> "bi sarim yasoru". ha lamadta shekketer tora gadol mishshenehem:
Amru chachamim mamzer talmid chacham kodem lechohen gadol am haaretz shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 3 15)</small> "yekara hi mippeninim". mikkohen gadol shennichnas lifnay velifnim:
En lecha mitzva bechol hammitzvot kullan shehi shekula keneged talmud tora ella talmud tora keneged kol hammitzvot kullan shehattalmud mevi lide maase. lefichach hattalmud kodem lemaase bechol makom:
Haya lefanav asiyyat mitzva vetalmud tora. im efshar lammitzva leheasot al yede acherim lo yafsik talmudo. veim lav yaase hammitzva veyachazor letalmudo:

Techillat dino shel adam eno niddon ella al hattalmud veachar kach al shear maasav. lefichach amru chachamim leolam yaasok adam battora ben lishmah ben shello lishmah shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah:

Mi shennesao libbo lekayyem mitzva zo karauy velihyot muchtar becheter tora. lo yassiach dato lidvarim acherim. velo yasim al libbo sheyyikne tora im haosher vehakkavod keachat. <small>(mishna avot 6 4)</small> "kach hi darkah shel tora. pat bammelach tochal umayim bammesura tishte veal haaretz tishan vechayye tzaar tichye uvattora atta amel". velo alecha haddavar ligmor velo atta ben chorin libbatel mimmenna. veim hirbeta tora hirbeta sachar. vehassachar lefi hatztzaar:

Shemma tomar ad sheakabbetz mamon echezor veekra. ad sheekne ma sheani tzarich veeppane measakay veechezor veekra. im taale machashava zo al libbecha en atta zoche lechitrah shel tora leolam. ella ase toratcha keva umelachtecha aray <small>(mishna avot 2 4)</small> velo tomar "lichsheeppane eshne shemma lo tippane":

Katuv battora <small>(gemara eruvin noah 1)</small> "lo vashshamayim hi velo meever layyam hi". lo vashshamayim hi lo begasse haruach hi metzuya velo bimhalleche meever layyam hi. lefichach amru chachamim <small>(mishna avot 2 5)</small> "lo kol hammarbe bischora machkim". vetziuu chachamim heve memaet beesek vaasok battora:

Divre tora nimshelu kammayim shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noah 1)</small> "hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim". lomar lecha ma mayim enam mitkannesin bimkom midron ella nizchalin mealav umitkabbetzim bimkom ashboren kach divre tora enam nimtzaim begasse haruach velo belev kol geva lev ella bedakka ushefal ruach shemmitabbek baafar ragle hachachamim umesir hattaavot vetaanuge hazzeman millibbo veose melacha bechol yom meat kede chayyav im lo haya lo ma yochal ushear yomo velelo osek battora:

Kol hammesim al libbo sheyyaasok battora velo yaase melacha veyitparnes min hatztzedaka hare ze chillel et hashshem uvizza et hattora vechibba meor haddat vegaram raa leatzmo venatal chayyav min haolam habba. lefi sheasur lehanot middivre tora baolam hazze. amru chachamim <small>(mishna avot 4 5)</small> "kol hannehene middivre tora natal chayyav min haolam". veod tziuu veamru <small>(mishna avot 4 5)</small> "al taasem atara lehitgaddel bahen velo kardom lachpor bahen". veod tziuu veamru <small>(mishna avot 1 10)</small> "ehov et hammelacha usena et harabbanut", <small>(mishna avot 2 2)</small> "vechol tora sheen immah melacha sofah betela vegoreret avon". vesof adam ze sheyyehe melastem et habberiyyot:

Maala gedola hi lemi shehu mitparnes mimmaase yadav. umiddat chasidim harishonim hi. uvaze zoche lechol kavod vetova shebbaolam hazze velaolam habba shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 128 2)</small> "yegia kappecha ki tochel ashrecha vetov lach" <small>(mishna avot 6 4)</small> "ashrecha baolam hazze vetov lach laolam habba" shekkullo tov:

En divre tora mitkayyemin bemi shemmarpe atzmo alehen. velo beellu shellomdin mittoch iddun umittoch achila ushetiyya. ella bemi shemmemit atzmo alehen umetzaer gufo tamid velo yitten shena leenav uleafappav tenuma. amru chachamim derech remez <small>(Bamidbar 19 14)</small> "zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel" en hattora mitkayyemet ella bemi shemmemit atzmo beohole hachachamim. vechen amar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Mishlei 24 10)</small> "hitrappita beyom tzara tzar kochecha". veod amar <small>(Kohelet 2 9)</small> "af chachmati amda li" chachma shellamadti beaf hi amda li. amru chachamim berit keruta shekkol hayyagea betorato bevet hammidrash lo bimhera hu meshakkeach. vechol hayyagea betalmudo betzina machkim shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 11 2)</small> "veet tzenuim chachma". vechol hammashmia kolo bishat talmudo talmudo mitkayyem beyado. aval hakkore belachash bimhera hu shocheach:

Af al pi shemmitzva lilmod bayyom uvallayla en adam lamed rov chachmato ella ballayla. lefichach mi sheratza lizkot becheter hattora yizzaher bechol lelotav velo yeabbed afillu echad mehen beshena vaachila ushetiyya vesicha vechayyotze bahen ella betalmud tora vedivre chachma. amru chachamim en rinna shel tora ella ballayla shenneemar <small>(Eicha 2 19)</small> "kumi ronni vallayla". vechol haosek battora ballayla chut shel chesed nimshach alav bayyom shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 42 9)</small> "yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi tefilla leel chayyay". vechol bayit sheen nishmaim bo divre tora ballayla esh ochalto shenneemar <small>(Iyov 20 26)</small> "kol choshech tamun litzpunav teachlehu esh lo nuppach". <small>(Bamidbar 15 lo)</small> "ki devar Adonai baza" ze shello hishgiach al divre tora kol ikkar. vechen kol sheefshar lo laasok battora veeno osek o shekkara veshana uferash lehavele olam veheniach talmudo uzenacho hare ze bichlal boze devar Adonai. amru chachamim kol hamevattel et hattora meosher sofo levattelah meoni vechol hamekayyem et hattora meoni sofo lekayyemah meosher. veinyan ze meforash hu battora, hare hu omer <small>(Devarim 28 47)</small> "tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai elohecha besimcha uvetuv levav merov kl" <small>(Devarim 28 48)</small> "veavadta et oyvecha". veomer <small>(Devarim 8 2)</small> "lemaan annotcha" <small>(Devarim 8 16)</small> "lehetivcha beacharitecha":
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 4: En melammedin tora ella letalmid hagun nae bemaasav. o letam. aval im haya holech bederech lo tova machzirin oto lammutav umanhigin oto bederech yeshara uvodkin oto veachar kach machnisin oto levet hammidrash umelammedin oto. amru chachamim kol hashshone letalmid sheeno hagun keillu zarak even lemarkulis shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 26 8)</small> "kitzror even bemargema ken noten lichsil kavod". veen kavod ella tora shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 3 la)</small> "kavod chachamim yinchalu". vechen harav sheeno holech bederech tova af al pi shechacham gadol hu vechol haam tzerichin lo en mitlammedin mimmennu ad shuvo lammutav. shenneemar <small>(Malachi 2 7)</small> "ki sifte chohen yishmeru daat vetora yevakshu mippihu ki malach Adonai tzevaot hu". amru chachamim im harav dome lemalach Adonai tzevaot tora yevakkeshu mippihu im lav al yevakkeshu tora mippihu:

Ketzad melammedim. harav yoshev barosh vehattalmidim mukkafim lefanav kaatara kede sheyyehu kullam roim harav veshomim devarav. velo yeshev harav al hakkisse vetalmidav al hakkarka ella o hakkol al haaretz o hakkol al hakkisot. uvarishona haya harav yoshev vehattalmidim omdim umikkodem churban bayit sheni nahagu hakkol lelammed lattalmidim vehem yoshvim:

Im haya melammed mippiv lattalmidim melammed. veim haya melammed al pi metargem [hametargem] omed beno uven hattalmidim veharav omer lamtargem vehametargem mashmia lechol hattalmidim. ucheshehem shoalin lamtargem hu shoel larav veharav meshiv lamtargem vehametargem meshiv lashshoel. velo yagbiah harav kolo yoter mikkol hametargem. velo yagbiah hametargem kolo beet sheshshoel et harav yoter mikkol harav. en hametargem rashshay lo lifchot velo lehosif velo leshannot ella im ken haya hameturgeman aviv shel chacham o rabbo. omer harav lamturgeman kach amar li rabbi o kach amar li abba mari. uchesheomer hameturgeman haddevarim laam omer beshem hechacham umazkir shemo shel avi harav o shel rabbo veomer kach amar rabbana peloni af al pi shello hizkir harav shemo shel chacham. sheasur likrot lerabbo o leaviv bishmo:

Harav shellimmed velo hevinu hattalmidim lo yichos alehem veyirgaz ella chozer veshone haddavar afillu kamma peamim ad sheyyavinu omek hahalacha. vechen lo yomar hattalmid hevanti vehu lo hevin ella chozer veshoel afillu kamma peamim. veim kaas alav rabbo veragaz yomar lo rabbi tora hi velilmod ani tzarich vedati ketzara:

Lo yihye hattalmid bosh mechaverav shellamdu mippaam rishona o sheniyya vehu lo lamad ella achar kamma peamim. sheim nitbayyesh middavar ze nimtza nichnas veyotze levet hammidrash vehu eno lamed kelum. lefichach amru chachamim harishonim en habbayshan lamed velo hakkappedan melammed. bamme devarim amurim bizman shello hevinu hattalmidim haddavar mippene amko o mippene datan shehi ketzara. aval im nikkar larav shehem mitrashshelin bedivre tora umitrappin alehen ulefichach lo hevinu chayyav lirgoz alehen ulehachliman bidvarim kede lechaddedam. ucheinyan ze amru chachamim zerok mara battalmidim. lefichach en rauy larav linhog kallut rosh lifne hattalmidim velo lischok bifnehem velo leechol velishtot immahem kede shettehe emato alehen veyilmedu mimmennu bimhera:

En shoalin et harav kesheyyikkanes lammidrash ad shettityashshev dato alav. veen hattalmid shoel kesheyyikkanes ad sheyyityashshev veyanuach. veen shoalin shenayim keechad. veen shoalin et harav meinyan acher ella meoto hainyan shehen asukin bo kede shello yitbayyesh. veyesh larav lehateot et hattalmidim bishelotav uvammaasim sheose bifnehem kede lechaddedan. uchede sheyyeda im zochrim hem ma shellimmedam o enam zochrim. veen tzarich lomar sheyyesh lo reshut lishl otam beinyan acher sheen oskin bo kede lezarzam:

En shoalin meummad veen meshivin meummad velo miggavoah velo merachok velo meachore hazzekenim. veen shoalin harav ella beinyan shehen korin bo. veen shoalin ella miyyira. velo yishal bainyan yoter mishshalosh halachot:

Shenayim sheshshaalu. shaal echad kainyan veshaal echad shello kainyan nizkakin lainyan. maase vesheeno maase nizkakin lammaase. halacha umidrash nizkakin lahalacha. midrash veaggada nizkakin lammidrash. aggada vekal vachomer nizkakin lakkal vachomer. kal vachomer ugezera shava nizkakin lakkal vachomer. hayu hashshoalin shenayim echad chacham veechad talmid nizkakin lechacham. talmid veam haaretz nizkakin lattalmid. shenehem chachamim shenehem talmidim shenehem amme haaretz shaalu shenehem bishte halachot o bishte teshuvot o bishte sheelot shene maasim. harshut beyad hametargem meatta:

En yeshenim bevet hammidrash vechol hammitnamnem bevet hammidrash chachmato naaset keraim keraim. vechen amar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Mishlei 23 21)</small> "ukeraim talbish numa". veen mesichin bevet hammidrash ella bedivre tora bilvad. afillu mi shennitattesh en omrim lo refua bevet hammidrash veen tzarich lomar shear haddevarim. ukedushshat bet hammidrash chamura mikkedushshat batte kenesiyyot:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 5:
Keshem sheadam metzuvve bichvod aviv veyirato kach hu chayyav bichvod rabbo veyirato yeter meaviv. sheaviv mevio lechayye haolam hazze verabbo shellimmedo chachma mevio lechayye haolam habba. raa avedat aviv vaavedat rabbo shel rabbo kodemet leshel aviv. aviv verabbo nosim bemassa meniach et shel rabbo veachar kach shel aviv. aviv verabbo shevuyim bashshivya pode et rabbo veachar kach pode et aviv. veim haya aviv talmid chacham pode et aviv techilla. vechen im haya aviv talmid chacham af al pi sheeno shakul keneged rabbo meshiv avedato veachar kach meshiv avedat rabbo. veen lecha kavod gadol mikkevod harav velo mora mimmora harav. amru chachamim <small>(mishna avot 4 12)</small> "mora rabbach kemora shamayim". lefichach amru kol hacholek al rabbo kecholek al hashshechina shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 26 9)</small> "behatztzotam al Adonai". vechol haose meriva im rabbo keose meriva im hashshechina shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 20 13)</small> "asher ravu vene yisrael et Adonai vayyikkadesh bam". vechol hammitraem al rabbo kemitraem al Adonai shenneemar <small>(Shemot 16 8)</small> "lo alenu telunotechem ki al Adonai". vechol hameharher achar rabbo keillu mehareher achar shechina shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 21 5)</small> "vaydabber haam belohim uvemshe":
Ezehu cholek al rabbo. ze shekkovea lo midrash veyoshev vedoresh umelammed shello birshut rabbo verabbo kayyam veaf al pi sherabbo bimdina acheret. veasur laadam lehorot bifne rabbo leolam. vechol hammore halacha bifne rabbo chayyav mita:
Haya beno uven rabbo shenem asar mil veshaal lo adam devar halacha muttar lehashiv. ulehafrish min haissur afillu bifne rabbo muttar lehorot. ketzad. kegon sheraa adam ose davar haasur mippene shello yada beissuro o mippene risho yesh lo lehaferisho velomar lo davar ze asur vaafillu bifne rabbo veaf al pi shello natan lo rabbo reshut. shekkol makom sheyyesh chillul hashshem en cholkin kavod larav. bamme devarim amurim. bedavar shennikra mikre. aval likboa atzmo lehoraa veleshev ulehorot lechol shoel afillu hu besof haolam verabbo besof haolam asur lo lehorot ad sheyyamut rabbo ella im ken natal reshut merabbo. velo kol mi shemmet rabbo muttar lo leshev ulehorot battora. ella im ken haya talmid shehiggia lehoraa:
Vechol talmid shello higgia lehoraa umore hare ze rasha shote vegas haruach. vealav neemar <small>(Mishlei 7 26)</small> "ki rabbim chalalim hippila" vegomer. vechen chacham shehiggia lehoraa veeno more hare ze monea tora venoten michsholot lifne haivverim vealav neemar <small>(Mishlei 7 26)</small> "vaatzumim kol harugeha". ellu hattalmidim hakketannim shello hirbu tora karauy vehem mevakkeshim lehitgaddel bifne amme haaretz uven anshe iram vekoftzin veyoshvin barosh ledin ulehorot beyisrael hem hammarbim hammachaloket vehem hammacharivim et haolam vehamechabbin nerah shel tora vehamechabbelim kerem Adonai tzevaot. alehem amar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Shir HaShirim 2 15)</small> "echezu lanu shualim shualim ketannim mechabbelim keramim":
Veasur lo letalmid likrot lerabbo bishmo vaafillu shello befanav. vehu sheyyihye hashshem peli shekkol hashshomea yeda shehu peloni. velo yazkir shemo befanav vaafillu likrot laacherim sheshshemam keshem rabbo kederech sheose beshem aviv. ella yeshanne et shemam afillu leachar motam. velo yitten shalom lerabbo o yachazir lo shalom kederech shennotnim lereim umachazirim ze laze. ella shoche lefanav veomer lo beyira vechavod shalom alecha rabbi. veim natan lo rabbo shalom yachazir lo shalom alecha rabbi umori:
Vechen lo yachalotz tefillav lifne rabbo. velo yasev ella yoshev keyoshev lifne hammelech. velo yitpallel lo lifne rabbo velo leachar rabbo velo betzad rabbo. veen tzarich lomar sheasur lo lehallech betziddo. ella yitrachek leachar rabbo velo yehe mechavven keneged achorav veachar kach yitpallel. velo yikkanes im rabbo bammerchatz. velo yeshev bimkom rabbo. velo yachria devarav befanav. velo yistor et devarav. velo yeshev lefanav ad sheyyomar lo shev. velo yaamod millefanav ad sheyyomar lo amod o ad sheyyittol reshut laamod. uchesheyyippater merabbo lo yachazor lo laachorav ella nirta laachorav ufanav keneged panav:
Vechayyav laamod mippene rabbo mishsheyyirennu merachok melo enav ad sheyyitkasse mimmennu velo yire komato veachar kach yeshev. vechayyav adam lehakebil pene rabbo baregel:
En cholkin kavod letalmid bifne rabbo ella im ken derech rabbo lachalok lo kavod. vechol hammelachot shehaeved ose lerabbo talmid ose lerabbo. veim haya bemakom sheen makkirin oto velo hayu lo tefillin vechash shemma yomru eved hu eno noel lo minalo veeno choltzo. vechol hammonea talmido milleshammesho monea mimmennu chesed uforek mimmennu yirat shamayim. vechol talmid shemmezalzel davar mikkol kevod rabbo gorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael:
Raa rabbo over al divre tora omer lo limmadtanu rabbenu kach vechach. vechol zeman shemmazkir shemua befanav omer lo kach limmadtanu rabbenu. veal yomar davar shello shama merabbo ad sheyyazkir shem omro. uchesheyyamut rabbo korea kol begadav ad shehu megalle et libbo veeno meache leolam. bamme devarim amurim berabbo muvhak shellamad mimmennu rov chachmato. aval im lo lamad mimmennu rov chachmato hare ze talmid chaver veeno chayyav bichvodo bechol ellu haddevarim. aval omed millefanav vekorea alav keshem shehu korea al kol hammetim shehu mitabbel alehem. afillu lo lamad mimmennu ella davar echad ben katan ben gadol omed millefanav vekorea alav:
Vechol talmid chacham sheddeotav mechuvvanot eno medabber bifne mi shehu gadol mimmennu bechachma af al pi shello lamad mimmennu kelum:
Harav hammuvhak sheratza limchol al kevodo bechol haddevarim haellu o beechad mehen lechol talmidav o leechad mehen harshut beyado. veaf al pi shemmachal chayyav hattalmid lehaddero vaafillu beshaa shemmachal:
Keshem shehattalmidim chayyavin bichvod harav kach harav tzarich lechabbed et talmidav ulekarvan. kach amru chachamim <small>(mishna avot 4 12)</small> "yehi kevod talmidcha chaviv alecha keshellecha". vetzarich adam lehizzaher betalmidav uleohovam shehem habbanim hamehannim laolam hazze velaolam habba:
Hattalmidim mosifin chachmat harav umarchivin libbo. amru chachamim harebe chachma lamadti merabbotay veyoter mechaveray umittalmiday yoter mikkullam. ucheshem sheetz katan madlik et haggadol kach talmid katan mechadded harav ad sheyyotzi mimmennu bishelotav chachma mefoara:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 6: Kol talmid chacham mitzva lehaddero veaf al pi sheeno rabbo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 32)</small> "mippene seva takum vehadarta pene zaken". zaken ze shekkana chachma. umeematay chayyavin laamod mippanav. mishsheyyikrav mimmennu bearba ammot ad sheyyaavor mikkeneged panav:

En omdin mippanav lo bevet hammerchatz velo bevet hakkisse shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 32)</small> "takum vehadarta" kima sheyyesh bah hiddur. veen baale ummanuyyot chayyavin laamod mippene talmide chachamim beshaa sheoskin bimlachtan shenneemar takum vehadarta ma hiddur sheen bah chesron kis af kima sheen bah chesron kis. uminnayin shello yaatzim enav min hechacham kede shello yirehu ad shello yaamod mippanav. shenneemar veyareta meelohecha. ha kol davar shehu masur lallev neemar bo veyareta meelohecha:

En rauy lechacham sheyyatriach et haam vichavven atzmo lahen kede sheyyaamdu mippanav ella yelech bederech ketzara umitkavven shello yiru oto kede shello yatrichen laamod. vehachachamim hayu makkifin veholchin bederech hachitzona sheen makkirehen metzuyin sham kede shello yatrichum:
Rochev hare hu kimhallech ucheshem sheomdim mippene hamehallech kach omdin mippene harochev:
Shelosha shehayu holchin badderech. harav baemtza gadol mimino vekatan missemolo:

Haroe chacham eno omed mippanav ad sheyyaggia lo learba ammot. vechevan sheavar yoshev. raa av bet din omed millefanav mishsheyyirennu merachok melo enav veeno yoshev ad sheyyaavor meacharav arba ammot. raa et hannasi omed millefanav melo enav veeno yoshev ad sheyyeshev bimkomo o ad sheyyitkasse meenav. vehannasi shemmachal al kevodo kevodo machul. keshehannasi nichnas kol haam omdim veenan yoshvin ad sheyyomar lahem shevu. kesheav bet din nichnas osin lo shete shurot veomdin mikkan umikkan ad shennichnas veyoshev bimkomo ushear haam yoshvin bimkoman:

Chacham shennichnas kol sheyyaggia lo bearba ammot omed millefanav echad omed veechad yoshev ad shennichnas veyoshev bimkomo. bene chachamim vetalmide chachamim bizman sheharabbim tzerichin lahem mekappetzin al rashe haam venichnasim limkomam. veen shevach letalmide chachamim sheyyikkansu laacharona. yatza letzorech chozer limkomo. bene chachamim bizman sheyyesh bahen daat lishmoa hofchin penehen kelappe avihen. en bahen daat lishmoa hofchin penehen kelappe haam:
Talmid shehu yoshev lifne rabbo tamid eno rashshay laamod mippanav ella shacharit vearvit bilvad shello yehe kevodo merubbe mikkevod shamayim:

Mi shehu zaken muflag bezikna af al pi sheeno chacham omdin lefanav. vaafillu hechacham shehu yeled omed bifne hazzaken hammuflag bezikna. veeno chayyav laamod melo komato ella kede lehaddero. vaafillu zaken kuti mehadderin oto bidvarim venotnin lo yad lesamcho shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 32)</small> "mippene seva takum" kol seva bemashma:

Talmide chachamim enam yotzin beatzman laasot im kol hakkahal bevinyan vachafira shel medina vechayyotze bahen kede shello yitbazzu bifne amme haaretz. veen govin mehen levinyan hachoma vetikkun hashshearim usechar hashshomrim vechayyotze bahen velo litshurat hammelech. veen mechayyevim otan litten hammas ben mas shehu katzuv al bene hair ben mas shehu katzuv al kol ish vaish shenneemar <small>(Hoshea 8 10)</small> "gam ki yitnu vaggoyim atta akabbetzem vayyachellu meat mimmassa melech vesarim". vechen im hayta sechora letalmid chacham menichim oto limkor techilla veen menichim echad mibbene hashshuk limkor ad sheyyimkor hu. vechen im haya lo din vehaya omed bichlal baale dinim harebe makdimin oto umoshivin oto:

Avon gadol hu levazzot et hachachamim o lisnotan. lo charva yerushalayim ad shebbizzu bah talmide chachamim shenneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 2 36 16)</small> "vayyihyu malivim bemalache haelohim uvozim devarav umittateim binviav". kelomar bozim melammede devarav. vechen ze sheamra tora <small>(Vayikra 26 15)</small> "im bechukkotay timasu", melammede chukkotay timasu. vechol hamevazze et hachachamim en lo chelek laolam habba vahare hu bichlal <small>(Bamidbar 15 lo)</small> "ki devar Adonai baza":

Af al pi shehamevazze et hachachamim en lo chelek laolam habba, im bau edim shebbizzahu afillu bidvarim chayyav nidduy, umenaddin oto bet din barabbim vekonsin oto litra zahav bechol makom venotnin otah lechacham. vehamevazze et hechacham bidvarim afillu leachar mita menaddin oto bet din vehem mattirim oto kesheyyachazor bitshuva. aval im haya hechacham chay en mattirin oto ad sheyyeratztze ze shennidduhu bishvilo. vechen hechacham atzmo menadde lichvodo leam haaretz shehifkir bo veen tzarich lo edim velo hateraa. veen mattirin lo ad sheyyeratztze et hechacham. veim met hechacham bain shelosha umattirin lo. veim ratza hechacham limchol lo velo niddahu harshut beyado:

Harav shennidda lichvodo kol talmidav chayyavin linhog nidduy bamnudde. aval talmid shennidda lichvod atzmo en harav chayyav linhog bo nidduy. aval kol haam chayyavin linhog bo nidduy. vechen menudde lenasi menudde lechol yisrael. menudde lechol yisrael eno menudde lannasi. menudde leiro menudde leir acheret. menudde leir acheret eno menudde leiro:

Bamme devarim amurim bemi shennidduhu al shebbizza talmide chachamim. aval mi shennidduhu al shear devarim shechayyavim alehem nidduy afillu niddahu katan shebbeyisrael chayyav hannasi vechol yisrael linhog bo nidduy ad sheyyachazor bitshuva middavar shennidduhu bishvilo veyattiru lo. al esrim vearbaa devarim menaddin et haadam ben ish ben ishsha. veellu hen: 1) hamevazze et hechacham vaafillu leachar moto. 2) hamevazze sheliach bet din. 3) hakkore lachavero eved. 4) mi sheshshalchu lo bet din vekavu lo zeman velo ba. 5) hamezalzel bedavar echad middivre sofrim veen tzarich lomar bedivre tora. 6) mi shello kibbel alav et haddin menaddin oto ad sheyyitten. 7) mi sheyyesh birshuto davar hammazzik kegon kelev ra o sullam raua menaddin oto ad sheyyasir hezzeko. 8) hammocher karka shello leoved kochavim menaddin oto ad sheyyekabbel alav kol ones sheyyavo min haoved kochavim leyisrael chavero baal hammetzar. 9) hammeid al yisrael bearkaot shel ovde kochavim vehotzi mimmennu beeduto mamon shello kedin yisrael, menaddin oto ad sheyyeshallem. 10) tabbach kohen sheeno mafrish hammattanot venotnan lechohen acher menaddin oto ad sheyyitten. 11) hamechallel yom tov sheni shel galuyyot af al pi shehu minhag. 12) haose melacha beerev happesach achar chatzot. 13) hammazkir shem shamayim levattala o lishvua bedivre havay. yad) hammevi et harabbim lide chillul hashshem. 15) hammevi et harabbim lide achilat kadashim bachutz. 16) hamechashshev shanim vekovea chodashim bechutza laaretz. 17) hammachishil et haivver. 18) hameakkev harabbim millaasot mitzva. 19) tabbach sheyyatza terefa mittachat yado. 20) tabbach shello badak sakkino lifne chacham. ka) hammakshe atzmo ledaat. 22) mi sheggeresh et ishto veasa beno uvenah shuttafut o massa umattan hammeviin lahen lehizzakek ze laze kesheyyavou levet din menaddin otam. 23) chacham sheshshemuato raa. kad) hamenadde mi sheeno chayyav nidduy:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 7: Chacham zaken bechachma vechen nasi o av bet din shessarach en menaddin oto befarhesya leolam. ella im ken asa keyaravam ben nevat vachaverav. aval keshechata shear chattaot malkin oto betzina. shenneemar <small>(Hoshea 4 5)</small> "vechashalta hayyom vechashal gam navi immecha layla" af al pi shekkashal kassehu kelayla. veomrim lo hikkaved veshev bevetcha. vechen kol talmid chacham shennitchayyev nidduy asur levet din likpotz ulenaddoto bimhera ella borchin middavar ze venishmatin mimmennu. vachaside hachachamim hayu mishtabbechim shello nimnu meolam lenaddot talmid chacham af al pi shennimnin lehalekoto im nitchayyev malkot. vaafillu makkat mardut nimnin alav lehakkoto:
Vechetzad hu hannidduy, omer peloni yehe beshammata. veim nidduhu befanav omer lo peloni ze beshammata. vehacherem, omer lo peloni muchram. vearur bo ala bo shevua bo nidduy:
Vechetzad mattirin hannidduy o hacherem. omer lo sharuy lecha umachul lecha. veim hittiruhu shello befanav omer lo peloni sharuy lo umachul lo:

Mahu hamminhag sheyyinhog hamenudde beatzmo veshennohagin immo. menudde asur lesapper ulechabbes keavel kol yeme nidduyo. veen mezammenin alav. velo kollin oto baasara lechol davar shetztzarich asara. velo yoshvin immo bearba ammot. aval shone hu laacherim veshonin lo veniskar vesocher. veim met benidduy bet din sholchin umannichin even al arono kelomar shehen rogmin oto lefi shehu muvdal min hatztzibbur. veen tzarich lomar sheen maspidin oto veen melavvin et mittato:

Yoter alav hammuchram sheeno shone laacherim veen shonin lo aval shone hu leatzmo shello yishkach talmudo. veeno niskar veen niskarin lo. veen nosin venotnin immo. veen mitassekin immo ella meat esek kede parnasato:
Mi sheyyashav benidduy sheloshim yom velo bikkesh lehattiro menaddin oto sheniyya. yashav sheloshim yom acherim velo bikkesh lehattiro machrimin oto:
Bechamma mattirin hannidduy o hacherem. bishlosha afillu hedyotot. veyachid mumche mattir hannidduy o hacherem levaddo. veyesh letalmid lehattir hannidduy o hacherem vaafillu bimkom harav:
Shelosha shenniddu vehalchu lahen vechazar ze middavar shennidduhu biglalo bain shelosha acherim umattirin lo:
Mi shello yada mi shenniddahu yelech lo etzel hannasi veyattir lo nidduyo:
Nidduy al tenay afillu al pi atzmo tzarich hafara. talmid chacham shennidda atzmo vaafillu nidda atzmo al daat peloni vaafillu al davar shechayyav alav nidduy hare ze mefer leatzmo:

Mi shennidduhu bachalom afillu yada mi niddahu tzarich asara bene adam sheshshonin halachot lehattiro minnidduyo. veim lo matza toreach acharehem ad parsa. lo matza mattirim lo afillu asara sheshshonim mishna. lo matza mattirin lo asara sheyyodim likrot battora. lo matza mattirin lo afillu asara sheenan yodin likrot. lo matza bimkomo asara mattirin lo afillu shelosha:

Mi shennidduhu befanav en mattirin lo ella befanav. nidduhu shello befanav mattirin lo befanav veshello befanav. veen ben nidduy lahafara kelum ella menaddin umattirin berega echad kesheyyachazor hamenudde lammutav. veim rau bet din lehanniach ze benidduy kamma shanim mannichin kefi risho. vechen im rau bet din lehacharim laze lechattechilla ulehacharim mi sheyyochal immo veshote immo o mi sheyyaamod immo bearba ammot machrimin kede leyassero uchede laasot seyag lattora ad shello yifretzu hachotim. af al pi sheyyesh reshut lechacham lenaddot lichvodo eno shevach letalmid chacham lehanehig atzmo bedavar ze ella maalim aznav middivre am haaretz velo yashit libbo lahen kainyan sheamar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Kohelet 7 21)</small> "gam lechol haddevarim asher yedabberu al titten libbecha". vechen haya derech chasidim harishonim shomim cherpatam veenan meshivin velo od ella shemmochalim lamcharef vesolchim lo. vachachamim gedolim hayu mishtabbechim bemaasehem hannaim veomrim shemmeolam lo niddu adam velo hechrimuhu lichvodan. vezo hi darkam shel talmide chachamim sherauy lelech bah. bamme devarim amurim keshebbizzahu o cherfahu basseter. aval talmid chacham shebbizzahu o cherfo adam befarhesya asur lo limchol al kevodo veim machal neenash shezze bizyon tora ella nokem venoter haddavar kenachash ad sheyyevakkesh mimmennu mechila veyislach lo:
Mishneh Torah, Foreign Worship and Custo: Vime enosh tau bene haadam taut gadol venivara atzat chachme oto haddor veenosh atzmo min hattoim haya. vezo hayta tautam. amru hoil vehaelohim bara kochavim ellu vegalgallim lehanehig et haolam unetanam bammarom vechalak lahem kavod vehem shammashim hameshammeshim lefanav reuyin hem leshabbecham ulefaaram velachalok lahem kavod. vezehu retzon hael baruch hu legaddel ulechabbed mi sheggiddelo vechibbedo. kemo shehammelech rotze lechabbed haomdim lefanav vezehu kevodo shel melech. kevan sheala davar ze al libbam hitchilu livnot lakkochavim hechalot ulehakriv lahen karbanot uleshabbecham ulefaaram bidvarim ulehishtachavot lemulam kede lehassig retzon habbore bedatam haraa. veze haya ikkar avodat kochavim. vechach hayu omrim ovdeha hayyodim ikkarah. lo shehen omrim sheen sham eloah ella kochav ze. hu sheyyirmeyahu omer mi lo yiraacha melech haggoyim ki lecha yaata ki vechol chachme haggoyim uvechol malchutam meen kamocha uveachat yivaru veyichsalu musar havalim etz hu. kelomar hakkol yodim sheatta hu levaddecha aval tautam uchesilutam shemmedammim shezze hahevel retzoncha hu:

Veachar shearchu hayyamim amdu bivne haadam nevie sheker veamru shehael tzivva veamar lahem ivdu kochav peloni o kol hakkochavim vehakerivu lo venassechu lo kach vechach uvenu lo hechol vaasu tzurato kede lehishtachavot lo kol haam hannashim vehakketannim ushear amme haaretz. umodia lahem tzura shebbada millibbo veomer zo hi tzurat hakkochav peloni shehodiuhu binvuato. vehitchilu al derech zo laasot tzurot bahechalot vetachat hailanot uverashe heharim veal haggevaot umitkabbetzin umishtachavim lahem veomrim lechol haam shezzo hatztzura metiva umerea verauy leavdah uleyira mimmenna. vechohanehem omrim lahem shebbaavoda zo tirbu vetatzlichu vaasu kach vechach veal taasu kach vechach. vehitchilu kozvim acherim laamod velomar shehakkochav atzmo o haggalgal o hammalach dibber immahem veamar lahem ivduni bechach vechach vehodia lahem derech avodato vaasu kach veal taasu kach. ufashat davar ze bechol haolam laavod et hatztzurot baavodot meshunnot zo mizzo ulehakriv lahem ulehishtachavot. vechevan shearchu hayyamim nishtakkach hashshem hannichbad vehannora mippi kol hayekum umiddatam velo hikkiruhu venimtzeu kol am haaretz hannashim vehakketannim enam yodim ella hatztzura shel etz veshel even vehahechol shel avanim shennitchannechu mikkatnutam lehishtachavot lah uleavdah ulehishshava bishmah. vehachachamim shehayu bahem kegon kohanehem vechayyotze bahen medammin sheen sham eloah ella hakkochavim vehaggalgallim shennaasu hatztzurot haellu biglalam uledammotan. aval tzur haolamim lo haya shum adam shehaya makkiro velo yodo ella yechidim baolam kegon chanoch umetushelach noach shem veever. veal derech ze haya haolam holech umitgalgel ad shennolad ammudo shel olam vehu avraham avinu:

Kevan shennigmal etan ze hitchil leshotet bedato vehu katan vehitchil lachashov bayyom uvallayla vehaya tameah heach efshar sheyyihye haggalgal hazze noheg tamid velo yihye lo manhig umi yesabbev oto. ki i efshar sheyyesabbev et atzmo. velo haya lo melammed velo modia davar ella mushka beur kasdim ben ovde kochavim hattippeshim veaviv veimmo vechol haam ovde kochavim vehu oved immahem velibbo meshotet umevin ad shehissig derech haemet vehevin kav hatztzedek mittevunato hannechona. veyada sheyyesh sham eloah echad vehu manhig haggalgal vehu bara hakkol veen bechol hannimtza eloah chutz mimmennu. veyada shekkol haolam toim vedavar sheggaram lahem litot ze sheovdim et hakkochavim veet hatztzurot ad sheavad haemet middatam. uven arbaim shana hikkir avraham et boro. kevan shehikkir veyada hitchil lehashiv teshuvot al bene ur kasdim velaaroch din immahem velomar sheen zo derech haemet sheattem holchim bah veshibber hatztzelamim vehitchil lehodia laam sheen rauy laavod ella leeloah haolam velo rauy lehishtachavot ulehakriv ulenassech kede sheyyakkiruhu kol habberuim habbaim. verauy leabbed uleshabber kol hatztzurot kede shello yitu bahen kol haam kemo ellu shehem medammim sheen sham eloah ella ellu. kevan sheggavar alehem birayotav bikkesh hammelech lehargo venaasa lo nes veyatza lecharan. vehitchil laamod velikro bekol gadol lechol haolam ulehodiam sheyyesh sham eloah echad lechol haolam velo rauy laavod. vehaya mehallech vekore umekabbetz haam meir leir umimmamlacha lemamlacha ad shehiggia leeretz kenaan vehu kore shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 21 33)</small> "vayyikra sham beshem Adonai el olam". vechevan shehayu haam mitkabbetzin elav veshoalin lo al devarav haya modia lechol echad veechad kefi dato ad sheyyachzirehu lederech haemet ad shennitkabbetzu elav alafim urevavot vehem anshe bet avraham veshatal belibbam haikkar haggadol hazze vechibber bo sefarim vehodio leyitzchak beno. veyashav yitzchak melammed umazhir. veyitzchak hodia leyaakov uminnahu lelammed veyashav melammed umachazik kol hannilvim elav. veyaakov avinu limmed banav kullam vehivdil levi uminnahu rosh vehoshivo bishiva lelammed derech hashshem velishmor mitzvat avraham. vetzivva et banav shello yafsiku mibbene levi memunne achar memunne kede shello tishshachach hallimmud. vehaya haddavar holech umitgabber bivne yaakov uvannilvim alehem venaaset baolam umma shehi yodaat et Adonai. ad shearchu hayyamim leyisrael bemitzrayim vechazru lilmod maasehen velaavod kochavim kemotan chutz mishshevet levi sheamad bemitzvat avot. umeolam lo avad shevet levi avodat kochavim. vechimat kat haya haikkar sheshshatal avraham neekar vechozrin bene yaakov letaut haolam uteiyyotan. umeahavat Adonai otanu umishshamro et hashshevua leavraham avinu asa moshe rabbenu rabban shel kol hanneviim ushelacho. kevan shennitnabbe moshe rabbenu uvachar Adonai yisrael lenachala hichtiran bemitzvot vehodiam derech avodato uma yihye mishpat avodat kochavim vechol hattoim achareha:

Ikkar hatztziuuy baavodat kochavim shello laavod echad mikkol habberuim lo malach velo galgal velo kochav velo echad mearbaa hayesodot velo echad mikkol hannivraim mehen. veaf al pi shehaoved yodea she hu haelohim vehu oved hannivra hazze al derech sheavad enosh veanshe doro techilla hare ze oved kochavim. veinyan ze hu shehizhira tora alav veamra <small>(Devarim 4 19)</small> "ufen tissa enecha hashshamayma veraita et hashshemesh" vegomer <small>(Devarim 4 19)</small> "asher chalak Adonai elohecha otam lechol haammim". kelomar shemma tashut been libbecha vetire sheellu hen hammanhigim et haolam vehem shechalak Adonai otam lechol haolam lihyot chayyim vehovim veenam nifsadim keminhago shel olam vetomar sherauy lehishtachavot lahem uleavdan. uvainyan hazze tzivva veamar <small>(Devarim 11 16)</small> "hishshamru lachem pen yifte levavchem". kelomar shello titteu behirhur hallev laavod ellu lihyot sarsur benechem uven habbore:

Sefarim rabbim chibberu ovde kochavim baavodatah heach ikkar avodatah uma maaseha umishpateha. tzivvanu hakkadosh baruch hu shello likrot beotan hassefarim kelal velo neharher bah velo bedavar middevareha. vaafillu lehistakkel bidmut hatztzura asur shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 4)</small> "al tifnu el haelilim". uvainyan hazze neemar <small>(Devarim 12 30)</small> "ufen tidrosh lelohehem lemor echa yaavdu", shello tishal al derech avodatah heach hi af al pi sheen atta ovdah, sheddavar ze gorem lehippanot achareha velaasot kema shehen osin shenneemar veeese ken gam ani:

Vechol hallavin haellu beinyan echad hen vehu shello yifne achar avodat kochavim vechol hannifne achareha bederech shehu ose bo maase hare ze loke. velo avodat kochavim bilvad hu sheasur lehippanot achareha bemachashava ella kol machashava shehu gorem lo laadam laakor ikkar meikkere hattora muzharin anu shello lehaalotah al libbenu velo nassiach datenu lechach venachshov venimmashech achar hirhure hallev. mippene sheddato shel adam ketzara velo kol haddeot yecholin lehassig haemet al buryo. veim yimmashech kol adam achar machshevot libbo nimtza machariv et haolam lefi kotzer dato. ketzad. peamim yatur achar avodat kochavim ufeamim yachshov beyichud habbore shemma hu shemma eno. ma lemala uma lematta ma lefanim uma leachor. ufeamim bannevua shemma hi emet shemma hi enah. ufeamim battora shemma hi min hashshamayim shemma enah. veeno yodea hammiddot sheyyadin bahen ad sheyyeda haemet al buryo venimtza yotze lide minut. veal inyan ze hizhira tora veneemar bah <small>(Bamidbar 15 39)</small> "velo taturu achare levavchem veachare enechem asher attem zonim". kelomar lo yimmashech kol echad mikkem achar dato hakketzara vidamme shemmachashavto masseget haemet. kach amru chachamim <small>(gemara berachot 12 2)</small> "achare levavchem zo minut" veachare enechem zo zenut. velav ze af al pi shehu gorem laadam letardo min haolam habba en bo malkot:

Mitzvat avodat kochavim keneged hammitzvot kullan hi shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 22)</small> "vechi tishgu velo taasu et kol hammitzvot" vegomer umippi hashshemua lamdu shebbaavodat kochavim hakkatuv medabber. ha lamadta shekkol hammode baavodat kochavim kofer bechol hattora kullah uvechol hanneviim uvechol ma shennitztauu hanneviim meadam vead sof haolam shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 23)</small> "min hayyom asher tzivva Adonai vahala ledorotechem". vechol hakkofer baavodat kochavim mode bechol hattora kullah uvechol hanneviim uvechol ma shennitztauu hanneviim meadam vead sof haolam vehu ikkar kol hammitzvot kullan:

Yisrael sheavad avodat kochavim hare hu keoved kochavim lechol devarav veeno keyisrael sheover avera sheyyesh bah sekila. mumar laavodat kochavim hare hu mumar lechol hattora kullah. vechen haeppikorsim miyyisrael enan keyisrael ledavar min haddevarim veen mekabbelim otam bitshuva leolam shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 2 19)</small> "kol baeha lo yeshuvun velo yassigu archot chayyim". vehaeppikorsim hem hattarim achar machshevot libbam besichlut devarim sheamarnu ad shennimtzeu ovrim al gufe tora lehacheis bishat nefesh beyad rama veomrim sheen baze avon. veasur lesapper immahen ulehashiv alehen teshuva kelal shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 5 8)</small> "veal tikrav el petach betah". umachashava shel eppikoros laavodat kochavim:

Kol hammode baavodat kochavim shehi emet af al pi shello avadah hare ze mecharef umegaddef et hashshem hannichbad vehannora. veechad haoved avodat kochavim veechad hamegaddef et Adonai shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 30)</small> "vehannefesh asher taase beyad rama min haezrach umin hagger et Adonai hu megaddef". lefichach tolin oved avodat kochavim kemo shettolin et hamegaddef ushenehem niskalin. umippene ze kalalti din hamegaddef behilchot avodat kochavim sheshshenehem kofrim baikkar hem:

Veellu hen dine hamegaddef. en hamegaddef chayyav sekila ad sheyyefaresh et hashshem hameyuchad shel arba otiyyot shehu alef dalet nun yod vivarech oto beshem min hashshemot sheenam nimchakim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 24 16)</small> "venokev shem Adonai", al hashshem hameyuchad chayyav sekila veal shear hakkinnuyim beazhara. veyesh mi shemmefaresh sheeno chayyav ella al shem yod hei vav hei vaani omer sheal shenehem hu niskal:

Azhara shel megaddef minnayin shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 27)</small> "elohim lo tekallel". bechol yom vayom bodkin et haedim bechinnuyim yakke yosi et yosi. nigmar haddin motziin et kol adam lachutz veshoalim et haggadol shebbaedim veomrim lo emor ma sheshshamata beferush vehu omer vehaddayyanim omdim al raglehem vekorin velo meachin. vehaed hashsheni omer af ani kemoto shamati. veim hayu edim rabbim tzarich kol echad veechad mehen lomar kaze shamati:

Megaddef shechazar bo betoch kede dibbur eno kelum ella kevan sheggiddef beedim niskal. mi sheggiddef et hashshem beshem avodat kochavim kannaim pogim bo vehorgim oto. veim lo haraguhu kannaim uva levet din eno niskal ad sheyyevarech beshem min hashshemot hameyuchadim:

Kol hashshomea birkat hashshem chayyav likroa vaafillu al birkat hakkinnuyin chayyav likroa vehu sheyyishmaenna miyyisrael. echad hashshomea veechad hashshomea mippi hashshomea chayyav likroa. aval hashshomea mippi haoved kochavim eno chayyav likroa. velo karu elyakim veshevna ella mippene sheravshake haya yisrael mumar. kol haedim vehaddayyanim somchim et yedehem echad echad al rosh hamegaddef veomer lo damcha beroshcha sheatta garamta lecha. veen bechol haruge bet din mi shessomchim alav ella megaddef bilvad shenneemar vesamchu chol hashshomim et yedehem:
Kol haoved kochavim birtzono bezadon chayyav karet veim hayu sham edim vehateraa niskal. veim avad bishgaga mevi karban chattat kevua:

Avodot harebe kavu ovde kochavim lechol tzelem vetzelem ulechol tzura vetzura vaavodat ze enah kaavodat ze kegon peor sheavodato sheppoer adam atzmo lo umarkulis sheavodato sheyyizrok lo avanim o yesakkel millefanav avanim veharebe avodot kegon ellu tikkenu lishar tzelamim. lefichach happoer atzmo lemarkulis o shezzarak even lifor patur ad sheyyaavod oto derech avodato shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 30)</small> "echa yaavdu haggoyim haelle et elohehem veeese ken gam ani". umippene ze hainyan tzerichin bet din leda darche haavodot, sheen soklin oved kochavim ad sheyyedu shezzo hi derech avodato:

Veazhara shel avodot ellu vechayyotze bahen hu ma shekkatuv <small>(Shemot 20 5)</small> "velo taavdem". bamme devarim amurim bishar avodot chutz mimmishtachav vezoveach umaktir umenassech. aval haoved beachat meavodot ellu leechad mikkol mine avodat kochavim chayyav veaf al pi sheen derech avodato bechach. ketzad. hare shennissech lifor o shezzavach lemarkulis chayyav shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 19)</small> "zoveach laelohim yochoram bilti laAdonai levaddo". zevicha bichlal avoda hayta velamma yatzat lomar lecha ma zevicha meyuchedet sheovdin bah lashshem vechayyav hazzoveach leel acher sekila aleha ben hayta derech avodato bizvicha o enah bizvicha. af kol avoda shehi meyuchedet lashshem im avad bah leel acher ben shehayta derech avodato bechach ben sheenah bechach chayyav aleha. lechach neemar <small>(Shemot 34 14)</small> "lo tishtachave leel acher" lechayyev al hahishtachavaya afillu en derech avodato bechach. vehu haddin limkatter umenassech. vezorek umenassech echad hu:

Safat lah tzoa o shennissech lah avit shel me raglayim chayyav. shachat lah chagav patur ella im ken hayta avodatah bechach. vechen im shachat lah behema mechusseret evar patur ella im ken hayta derech avodatah bechach. avodat kochavim sheovdin otah bemakkel. shavar makkel befaneha chayyav veneeseret. zarak makkel befaneha chayyav veenah neeseret. sheen zerikat hammakkel keen zerikat haddam shehare hammakkel kemo shehu vehaddam mitpazzer. hamekabbel alav echad mikkol mine avodat kochavim beloah chayyav sekila. vaafillu higbiah levena veamar lah eli atta vechen kol kayyotze bedibbur ze chayyav. vaafillu chazar bo betoch kede dibbur veamar en ze eli en chazarato kelum ella niskal:

Haoved avodat kochavim kedarkah vaafillu asa derech bizzayon chayyav. ketzad. happoer atzmo lifor kede levazzoto o zarak even lemarkulis kede levazzoto hoil vaavodato bechach chayyav. umevi karban al shiggato:

Haoved avodat kochavim meahava kegon shechashak betzura zo mippene melachtah shehayta naa beyoter. o sheavadah miyyirato lah shemma tarea lo kemo shehen medammim ovdeha shehi metiva umerea. im kibbelah alav beloah chayyav sekila veim avadah derech avodatah o beachat mearba avodot meahava o miyyira patur. hamegappef avodat kochavim vehamenashshek lah vehamechabbed vehamerabbetz lefaneha vehammarchitz lah vehassach vehammalbish vehammanil vechol kayyotze bedivre kavod haellu over belo taase shenneemar velo taavdem, udevarim ellu bichlal avoda hen. veaf al pi chen eno loke al achat mehen lefi sheenan beferush. veim hayta derech avodatah beechad mikkol haddevarim haellu vaasahu leavdah chayyav:

Yashav lo kotz beraglo lifne avodat kochavim lo yashoach veyittelennu mippene shennire kemishtachave lah. nitpazzeru lo maot befaneha lo yashoach veyittelem mippene shennire kemishtachave lah ella yeshev veachar kach yittol:
Partzufot hamekallechot mayim bifne avodat kochavim lo yanniach piv al pihem veyishte mippene shennire kimnashshek laavodat kochavim:

Haose avodat kochavim leatzmo af al pi shello asaah beyado velo avadah loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 4)</small> "lo taase lecha fesel vechol temuna". vechen haose avodat kochavim beyado laacherim afillu asaah leoved kochavim loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 4)</small> "velohe massecha lo taasu lachem". lefichach haose avodat kochavim beyado leatzmo loke shetayim:

Asur laasot tzurot lenoy veaf al pi sheenah avodat kochavim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 20)</small> "lo taasun itti" kelomar tzurot shel kesef vezahav sheenam ella lenoy kede shello yitteu bahen hattoim vidammu shehem laavodat kochavim. veen issur latzur lenoy ella tzurat haadam bilvad. lefichach en metzayyerim lo beetz velo besid velo beeven tzurat haadam. vehu shettihye hatztzura boletet kegon hatztziyyur vehakkiyyur shebbatteraklin vechayyotze bahen veim tzar loke. aval im hayita hatztzura mushkaat o tzura shel sammanin kegon hatztzurot sheal gabbe halluchot vihattavliyyot o tzurot sherokmin baarig hare ellu muttarot:

Tabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam shehu tzurat adam im hayta hatztzura boletet asur lehannichah umuttar lachtom bah. veim hayta hatztzura shokaat muttar lehannichah veasur lachtom bah mippene shehannachatam taase bo hatztzura boletet. vechen asur latzur demut chamma ulevana kochavim mazzalot umalachim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 20)</small> "lo taasun itti" <small>(gemara rosh hashshana kad 2)</small> "lo taasun kidmut shemashay hameshammeshin lefanay bammarom" vaafillu al halluach. tzurot habbehemot ushear nefesh chayya chutz min haadam vetzurot hailanot udeshaim vechayyotze bahen muttar latzur otam vaafillu hayta hatztzura boletet:

Maddiche ir miyyisrael hare ellu niskalin af al pi shello avdu avodat kochavim ella hiddichu et yoshve iram ad sheavdu otah. veanshe hair hammuddachin neheragin besayif vehu sheavdu avodat kochavim o shekkibbeluha alehem beeloah. veazhara lammaddiach minnayin shenneemar lo yishshama al picha:

En hair naaset ir hanniddachat ad sheyyihyu maddicheha mittochah umeoto hashshevet shenneemar mikkirbecha <small>(Devarim 13 14)</small> "vayyaddichu et yoshve iram". vead sheyyihyu maddicheha shenayim o yeter al shenayim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 14)</small> "yatzu anashim bene veliyyaal vayyaddichu et yshve iram". vead sheyyaddichu rubbah. veyihyu hammuddachin mimmea vead rubbo shel shevet. aval im huddach rubbo shel shevet danin otam kichidim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 16)</small> "yshve hair" lo kefar katan velo kerach gadol. vechol pachot mimmea kefar katan. verubbo shel shevet kerach gadol. vechen im hiddichuha nashim o ketannim o shehiddichah yachid o shehuddecha miutah o shehuddechu mealehen o shehayu maddicheha michutza lah en danin bah din ir hanniddachat ella hare hen kichidim sheavdu avodat kochavim vesoklin kol mi sheavad umamonan leyorshehen kishar haruge bet din:

En danin ir hanniddachat ella bevet din shel echad veshivim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 5)</small> "vehotzeta et haish hahu o et haishsha hahi asher asu et haddavar hara hazze el shearecha", yechidim neheragim bevet din shel kol shaar veshaar veen hamerubbim neheragin ella bevet din haggadol:

En achat meare miklat naaset ir hanniddachat shenneemar ("beachad shearecha") [beachat arecha]. velo yerushalayim naaset ir hanniddachat lefi shello nitchalleka lishvatim. veen osin ir hanniddachat bassefar kede shello yikkansu ovde kochavim veyacharivu et eretz yisrael. veen bet din echad ose shalosh ayarot hanniddachot zo betzad zo. aval im hayu meruchakot ose:

En osin ir hanniddachat ad sheyyaddichuha maddicheha bilshon rabbim veyomru lahen nelech venaavod o nelech venizbach o nelech venaktir o nelech unenassech o nelech venishtachave o nelech unekabbel beeloah vehem shomim veavdu otah derech avodatah o beachat mearba avodot o shekkibbeluha beloah. ir hanniddachat shello nitkayyemu bah uvemaddicheha kol hattenaim haellu heach osim lahem, matrin umeidin bechol echad veechad mehen sheavad avodat kochavim vesoklin otam kichidim sheavdu umamonam leyorshehem:

Veheach din ir hanniddachat. bizman shettihye reuya leheasot ir hanniddachat. bet din haggadol sholchin vedorshin vechokrin ad sheyyedu biraya berura shehuddecha kol hair o rubbah vechazru laavodat kochavim. achar kach sholchim lahem shene talmide chachamim lehazehiram ulehachaziram. im chazru veasu teshuva mutav veim yaamdu beivvaltan bet din metzavvin lechol yisrael laalot alehen latztzava vehen tzarin alehem veorchin immahen milchama ad shettibbaka hair. keshettibbaka miyyad marbin lahem batte dinin vedanim otam. kol mi shebbau alav shene edim sheavad kochavim achar shehitru oto mafrishin oto. nimtzeu kol haovdim miutah soklin otan ushear hair nitztzol. nimtzeu rubbah maalin otan levet din haggadol vegomrin sham dinam vehorgin kol ellu sheavdu besayif. umakkin et kol nefesh adam asher bah lefi charev taf venashim im huddecha kullah. veim nimtzeu haovdim rubbah makkim et kol hattaf venashim shel ovdim lefi charev. uven shehuddecha kullah ben shehuddecha rubbah soklin et maddicheha umekabbetzin kol shelalah el toch rechovah. en lah rechov osin lah rechov. haya rechovah chutza lah bonin choma chutz mimmennu ad sheyyikkanes letochah shenneemar el toch rechovah. vehorgin kol nefesh chayya asher bah vesorfin et kol shelalah im hammedina baesh. userefatah mitzvat ase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 17)</small> "vesarafta vaesh et hair veet kol shelalah":

Nichse hatztzaddikim shebbetochah vehem shear yoshve hair shello huddechu im rubbah nisrafin bichlal shelalah hoil veyashvu sham mamonan avad. vechol hannehene mimmenna bechol shehu loke achat shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 18)</small> "velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem":

Veir hanniddachat shehuzemu edeha kol hammachazik binchaseha zacha umuttar lehanot bo shehare huzemu. velamma zacha bah shekkol echad veechad kevar hifkir mamono mishshaa shennigmar dino. veenah nivnet leolam vechol habbone otah loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 17)</small> "lo tibbane od". umuttar laasotah ginnot ufardesim shenneemar lo tibbane od lo tibbane medina kemo shehayta:
Shayyara haoveret mimmakom lemakom im avra bair hanniddachat vehuddecha immah. im shahata sham sheloshim yom neheragin besayif umamonam aved veim lav hen biskila umamonam leyorshehen:

Nichse anshe medina acheret shehayu mufkadin betochah af al pi shekkibbelu alehen acharayut en nisrafin ella yachzeru levaalehen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 17)</small> "shelalah" velo shelal chavertah. nichse harshaim shehuddechu shehayu mufkadin bimdina acheret im nikbetzu immah nisrafin bichlalah veim lav en meabbedim otam ella yinnatnu leyorshehem:
