Behema chetzyah shel ir hanniddachat vechetzyah shel ir acheret shehayta betochah hare zo asura. veissa shehi ken mutteret lefi sheefshar lechallekah:

Behema shel ir hanniddachat shennishchata asura bahanaa keshor hanniskal shennishchat. sear harosh ben shel anashim ben shel nashim shebbah muttar bahanaa aval shel pea nachrit hare hu mikkelal shelalah veasur:

Perot hamechubbarin shebbetochah muttarin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 17)</small> "tikbotz" <small>(Devarim 13 17)</small> "vesarafta" mi sheeno mechussar ella kibbutz userefa yatzu perot hamechubbarin shehen mechussarin telisha vekibbutz userefa. vehu haddin lisar harosh veen tzarich lomar hailanot atzman shehen muttarim vahare hen shel yorshehem. hahekdeshot shebbetochah kadshe mizbeach yamutu [shenneemar] zevach reshaim toeva. kadshe bedek habbayit yippadu veachar kach sorfin otan shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 17)</small> "shelalah" velo shelal shamayim:

Habbechor vehammaaser shebbetochah temimim hare hen kadshe mizbeach veyamutu. uvaale mumim hare hen bichlal behemtah veneheragin. hatterumot shebbetochah im higgiu leyad kohen yerakvu mippene shehem nechasav. veim adayin hen beyad yisrael yinnatnu lechohen shel medina acheret mippene shehen nichse shamayim ukedushshatan kedushshat hagguf:
Maaser sheni vechesef maaser sheni vechitve hakkodesh shebbetochah hare ellu yigganzu:

Kol haose din beir hanniddachat hare ze kemakriv ola kalil shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 17)</small> "kalil laAdonai elohecha". velo od ella shemmesallek charon af miyyisrael shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 18)</small> "lemaan yashuv Adonai mecharon appo". umevi alehem beracha verachamim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 18)</small> "venatan lecha rachamim verichamcha vehirbecha":

Hammesit echad miyyisrael ben ish ben ishsha hare ze niskal af al pi shello avad hammesit velo hammusat avodat kochavim ella mippene shehorahu laavod. ben shehaya hammesit hedyot ben shehaya navi ben shehaya hammusat yachid ish o ishsha o yechidim mitato biskila:

Hammesit et rov anshe hair hare ze maddiach veeno nikra mesit. haya ze shehiddiach rov hair navi mitato biskila vehanniddachim hare hen kichidim veenam keanshe ir hanniddachat ad sheyyihyu hammaddichim shenayim. veechad haomer amra li avodat kochavim ivduha. o sheamar amar li hakkadosh baruch hu ivdu avodat kochavim hare ze navi shehiddiach. veim huddechu acharav rov hair niskal. hammesit shehesit ben bilshon rabbim ben bilshon yachid hare ze niskal. ketzad. haomer lachavero eevod kochavim elech veeevod nelech venaavod baavoda pelonit shedderech otah avodat kochavim leheaved bah. ezbach elech veezbach nelech venizbach. akatter elech vaakater nelech unekatter. anassech elech vaanassech nelech unenassech. eshtachave elech veeshtachave nelech venishtachave hare ze mesit. hesit lishnayim hare hen edav vehen meviin oto levet din umeidin alav shekkach amar lahen vesoklin oto:

Veen hammesit tzarich hateraa. amar leechad hu omer yesh li chaverim rotzim bechach umaarim alav ad sheyyasit bifne shenayim kede lehargo. im lo ratza hammesit lehasit lishnayim mitzva lehachemin lo. kol chayyave mitot shebbattora en machminin alehen chutz mizze. ketzad machminin lo. hammusat mevi shenayim umaamidan bemakom afel kede sheyyiru hammesit veyishmeu devarav velo yire otam, vehu omer lammesit emor ma sheamarta li beyichud, vehu omer lo, vehammusat meshivo heach nanniach et elohenu shebbashshamayim venelech venaavod et haetzim veet haavanim. im chazar bo o shatak patur. veim amar lo kach hi chovatenu vechach yafe lanu, haomdim sham berachok meviin oto levet din vesoklim oto:

Mitzva beyad hammusat lehargo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 10)</small> "yadcha tihye bo varishona lahamito" vegomer. veasur lammusat leehov et hammesit shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 9)</small> "lo tove lo". ulefi shenneemar besone <small>(Shemot 23 5)</small> "azov taazov immo" yachol atta ozev laze talmud lomar <small>(Devarim 13 9)</small> "velo tishma elav". ulefi shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 16)</small> "velo taamod al dam reecha" yachol i atta omed al damo shel ze talmud lomar <small>(Devarim 13 9)</small> "velo tachos encha". veasur lammusat lelammed alav zechut shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 9)</small> "velo tachml". veim yada lo chova eno rashshay lishtok mimmenna shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 9)</small> "velo techasse alav". veazhara lehedyot hammesit minnayin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 12)</small> "vechol yisrael yishmeu veyirau":

Hammesit acherim leavdo veamar lahem ivduni im avaduhu niskal veim lo avaduhu af al pi shekkibbelu mimmennu veamru hen eno niskal. aval im hesit laavodat ish acher o lishar mine avodat kochavim im kibbel mimmennu veamar hen nelech venaavod af al pi sheadayin lo avad shenehen niskalin hammesit vehammusat shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 9)</small> "lo tove lo velo tishma elav" ha im shama veava chayyav:

Navi hammitnabbe beshem avodat kochavim ketzad. ze haomer amra li avodat kochavim pelonit o kochav peloni shemmitzva laasot kach vechach o shello laasot, afillu kivven et hahalacha letamme et hattame uletaher et hattahor, im hitru bo bifne shenayim hare ze nechnak shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 20)</small> "vaasher yedabber beshem elohim acherim umet hannavi hahu". veazhara shello mikkelal shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 13)</small> "veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru":

Veasur laaroch din uteshuva im hammitnabbe beshem avodat kochavim veen shoalin mimmennu ot umofet. veim asa meatzmo en mashgichin alav veen mehareharin bo. vechol hamechashshev beotot shello shemma emet hen over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 4)</small> "lo tishma el divre hannavi hahu". vechen nevi hashsheker mitato bechenek af al pi shennitnabbe beshem Adonai velo hosif velo gara shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 20)</small> "ach hannavi asher yazid ledabber davar bishmi et asher lo tzivviti" <small>(Devarim 18 20)</small> "umet hannavi hahu":
Echad hammitnabbe ma shello shama bemare hannevua o mi sheshshama divre navi chavero veamar sheddavar ze lo neemar vehu nitnabbe bo hare ze nevi sheker umitato bechenek:

Kol hammonea atzmo meharigat nevi hashsheker mippene maalato shehare holech bedarche hannevua hare ze over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 22)</small> "lo tagur mimmennu". vechen hammonea atzmo millelammed alav chova o happoched veyare middevarav hare hu bichlal lo tagur mimmennu. veen danin nevi hashsheker ella bevet din shel shivim veechad:

Hannoder beshem avodat kochavim vehannishba bah loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 13)</small> "veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru". echad hannishba bah leatzmo veechad hannishba bah leoved kochavim. veasur lehashebia haoved kochavim beyirato. afillu lehazekir shem avodat kochavim shello derech shevua asur shenneemar lo tazkiru:

Lo yomar adam lachavero shemor li batztzad avodat kochavim pelonit vechayyotze bah. vechol avodat kochavim hakketuva bechitve hakkodesh muttar lehazekir shemah kegon peor uvel unevo vegad vechayyotze bahen. veasur ligrom laacherim sheyyidderu vesheyyekayyemu beshem avodat kochavim. veeno loke ella hannoder bishmah vehamekayyem bishmah vehu hannishba bishmah:

Haose ov o yiddeoni birtzono bezadon chayyav karet veim hayu sham edim vehateraa niskal. haya shogeg mevi chattat kevua. ketzad hu maase haov. ze shehu omed umaktir ketoret yedua veochez sharvit shel hadas beyado umenifo vehu medabber ballat bidvarim yeduim etzlam ad sheyyishma hashshoel keillu echad medabber immo umeshivo al ma shehu shoel bidvarim mittachat haaretz bekol namuch ad meod ucheillu eno nikkar laozen ella bemachashava margish bo. vechen hallokeach gulgolet hammet umaktir lah umenachesh bah ad sheyyishshama keillu kol yotze mittachat shechyo shafal ad meod umeshivo. kol ellu maase ov hen vehaose echad mehen niskal:

Ketzad maase hayyiddeoni. meniach etzem of sheshshemo yadua befiv umaktir veose maasim acherim ad sheyyippol kenichpe vidabber befiv devarim sheatidim lihyot. vechol ellu mine avodat kochavim hen veazhara shellahen minnayin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 lo)</small> "al tifnu el haovot" vegomer:

Hannoten mizzaro lammolech birtzono uvezadon chayyav karet. beshogeg mevi chattat kevua. veim asa beedim vehateraa niskal shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 20 2)</small> "asher yitten mizzaro lammolech mot yumat" vegomer. veazhara shello minnayin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 21)</small> "umizzaracha lo titten lehaavir lammlech" ulehallan hu omer <small>(Devarim 18 10)</small> "lo yimmatze vecha maavir beno uvitto baesh". ketzad hayu osim. madlik esh gedola velokeach miktzat zaro umosro lechohanehem ovde haesh. veotan hakkohanim notnin habben leaviv achar shennimsar beyadan lehaaviro baesh birshuto vaavi habben hu shemmaavir beno al haesh birshut hakkohanim umaaviro beraglav mitztzad ze letzad acher betoch hashshalhevet. lo shehu sorfo lammolech kederech shessorfin benehem uvenotehem laavodat kochavim acheret ella behaavara bilvad hayta avoda zo sheshshemah molech. lefichach haose avoda zo laavodat kochavim acheret chutz mimmolech patur:

Eno chayyav karet o sekila ad sheyyimsor beno lammolech veyaaviro beraglav baesh derech haavara. masar velo heevir heevir velo masar. o shemmasar veheevir shello bederech haavara patur. veeno chayyav ad sheyyimsor miktzat zaro veyaniach miktzat shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 20 3)</small> "ki mizzaro natan lammlech" miktzato velo kullo:

Echad zera kasher veechad zera pasul echad banav uvenotav benehem uvene benehem al kol yotze yerecho hu chayyav mippene shehen zaro. aval im heevir echav o achyotav o avotav o sheheevir atzmo patur. heevir echad mizzaro vehu yashen o shehaya suma patur:

Matztzeva sheasra tora hi binyan shehakkol mitkabbetzin etzlah vaafillu laavod et Adonai shekken haya derech ovde kochavim. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 22)</small> "velo takim lecha matztzeva". vechol hammekim matztzeva loke. vechen even maskit haamura battora af al pi shehu mishtachave aleha lashshem loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 26 1)</small> "veeven maskit lo tittenu beartzechem lehishtachavot aleha" mippene shehaya derech ovde kochavim lehanniach even lefaneha lehishtachavot aleha. lefichach en osin ken laAdonai. veeno loke ad sheyyifshot yadav veraglav al haeven venimtza kullo muttal aleha shezzo hi hishtachavaya haamura battora:

Bamme devarim amurim bishar (haaratzot) aval bammikdash muttar lehishtachavot al haavanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 26 1)</small> "beartzechem", beartzechem i attem mishtachavim al haavanim aval attem mishtachavim al haavanim hamefutztzalot bammikdash. umippene ze nahagu kol yisrael lehatztzia machtzelaot bevatte kenesiyyot hartzufot baavanim o mine kash veteven lehavedil ben penehem uven haavanim. veim lo matza davar mavdil beno uven haeven holech lemakom acher umishtachave o shoche al tziddo umatte kede shello yadbik panav baeven:

Kol hammishtachave laAdonai al haavanim hamefutztzalot belo pishshut yadayim veraglayim eno loke ella makkin oto makkat mardut. aval laavodat kochavim echad hishtachavaya befishshut yadayim veraglayim o belo pishshut yadayim veraglayim mishshaa sheyyichbosh panav bakkarka niskal:

Hannotea ilan etzel hammizbeach o bechol haazara ben ilan serak ben ilan maachol af al pi sheasao lenoy lammikdash veyofi lo hare ze loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 21)</small> "lo titta lecha ashera kol etz etzel mizbach Adonai elohecha". mippene shehaya ze derech ovde kochavim notin ilanot betzad mizbeach shellah kede sheyyitkabbetzu sham haam:

Asur laasot achsadraot shel etz bammikdash kederech sheosin bachatzerot, af al pi shehu bevinyan veeno etz natua harechaka yetera hi shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 21)</small> "kol etz". ella kol haachsadraot vehassevachot hayyotzot min hakketalim shehayu bammikdash shel even hayu lo shel etz:

Mitzvat ase hi leabbed avodat kochavim umeshammesheha vechol hannaase bishvilah shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 2)</small> "abbed teabbedun et kol hammekomot" veneemar <small>(Devarim 7 5)</small> "ki im ko taasu lahem" vegomer. uveeretz yisrael mitzva lirdof achareha ad shenneabbed otah mikkol artzenu. aval bechutz laaretz en anu metzuvvin lirdof achareha ella kol makom shennichbosh oto neabbed kol avodat kochavim shebbo. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 3)</small> "veibbadtem et shemam min hammakom hahu". beeretz yisrael atta metzuvve lirdof acharehen vei atta metzuvve lirdof acharehen bechutz laaretz:

Avodat kochavim umeshammesheha vetikrovet shellah vechol hannaase bishvilah asur bahanaa shenneemar <small>(Devarim 7 26)</small> "velo tavi toeva el betecha" vechol hannehene beechad mikkol ellu loke shetayim. achat mishshum velo tavi. veachat mishshum velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem:

Behema shehikrivuha kullah laavodat kochavim asura bahanaa afillu pirshah veatzmoteha vekarneha utelafeha veorah hakkol asur bahanaa. lefichach im haya baor siman sheyyodea bo shezze haor tikrovet avodat kochavim hu kegon shehayu osim shekkorim kera agol keneged hallev umotziin hallev hare kol otan haorot shehen kach asurin bahanaa vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Ma ben avodat kochavim shel oved kochavim laavodat kochavim shel yisrael. avodat kochavim shel oved kochavim asura bahanaa miyyad shenneemar <small>(Devarim 7 25)</small> "pesile elohehem tisrefun baesh" mishsheppesalo naasa lo eloah. veshel yisrael enah asura bahanaa ad shetteaved shenneemar <small>(Devarim 27 15)</small> "vesam bassater" ad sheyyaase lah devarim shebbasseter shehen avodatah. umeshammeshe avodat kochavim ben shel oved kochavim ben shel yisrael enan asurin ad sheyyishtammeshu bahen laavodat kochavim:

Haose avodat kochavim laacherim af al pi shehu loke secharo muttar vaafillu asaah leoved kochavim shehi asura miyyad. mippene sheenah neeseret ad shettiggamer umakkosh acharon sheggomrah en bo sheve peruta. hallokeach gerutaot min haoved kochavim umatza bahen avodat kochavim. im natan maot velo mashach yachazirem laoved kochavim. vechen im mashach velo natan maot af al pi shemmeshicha beoved kochavim kona kemekach taut hu. natan maot umashach yolichem leyam hammelach. vechen oved kochavim veger sheyyarshu et avihen oved kochavim yachol hagger lomar leoved kochavim tol atta avodat kochavim vaani maot. tol atta yen nesech vaani perot. veim mishshebbau lirshut hagger asur:

Tzurot sheasaum ovde kochavim lenoy muttarin bahanaa vetzurot sheasaum laavodat kochavim asurin. ketzad. kol hatztzurot hannimtzaim bakkefarim asurim bahanaa mippene shechezkatan shellaavodat kochavim hen asuyin, vehannimtzaot bammedina im hayu omdin al petach hammedina vehaya beyad hatztzura tzurat makkel o tzippor o kaddur o sayif o atara vetabbaat chezkato shehu laavodat kochavim veasur bahanaa. veim lav hare hu bechezkat lenoy umuttar:

Tzalme avodat kochavim hannimtzaim mushlachim bashshevakim o betoch haggerutaot hare ellu muttarin veen tzarich lomar shivre tzalmehen. aval hammotze yad mitztzurat kochav o mazzal o raglah o evar meevareha mushlach hare ze asur bahanaa hoil veyada bevadday shezze haevar min tzurat avodat kochavim hanneevedet hare hi beissurah ad sheyyivadda lo shehaovde kochavim ovdeha bitteluha:

Hammotze kelim vaalehen tzurat chamma ulevana uderakon. im hayu kele kesef vezahav o bigde shani o shehayu chakukim al hannezamim veal hattabbaot hare ellu asurin. veal shear hakkelim muttarin mippene shechezkatan lenoy. vechen shear hatztzurot hannimtzaot al kol hakkelim chezkatan lenoy umuttarin:

Avodat kochavim umeshammesheha vechol hattikrovet shellah osrim bechol shehen. ketzad. avodat kochavim shennitarva betzurot shel noy afillu achat bechamma alafim yolich hakkol leyam hammelach. vechen im nitarev kos shel avodat kochavim bechamma kosot o chaticha min habbasar (shennitarva) bechamma chatichot yolich hakkol leyam hammelach. vechen or lavuv shennitarev bechamma orot hakkol asur bahanaa. avar umachar avodat kochavim o echad mimmeshammesheha o tikrovet shellah hare haddamim asurin bahanaa veosrin bechol shehen kaavodat kochavim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 7 26)</small> "vehayita cherem kamohu" kol ma sheatta mevi meavodat kochavim umikkol meshammesheha vetikravtah hare hi kamoha:

Avodat kochavim o ashera shennisrefa efrah asur bahanaa. vegachelet shel avodat kochavim asura vehashshalhevet mutteret mippene sheen bah mammash. sefek avodat kochavim asur, sefek sefekah muttar. ketzad. kos shel avodat kochavim shennafal beotzar male kosot kullan asurim, mippene sheavodat kochavim vechol meshammesheha osrin bechol shehen. perash kos echad min hattaarovet venafal lechosot shenayim hare ellu muttarin. tabbaat shel avodat kochavim shennitarva bechamma tabbaot venaflu shetayim mehen layyam haggadol hutteru kullan sheani omer otah hattabbaat hayta bichlal hashshetayim. nitarva bemea venitchalleku arbaim lemakom echad veshishshim lemakom acher venaflu haarbaim kullan letabbaot acherot kullan muttarot sheani omer otah hattabbaat haasura barov hi. naflu hashshishshim letabbaot acherot kullan asurot:

Haashera ben shehayta neevedet ben shehayta avodat kochavim munnachat tachteha asur leshev betzel komatah. umuttar leshev betzel hassarigim vehealim shellah. veim yesh lo derech acheret asur lo laavor tachteha. veim en sham derech acheret over tachteha keshehu ratz:

Efrochim shekkinnenu bah veen tzerichin leimman muttarin. vehaefrochim vehabbetzim shetztzerichin leimman asurin shehare haashera kemo basis lahen. vehakken atzmah shebberoshah muttar mippene shehaof mevi etzav mimmakom acher:

Natal mimmenna etzim asurim bahanaa. hesik bahen et hattannur yutzan veachar kach yassik beetzim acherim shel hetter veyofe bo. afa bo et happat velo tzinneno happat asura bahanaa. nitarva baacherot yolich deme otah happat leyam hammelach kede shello yehane bah ushear hakkikkarot muttarin:

Natal mimmenna karkar vearag bo et habbeged asur bahanaa. nitarev bivgadim acherim yolich deme oto habbeged leyam hammelach ushear kol habbegadim muttarin. umuttar litta tachteha yerakot ben bimot hachamma shehen tzerichin letzel. ben bimot haggeshamim. mippene shetztzel haashera shehu asur im hakkarka sheenah neeseret gormin lirakot ellu litzmoach vechol sheddavar asur vedavar muttar gormin lo hare ze muttar bechol makom. lefichach sade shezzibbelah bezevel avodat kochavim muttar lizroa otah. ufara sheppittemah becharshine avodat kochavim teachel vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Basar o yayin o perot shehechinum lehakerivam laavodat kochavim lo neesru bahanaa af al pi shehichnisum levet avodat kochavim ad sheyyakrivum lefaneha. hikrivum lefaneha naasu tikrovet veaf al pi shechazru vehotzium hare ellu asurin leolam. vechol hannimtza bevet avodat kochavim afillu mayim umelach asur bahanaa min hattora. vehaochel mimmennu kol shehu loke:

Hammotze kesut vechelim umaot berosh avodat kochavim. im metzaan derech bizzayon hare ellu muttarin veim metzaan derech kavod hare ellu asurin. ketzad. matza kis taluy betzavvaro. kesut mekuppelet umunnachat al rosho. keli kafuy al rosho hare ze muttar mippene shehu derech bizzayon vechen kol kayyotze baze. matza berosho davar shekkayyotze bo karev legabbe hammizbeach hare ze asur. bamme devarim amurim bizman shemmetzaan chutz limkom avodato aval im metzao bifnim ben derech kavod ben derech bizzayon ben davar harauy lammizbeach ben davar sheeno rauy kol hannimtza bifnim asur afillu mayim umelach. ufeor umarkulis kol hannimtza immahen ben bifnim ben bachutz asur bahanaa. vechen avne markulis even hanniret shehi immo asur bahanaa:
Avodat kochavim shehaya lah merchatz o ginna nehenim bahem shello betova veen nehenim bahem betova. haya lah velaacherim nehenin bahen afillu betovat kohaneha uvilvad shello yitten sachar:

Merchatz sheyyesh bah avodat kochavim muttar lirchotz bah mippene shehi naaset sham lenoy velo leavdah. shenneemar elohehem. bizman shennohagim bah minhag elohut velo bizman shemmevazzin otan kegon zo shehi omedet al habbiv vehakkol mashtinin befaneha. veim hayta derech avodatah bechach asur likkanes bo:

Sakkin shel avodat kochavim sheshshachat bah hare ze muttar mippene shehu mekalkel. veim hayta behema mesukkenet hare zo asura mippene shehu metakken vahare ze hattikkun mehanaat meshammeshe avodat kochavim. vechen asur lachtoch bah basar mippene shehu metakken veim chatach derech hefsed vehashechata muttar:

Kol sheen bo tefisat yad adam velo asahu adam af al pi shenneevad hare ze muttar bahanaa. lefichach ovde kochavim haovdim et heharim veet haggevaot veet hailanot hannetuin mittechillatan leferot veet hammayanot hannovin larabbim veet habbehema hare ellu muttarin bahanaa umuttar leechol otan happerot shenneevdu bimkom gedilatan veotah habbehema. veen tzarich lomar habbehema shehuktzat laavodat kochavim shehi mutteret baachila ben shehiktzuha leavdah ben shehiktzuha lehakerivah hare zo mutteret. bamme devarim amurim sheen habbehema neeseret beshello asa bah maase leshem avodat kochavim aval asa bah maase kol shehu asarah. ketzad, kegon sheshshachat bah siman laavodat kochavim. asaah chalifin laavodat kochavim asarah. vechen chalife chalifin. mippene shennaasim deme avodat kochavim. bamme devarim amurim bevehemat atzmo. aval im shachat behemat chavero laavodat kochavim o hechelifah lo neesra sheen adam oser davar sheeno shello. hammishtachave lekarka olam lo asarah. chafar bah borot shichin umearot leshem avodat kochavim asarah:
Mayim sheakaran haggal vehishtachava lahen lo asaran. netalan beyado vehishtachava lahen asaran. avne har shenniddaldelu vaavadan bimkomam muttarot shehare en bahen tefisat yad adam:

Yisrael shezzakaf levena lehishtachavot lah velo hishtachava lah uva oved kochavim vehishtachava lah asarah bahanaa shezzekifatah maase. vechen im zakaf betza uva oved kochavim vehishtachava lah asarah. chatach delaat vechayyotze bah vehishtachava lah asarah. hishtachava lachatzi delaat vachatzi haacher meore bo hare ze asur missafek shemma ze hachetzi kemo yad lachetzi hanneevad. ilan shennetao mittechilla sheyyihye neevad asur bahanaa vezo hi ashera haamura battora. haya ilan natua ugedao ufesalo leshem avodat kochavim afillu hivrich vehirkiv begufo shel ilan vehotzi sarigim koret et hassarigim vehem asurim bahanaa ushear hailan muttar. vechen hammishtachave leilan af al pi shello neesar gufo kol hassarigim vehealim vehallulavin vehapperot sheyyotzi kol zeman shehu neevad hare ellu asurin bahanaa. ilan shehayu haovde kochavim meshammerin et perotav veomrim shehem muchanim laasot shechar levet avodat kochavim peloni veosin mehen shechar veshotim oto beyom chaggam hare ze hailan asur bahanaa mippene shessetamo shehu ashera ulefichach osin beferotav kach shezzo hi chukkah shel ashera:

Ilan shemmaamidin tachtav avodat kochavim kol zeman shehi tachtav asur bahanaa. netalah mittachtav hare ze muttar mippene sheen hailan atzmo hu hanneevad. bayit shebbenao haoved kochavim mittechilla sheyyehe habbayit atzmo neevad vechen hammishtachave levayit banuy hare ze asur bahanaa. haya banuy vesiyyedo vechiyyero leshem avodat kochavim ad shennitchaddesh notel ma shechiddesh vehachiddush asur bahanaa mippene sheasaahu leavdo ushear habbayit muttar. hichnis avodat kochavim letoch habbayit kol zeman shehi sham habbayit asur bahanaa. hotziah huttar habbayit. vechen even shechatzavah mittechilla leavdah asura bahanaa. hayta chatzuva vetziyyerah vechiyyerah shetteaved afillu tziyyer vechiyyer beguf haeven veen tzarich lomar im kiyyer aleha notel ma shechiddesh vehu asur bahanaa hoil venaasa sheyyeaved ushear haeven muttar:

Even sheheemid aleha avodat kochavim hare zo asura kol zeman shehi aleha. sulleka haeven mutteret. mi shehaya beto samuch laavodat kochavim venafal asur livnoto. ketzad yaase. kones letoch shello uvone veoto harevach memalleehu kotzim o tzoa. kede shello yarchiv levet avodat kochavim. haya hakkotel shello veshel avodat kochavim yiddon mechetza lemechetza, mechetza shello muttar bahanaa veshel avodat kochavim hakkol asur bahanaa. avanav etzav vaafaro hakkol asur bahanaa:
Ketzad meabbed avodat kochavim ushear devarim haasurim biglalah kegon meshammesheha vetikrovet shellah. shochek vezore laruach o soref umetil leyam hammelach:

Davar sheen bo tefisat yad adam shenneevad kegon harim uvehema veilan af al pi shehanneevad atzmo muttar bahanaa tzippuyo asur bahanaa vehannehene bechol shehu mehen loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 7 25)</small> "lo tachmod kesef vezahav alehem". vechol tzippuye avodat kochavim hare hen bichlal meshammesheha:

Avodat kochavim shel ovde kochavim shebbitteluha kodem shettavo lide yisrael hare zo mutteret bahanaa shenneemar <small>(Devarim 7 25)</small> "pesile elohehem tisrefun baesh", keshebbau leyadenu vehen nohagin bahem elohut, aval im bittelum hare ellu muttarin:

Avodat kochavim shel yisrael enah betela leolam afillu haya leoved kochavim bah shuttafut en bittulo moil kelum ella asura bahanaa leolam uteuna geniza. vechen avodat kochavim shel oved kochavim shebbat leyad yisrael veachar kach bittelah haoved kochavim en bittulo moil kelum ella asura bahanaa leolam. veen yisrael mevattel avodat kochavim vaafillu birshut oved kochavim. oved kochavim katan o shote eno mevattel avodat kochavim. veoved kochavim shebbittel avodat kochavim ben shello ben shel ovde kochavim acherim beal karcho af al pi sheanaso yisrael al kach hare zo betela. uvilvad sheyyehe haoved kochavim hamevattel oved avodat kochavim. aval mi sheeno oved avodat kochavim en bittulo bittul. hamevattel avodat kochavim bittel meshammesheha. bittel meshammesheha meshammesheha muttarim vehi asura bahanaa kemo shehayta ad sheyyevattelenna. vetikrovet avodat kochavim enah betela leolam:

Ketzad mevattelah. kata rosh chatmah rosh aznah rosh etzbaah pachasa befaneha af al pi shello chisserah o shemmecharah letzoref yisrael hare zo betela. aval im mishkenah o mecharah leoved kochavim o leyisrael sheeno tzoref o shennafla aleha mappolet velo pinna. genavuha listim velo tevauha. rakak befaneha. hishtin befaneha. gerarah. zarak bah et hatztzoa hare zo enah betela:

Avodat kochavim shehenichuha ovdeha bishat shalom mutteret bahanaa shehare bitteluha. bishat milchama asura mippene shello henichuha ella mippene hammilchama. avodat kochavim shennishbera meeleha shevareha asurim bahanaa ad sheyyevatteluha. lefichach hammotze shivre avodat kochavim hare ellu asurin bahanaa shemma lo bitteluha haovde kochavim. veim hayta shel perakim vehedyot yachol lehachaziram tzarich levattel kol perek uferek mipperakeha veim eno yachol lehachazir kevan shebbittel evar echad mimmenna batlu kol hashshevarim:

Mizbach avodat kochavim shennifgam adayin hu asur bahanaa ad sheyyinnatetz rubbo beyad oved kochavim. uvimos shennifgam muttar. e zehu bimos vee zehu mizbeach. bimos even achat. mizbeach avanim harebe. vechetzad mevattelin avne markulis. kevan shebbana mehem binyan o chippa bahen et hadderachim vechayyotze beellu hare hen muttarim bahanaa. ketzad mevattelim et haashera. kirsem mimmenna ale o zarak mimmenna yonek natal mimmenna makkel o sharvit o sheshshefaah shello letzarkah hare zo betela. shefaah letzarkah hi asura ushefaeha muttarim. veim hayta shel yisrael ben letzarkah ben shello letzarkah ben hi uven shefaeha asura leolam sheavodat kochavim shel yisrael en lah bittul leolam:

Shelosha yamim lifne chaggam shel ovde kochavim asur likkach mehem velimkor lahem davar hammitkayyem, lilvot mehen ulehalvotam, lippara mehen velifroa lahem milvve bishtar o al hammashkon aval milvve al pe nifrain mehen mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadam. umuttar limkor lahen davar sheeno mitkayyem kegon yerakot vetavshil ad yom chaggam. bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael aval bishar aratzot eno asur ella yom chaggam bilvad. avar venasa venatan immahen beotan hashshelosha yamim hare ze muttar bahanaa. vehannose venoten beyom chaggam immahen hare ze asur bahanaa:
Veasur lishloach doron lechuti beyom edo ella im ken noda lo sheeno mode baavodat kochavim veeno ovdah. vechen kuti sheshshalach doron leyisrael beyom chaggo lo yekabbelennu mimmennu. veim chashash leeva notlo befanav veeno nehene bo ad sheyyivvada lo shezze hakkuti eno oved kochavim veeno mode bah:
Haya edan shel otan akkum yamim harebe shelosha o arbaa o asara kol otan hayyamim keyom echad hen vechullan asurin im 3 yamim lifnehen:
Kenaanim ovde kochavim umazzalot hem veyom rishon hu yom edam. lefichach asur latet velaset immahem beeretz yisrael yom chamishi veyom shishshi shebbechol shabbat veshabbat veen tzarich lomar yom rishon atzmo shehu asur bechol makom. vechen nohagin immahem bechol edehem:
Yom shemmitkannesin bo ovde kochavim lehaamid lahen melech umakrivin umekallesim lelohehem yom chaggam hu vahare hu kishar chaggehem aval oved kochavim sheose hu chag leatzmo umode lechochav shello umekalleso beyom shennolad bo veyom tiglachat zekano o belorito veyom sheala bo min hayyam vesheyyatza mibbet haasurim veyom sheasa bo mishte livno vechayyotze baellu eno asur ella oto hayyom veoto haish bilvad. vechen yom sheyyamut lahen bo met veyaasuhu chag otam haosim asurin oto hayyom. vechol mita shessorfin bah kelim umekatterim ketoret beyadua sheyyesh bah avodat kochavim. en yom hechag asur ella leovdeha bilvad. aval otam shessemechim bo veochlin veshotin umeshammerin oto mippene minhag o mippene kevod hammelech aval hem en modin bo hare ellu muttarin laset velatet immahen:
Devarim shehen meyuchadin lemin mimmine avodat kochavim shebbeoto makom asur limkor leovde otah avodat kochavim shebbeoto hammakom leolam. udevarim sheenan meyuchadin lah mochrin otam setam. veim peresh haoved kochavim shehu kone otam laavodat kochavim asur limkor lo ella im ken pesalo millehakrivo laavodat kochavim. lefi sheen makrivin chaser laavodat kochavim:
Hayu meoravin devarim hameyuchadin im devarim sheen meyuchadin kegon levona zakka bichlal levona shechora mocher hakkol setam veen choshshin shemma yelakket hazzakka levaddah laavodat kochavim vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Keshem sheen mochrin leoved kochavim devarim shemmachazikin bahen yedehen laavodat kochavim kach en mochrin lahem davar sheyyesh bo nezek larabbim kegon dubbim vaarayot uchele zayin uchevalim veshalshelaot. veen mashchizin lahem et hazzayin. vechol sheasur lemachro leoved kochavim asur lemachro leyisrael hechashud limkor leoved kochavim. vechen asur limkor kele nezek leyisrael listim:
Hayu yisrael shochnim ben haovde kochavim vechartu lahem berit muttar limkor kele zayin leavde hammelech vegesotav mippene sheosim bahem milchama im tzare hammedina lehatztzilah venimtzeu meginnim alenu shehare anu sheruyin betocham. ir sheyyesh bah avodat kochavim muttar lehallech chutza lah veasur lehikkanes betochah. haya chutza lah avodat kochavim muttar lehallech betochah:
Haholech mimmakom lemakom asur lo laavor beir sheyyesh bah avodat kochavim. bamme devarim amurim bizman shehadderech meyuchedet leoto makom aval im yesh sham derech acheret venikra vehalach bezo muttar:
Asur livnot im haovde kochavim kippa shemmaamidim bah avodat kochavim. veim avar uvana secharo muttar. aval bone hu lechattechilla hatteraklin o hechatzer sheyyesh bah otah hakkippa:
Ir sheyyesh bah avodat kochavim vehayu bah chanuyyot meuttarot vesheenan meuttarot hameuttarot asur lehanot bahen bechol ma shebbetochan mippene shechezkatan shebbiglal avodat kochavim nitatteru vesheenan meettarot muttarot bahanaa. chanuyyot shel avodat kochavim asur lesachran mippene shemmehanne avodat kochavim:
Hammocher bayit laavodat kochavim damav asurim bahanaa veyolichem leyam hammelach. aval ovde kochavim sheansu yisrael vegazlu beto veheemidu bo avodat kochavim damav muttarin, vechotev umaale bearkaot shellahem:
Vachalilin shel ovde kochavim asur lispod bahen. holchin leyarid shel avodat kochavim velokchin mehen behema avadim ushefachot begeutan uvattim vesadot ucheramim vechotev umaale bearkaot shellahen mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadam. bamme devarim amurim belokeach mibbaal habbayit sheeno noten meches aval hallokeach sham min hattaggar asur mippene shehu noten meches vehammeches laavodat kochavim venimtza ze mehanne avodat kochavim. avar velakach min hattaggar. im behema lakach menashsher parsoteha min haarkubba ulematta. veim kesut vechelim lakach yerakvu. lakach maot uchele mattachot yolichem leyam hammelach. lakach eved lo maalim velo moridin:
Oved kochavim sheasa livno o levitto mishte asur lehanot misseuddato. vaafillu leechol velishtot hayyisrael mishshello sham asur hoil uvimsibbat ovde kochavim achalo. umeematay asur leechol etzlo mishsheyyatchil laasok ulehachin tzarche seudda vechol yeme hammishte uleachar yeme hammishte sheloshim yom. veim asa seudda acheret mechamat hannissuin afillu leachar sheloshim yom asur ad shenem asar chodesh. vechol haharchaka hazzot mippene avoda shel kochavim hu shenneemar <small>(Shemot 34 15)</small> "vekara lecha veachalta mizzivcho" <small>(Shemot 34 16)</small> "velakachta mibbenotav levanecha vezanu" vegomer:
Bat yisrael lo tenik et benah shel ovedet kochavim mippene shemmegaddelet ben laavodat kochavim. velo teyalled et hannachrit akkum aval meyalledet hi besachar mishshum eva. vehannachrit akkum meyalledet et bat yisrael umenika et benah birshutah kede shello tahargennu:
Haholchin letarput akkum asur laset velatet immahen vehabbaim muttarin vehu shello yihyu keshurin ze baze sheim hayu keshurin shemma datan lachazor. yisrael haholech letarput akkum, bahalicha muttar laset velatet immo shemma yachazor bo uvachazira asur. yisrael mumar ben bahalicha ben bachazira asur:
Yisrael shehalach leyarid shel akkum, bachazira asur laset velatet immo shemma akkum machar lahen sham, udeme akkum beyad yisrael asurim bahanaa uveyad akkum muttarin bahanaa, umippene ze nosin venotnin im akkum habba min hattarput shel akkum veen nosin venotnin im yisrael habba min hattarput hahu velo im yisrael mumar lo bahalichato velo bachazirato:

En kortin berit leshova amamin kede shennaase immahen shalom venaniach otam laavod avoda zara shenneemar <small>(Devarim 7 2)</small> "lo tichrot lahem berit" ella yachzeru meavodatam o yehargu. veasur lerachem alehem shenneemar <small>(Devarim 7 2)</small> "velo techannem". lefichach im raa mehem oved o tovea bannahar lo yaalennu. raahu natuy lamut lo yatztzilennu. aval leabbedo beyado o ledochofo labbor vechayyotze baze asur mippene sheeno ose immanu milchama. bamme devarim amurim beshiva amamin aval hammosrim vehaeppikorosin miyyisrael haya din leabbedan beyad ulehoridan ad beer shachat mippene shehayu metzerim leyisrael umesirin et haam meachare Adonai:
Mikkan atta lamed sheasur lerappeot akkum afillu besachar. veim haya mityare mehen o shehaya choshesh mishshum eva merappe besachar aval bechinnam asur. veger toshav hoil veatta metzuvve lehachayoto merappeim oto bechinnam:
En mochrin lahem battim vesadot beeretz yisrael. uvesureya mochrin lahem battim aval lo sadot. umaskirin lahem battim beeretz yisrael uvilvad shello yaasu shechuna veen shechuna pachot mishshelosha. veen maskirin lahem sadot. uvesureya maskirin lahem sadot. umippene ma hechmiru besade, mippene sheyyesh bah shetayim, mafkiah min hammaasrot venoten lahem chaniyya bakkarka. umuttar limkor lahem battim vesadot bechutza laaretz mippene sheenah artzenu:
Af bemakom shehittiru lehasekir lo levet dira hittiru mippene shehu machnis letochah avodat kochavim veneemar <small>(Devarim 7 26)</small> "lo tavi toeva el betecha". aval maskir lahen battim laasotan otzar. veen mochrin lahen perot utevua vechayyotze bahen bamchubbar lakkarka. aval mocher hu mishsheyakotz o mocher lo al menat lakotz vekotzetz. umippene ma en mochrin lahen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 7 2)</small> "velo techannem" lo titten lahem chaniyya bakkarka sheim lo yihye lahem karka yeshivatan yeshivat aray hi. vechen asur lesapper beshivchan vaafillu lomar kamma nae oved kochavim ze betzurato. kal vachomer sheyyesapper beshevach maasav o sheyyechabbev davar middivrehem shenneemar velo techannem lo yihye lahem chen beenecha, mippene sheggorem lehiddabbek immo velilmod mimmaasav haraim. veasur litten lahem mattenat chinnam aval noten hu leger toshav shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 21)</small> "lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah o machor lenachri", bimchira velo bintina: 
Mefarnesim aniyye ovde kochavim im aniyye yisrael mippene darche shalom. veen memachin bide aniyye ovde kochavim beleket shichcha ufea mippene darche shalom. veshoalim bishlomam vaafillu beyom chaggam mippene darche shalom. veen koflin lahen shalom leolam. velo yikkanes leveto shel oved kochavim beyom chaggo latet lo shalom. metzao bashshuk noten lo shalom besafa rafa uvechoved rosh:
En kol haddevarim haellu amurim ella bizman sheggalu yisrael leven haovde kochavim o sheyyad akkum takkifa al yisrael aval bizman sheyyad yisrael takkifa alehem asur lanu lehanniach ovde kochavim benenu. vaafillu yoshev yeshivat aray o over mimmakom lemakom bischora lo yaavor beartzenu ella ad sheyyekabbel alav sheva mitzvot shennitztauu bene noach shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 33)</small> "lo yeshvu beartzecha" afillu lefi shaa. veim kibbel alav sheva mitzvot hare ze ger toshav. veen mekabbelin ger toshav ella bizman shehayyovel noheg aval shello bizman hayyovel en mekabbelin ella ger tzedek bilvad:

En holchin bechukkot haovde kochavim velo middammin lahen lo bemalbush velo besear vechayyotze bahen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 20 23)</small> "velo telchu bechukkot haggoy". veneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 3)</small> "uvechukkotehem lo telechu". veneemar <small>(Devarim 12 30)</small> "hishshamer lecha pen tinnakesh acharehem". hakkol beinyan echad hu mazhir shello yidme lahen. ella yihye hayyisrael muvdal mehen veyadua bemalbusho uvishar maasav kemo shehu muvdal mehen bemaddao uvedeotav. vechen hu omer <small>(Vayikra 20 26)</small> "vaavdil etchem min haammim". lo yilbash bemalbush hameyuchad lahen. velo yegaddel tzitzit rosho kemo tzitzit rosham. velo yegalleach min hatztzedadin veyanniach hassear baemtza kemo shehen osin veze hannikra belorit. velo yegalleach hassear mikkeneged panav meozen leozen veyanniach happera milleacharav kederech sheosin hen. velo yivne mekomot kevinyan hechalot shel akkum kede sheyyikkansu bahen rabbim kemo shehen osin. vechol haose achat meellu vechayyotze bahen loke:
Akkum shehaya mistapper miyyisrael kevan shehiggia livlorito karov shalosh etzbaot lechol ruach shomet et yado:
Yisrael shehaya karov lammalchut vetzarich leshev lifne malchehem vehoyo lo genay lefi shello yidme lahen hare ze muttar lilbosh bemalbushehen ulegalleach keneged panav kederech shehen osin:

En menachashin keakkum shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 26)</small> "lo tenachashu". ketzad hu hannachash. kegon ellu sheomrim hoil venafla pitti mippi o nafal makli miyyadi eni holech lemakom peloni hayyom sheim elech en chafatzayy naasim. hoil veavar shual mimini eni yotze mippetach beti hayyom sheim etze yifgaeni adam rammay. vechen ellu sheshshomim tziftzuf haof veomrim yihye kach velo yihye kach. tov laasot davar peloni vera laasot davar peloni. vechen ellu sheomrim shechot tarnegol ze shekkara arvit. shechot tarnegolet zo shekkara kemo tarnegol. vechen hammesim simanim leatzmo im yeera li kach vechach eese davar peloni veim lo yeera li lo eese, keeliezer eved avraham. vechen kol kayyotze baddevarim haellu hakkol asur. vechol haose maase mippene davar middevarim ellu loke:

Mi sheamar dira zo shebbaniti siman tov hayta alay. ishsha zo shennasati uvehema zo shekkaniti mevorechet hayta meet shekkenitiha asharti. vechen hashshoel letinok e ze pasuk atta lomed im amar lo pasuk min habberachot yismach veyomar ze siman tov kol ellu vechayyotze bahen muttar hoil velo kivven maasav velo nimna millaasot ella asa ze siman leatzmo ledavar shekkevar haya hare ze muttar:

Ezehu kosem ze haose maase mishshear hammaasiyyot kede sheyyishshom vetippane machashavto mikkol haddevarim ad sheyyomar devarim sheatidim lihyot veyomar davar peloni atid lihyot o eno hove o sheyyomar sherauy laasot ken vehizzaharu mikkach. yesh min hakkosmin shemmeshammeshim bechol o baavanim. veyesh mi sheggoher laaretz veyanua vetzoek. veyesh mi shemmistakkel bemara shel barzel o baashashit umedammin veomrim. veyesh mi shennose makkel beyado venishan alav umakke bo ad shettippane machashavto umedabber. hu shehannavi omer <small>(Hoshea 4 12)</small> "ammi beetzo yishal umaklo yaggid lo":

Asur liksom velishl lekosem ella shehashshoel lekosem makkin oto makkat mardut aval hakkosem atzmo im asa maase mikkol ellu vechayyotze bahen loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 10)</small> "lo yimmatze vecha maavir beno" vegomer <small>(Devarim 18 10)</small> "kosem kesamim":
Ezehu meonen ellu notne ittim sheomrim beitztagninut yom peloni tov yom peloni ra yom peloni rauy laasot bo melacha pelonit shana pelonit o chodesh peloni ra ledavar peloni:

Asur leonen af al pi shello asa maase ella hodia otan hakkezavim shehakkesilim medammin shehen divre emet vedivre chachamim. vechol haose mippene haitztagninut vechivven melachto o halichato beoto haet shekkavu hovre shamayim hare ze loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 26)</small> "lo teonenu". vechen haochez et haenayim umedamme bifne haroim sheose maase timmahon vehu lo asa hare ze bichlal meonen veloke:

Ezehu chover ze shemmedabber bidvarim sheenan leshon am veen lahen inyan umaale al dato besichluto sheotan haddevarim moilin. ad shehen omrim shehaomer kach vechach al hannachash o al haakrav eno mazzik vehaomer kach vechach al haish eno nizzok. umehen ochez beyado beet shemmedabber mafteach o sela vechayyotze baddevarim haellu hakkol asur. vehachover atzmo sheachaz beyado kelum o sheasa maase im dibburo afillu hera beetzbao hare ze loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 10)</small> "lo yimmatze vecha" vegomer <small>(Devarim 18 11)</small> "vechover chaver". aval im amar devarim bilvad velo henid lo etzba velo rosh velo haya beyado kelum. vechen adam sheamar alav hechaver otan hakkolot vehu yoshev lefanav umedamme sheyyesh lo baze hanaa makkin oto makkat mardut mippene shennishtattef besichlut hachover. vechol otan hakkolot vehashshemot hameshunnim hamechoarim lo yareu vegam hetev en otam:

Mi shenneshacho akrav o nachash muttar lilchosh al mekom hanneshicha vaafillu beshabbat kede leyashshev dato ulechazzek libbo. af al pi sheen haddavar moil kelum hoil umesukkan hu hittiru lo kede shello tittaref dato alav:

Hallochesh al hammakka vekore pasuk min hattora. vechen hakkore al hattinok shello yibbaet vehammanniach sefer tora o tefillin al hakkatan bishvil sheyyishan. lo day lahem shehem bichlal menachashim vechovrim ella shehen bichlal hakkofrim battora shehen osin divre tora refuat guf veenan ella refuat nefashot shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 3 22)</small> "veyihyu chayyim lenafshecha". aval habbari shekkara pesukin umizmor mittehillim kede shettagen alav zechut keriatan veyinnatzel mitztzarot uminnezakim hare ze muttar:

Ezehu doresh el hammetim ze hammariv et atzmo veholech velan bevet hakkevarot kede sheyyavo met bachalom veyodio ma sheshshaal alav. veyesh acherim shehem lovshim malbushim yeduim veomrim devarim umaktirin ketoret yedua vishenim levaddan kede sheyyavo met peloni visapper immo bachalom. kelalo shel davar kol haose kede sheyyavo hammet veyodio loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 10)</small> "lo yimmatze vecha maavir" vegomer <small>(Devarim 18 11)</small> "vedoresh el hammetim":

Asur lishl baal ov o baal yiddeoni shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 10)</small> "lo yimmatze vecha maavir" vegomer <small>(Devarim 18 11)</small> "veshoel ov veyiddeoni". nimtzeta lamed shebbaal ov veyiddeoni atzman biskila vehannishal bahen beazhara umakkin oto makkat mardut. veim kivven maasav veasa kefi meamaran loke:

Hamechashshef chayyav sekila vehu sheasa maase keshafim. aval haochez et haenayim vehu sheyyerae sheasa vehu lo asa loke makkat mardut. mippene shellav ze shenneemar bimchashshef bichlal <small>(Devarim 18 10)</small> "lo yimmatze vecha" hu velav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din hu veen lokin alav shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 17)</small> "mechashshefa lo techayye":

Udevarim haellu kullan divre sheker vechazav hen vehem shehitu bahen ovde kochavim hakkadmonim legoye haaratzot kede sheyyinhagu acharehen. veen rauy leyisrael shehem chachamim mechukkamim lehimmashech bahavalim ellu velo lehaalot al lev sheyyesh toelet bahen. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 23 23)</small> "ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael". veneemar <small>(Devarim 18 14)</small> "ki haggoyim haelle asher atta yoresh otam el meonnim veel kosmim yishmau veatta lo chen" vegomer. kol hammaamin bidvarim haellu vechayyotze bahen umechashshev belibbo shehen emet udevar chachma aval hattora asaratan enan ella min hassechalim umechussere haddaat uvichlal hannashim vehakketannim sheen datan shelema. aval baale hachachma utemime haddaat yedu birayot berurot shekkol ellu haddevarim sheasra tora enam divre chachma ella tohu vehevel shennimshechu bahen chasre haddaat venatshu kol darche haemet biglalan. umippene ze amra tora keshehizhira al kol ellu hahavalim <small>(Devarim 18 13)</small> "tamim tihye im Adonai elohecha":

En megallechin paate harosh kemo shehayu osin ovde kochavim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 27)</small> "lo takkifu peat roshchem". vechayyav al kol pea ufea. lefichach hamegalleach shene tzedaav afillu bevat achat vehateraa achat loke shetayim. echad hamegalleach happeot bilvad umeniach sear kol harosh veechad hamegalleach kol harosh keechad loke hoil vegillach happeot. bamme devarim amurim beish hamegalleach aval ish hammitgalleach eno loke ella im ken siyyea lamgalleach. vehamegalleach et hakkatan loke:

Haishsha sheggillecha peat rosh haish o shennitgallecha petura shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 27)</small> "lo takkifu peat roshchem" <small>(Vayikra 19 27)</small> "velo tashchit peat zekanecha" kol sheyyeshno beval tashchit yeshno beval takkif, veishsha sheenah beval tashchit lefi sheen lah zakan enah beval takkif. lefichach haavadim hoil veyesh lahem zakan asurin behakkafa:

Kol mitzvot lo taase shebbattora echad anashim veechad nashim chayyavim chutz mibbal tashchit" uval takkif" uval yittame kohen lammetim" <small>(mishna kiddushin 1 7)</small>. vechol mitzvat ase shehi mizzeman lizman veenah tedira nashim peturot chutz mikkiddush hayyom vaachilat matztza belele happesach vaachilat happesach ushechitato vehakehel vesimcha shehannashim chayyavot:
Tumtum veanderoginus hare hen safek, notnin alehen chumre haish vechumre haishsha bechol makom vechayyavim bakkol. veim avru enam lokin:
Af al pi shehaishsha mutteret legalleach peat roshah hare hi asura legalleach peat rosh haish. vaafillu katan asur lah legalleach lo pea:
Ufea zo shemmannichim batztzedaim lo natnu bo chachamim shiur veshamanu mizzekenenu sheeno manniach pachot mearbaim searot. umuttar lelakket happeot bemisparayim lo neesar ella hashechata betaar:

Derech kohane ovde kochavim haya lehashechit zekanam. lefichach asra tora lehashechit hazzakan. vechamesh peot yesh bo. lechi haelyon ulechi hattachton miyyamin vechen missemol veshibbolet hazzakan. veloke al kol pea ufea. veim netalan kullan keachat loke chamesh. veeno chayyav ad sheyyegallechennu betaar shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 27)</small> "velo tashchit et peat zekanecha" gilluach sheyyesh bo hashechata. lefichach im gilleach zekano bemisparayim patur. veen hammitgalleach loke ad sheyyesayyea. veishsha mutteret lehashechit zekanah im yesh lah sear bazzakan. veim hishchita zekan haish petura:

Hassafa muttar legallecho betaar vehu hassear sheal gav hassafa haelyona vechen hassear hameduldal min hassafa hattachtona. veaf al pi shehu muttar lo nahagu yisrael lehashechito ella yegalleach ketzato ad shello yeakkev achila ushetiyya:

Haavarat hassear mishshear hagguf kegon bet hashshechi uvet haerva eno asur min hattora ella middivre sofrim vehammaaviro makkin oto makkat mardut. bamme devarim amurim bemakom sheen maavirin oto ella nashim kede shello yetakken atzmo tikkun nashim. aval bemakom shemmaavirin hassear hannashim vaanashim im heevir en makkin oto. umuttar lehaavir sear shear evarim bemisparayim bechol makom:

Lo taade ishsha adi haish kegon shettasim beroshah mitznefet o kova o tilbash shiryon vechayyotze bo o shettegalleach roshah keish. velo yaade ish adi ishsha kegon sheyyilbash bigde tzivonin vachali zahav bemakom sheen lovshin otan hakkelim veen mesimim oto hachali ella nashim hakkol keminhag hammedina. ish sheada adi ishsha veishsha sheadta adi ish lokin. hamelakket searot levanot mittoch hashshechorot merosho o mizzekano mishsheyyelakket saara achat loke mippene sheada adi ishsha. vechen im tzava searo shachor mishsheyyitzba sear levana achat loke. tumtum veanderoginus eno otef keishsha velo megalleach rosho keish veim asa ken eno loke:

Ketovet kaaka haamura battora hu sheyyisrot al besaro vimalle mekom hasserita kachol o deyo o shear tzivonim haroshmim. veze haya minhag haakkum sheroshmin atzman laavodat kochavim kelomar shehu eved machur lah umursham laavodatah. umeet sheyyirshom beechad middevarim haroshmin achar sheyyisrot bee ze makom min hagguf ben ish ben ishsha loke. katav velo rasham betzeva o sherasham betzeva velo katav bisrita patur ad sheyyichtov vikaakea shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 28)</small> "uchetovet kaaka". bamme devarim amurim bechotev aval ze shekkatvu bivsaro vekikeu bo eno chayyav ella im ken siyyea kede sheyyaase maase. aval im lo asa kelum eno loke:

Hassoret serita achat al hammet loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 28)</small> "veseret lanefesh lo tittenu bivsarchem". echad kohen veechad yisrael. sarat serita achat al chamesh metim o chamesh seritot al met echad loke chamesh. vehu shehitru bo al kol achat veachat:

Gedida userita achat hi. ucheshem shehayu haakkum sortim bivsaram al metehem mippene hatztzaar kach hayu chovlin beatzmam laavodat kochavim shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 18 28)</small> "vayyitgoddu kemishpatam". gam ze asra tora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 1)</small> "lo titgoddu". ella sheal met ben sarat beyado ben sarat bichli loke. laavodat kochavim bichli chayyav malkot beyado patur:

Uvichlal azhara ze shello yihyu shene batte dinin beir achat ze noheg keminhag ze veze noheg keminhag acher. sheddavar ze gorem lemachalokot gedolot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 1)</small> "lo titgoddu" lo teasu aguddot aguddot:

Hakkoreach karcha al hammet loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 1)</small> "velo tasimu karcha ben enechem lamet". echad yisrael veechad kohen shessarat al hammet eno loke ella achat. hakkoreach arba o chamesh karchot al met echad loke keminyan hakkarchot vehu shehitru bo al kol karcha vekarcha. echad hakkoreach beyado o besam o hitbil etzbeotav besam vehinnicham bachamishsha mekomot berosho bevat achat hoil vekarach chamesh karchot af al pi shehi hateraa achat loke chamesh shehare kullan bain keachat. vechayyav al kol harosh keven haenayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 5)</small> "lo yikrechu karcha berosham". vechamma shiur hakkarcha kede sheyyerae merosho kigris panuy beli sear:

Hakkoreach rosho o hassoret bivsaro al beto shennafal veal sefinato shennitbea bayyam patur veeno loke ella al hammet bilvad o hassoret laavodat kochavim. hakkoreach karcha berosho shel chavero vehassoret serita bivsar chavero vehakkotev ketovet kaaka bivsaro shel chavero vehaya chavero mesayyea. bizman sheshshenehen mezidin shenehen lokin. echad shogeg veechad mezid hammezid mishshenehem loke vehashshogeg patur:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 1: Kol mitzvot shebbattora ben ase ben lo taase im avar adam al achat mehen ben bezadon ben bishgaga kesheyyaase teshuva veyashuv mecheto chayyav lehitvaddot lifne hael baruch hu shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 6)</small> "ish o ishsha ki yaasu" vegomer <small>(Bamidbar 5 7)</small> "vehitvaddu et chattatam asher asu" ze vidduy devarim. vidduy ze mitzvat ase. ketzad mitvaddin. omer anna hashshem chatati aviti pashati lefanecha veasiti kach vechach vahare nichamti uvoshti bemaasay uleolam eni chozer ledavar ze. vezehu ikkaro shel vidduy. vechol hammarbe lehitvaddot umaarich beinyan ze hare ze meshubbach. vechen baale chattaot vaashamot beet shemmeviin karbenotehen al shiggatan o al zedonan en mitkapper lahen bekarbanam ad sheyyaasu teshuva veyitvaddu vidduy devarim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 5)</small> "vehitvadda asher chata aleha". vechen kol mechuyyeve mitot bet din umechuyyeve malkot en mitkapper lahen bemitatan o bilkiyyatan ad sheyyaasu teshuva veyitvaddu. vechen hachovel bachavero vehammazzik mamono af al pi sheshshillem lo ma shehu chayyav lo eno mitkapper ad sheyyitvadde veyashuv millaasot kaze leolam shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 6)</small> "mikkol chattot haadam":

Sair hammishtalleach lefi shehu kappara al kol yisrael kohen gadol mitvadde alav al leshon kol yisrael shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 21)</small> "vehitvadda alav et kol avonot bene yisrael". sair hammishtalleach mechapper al kol averot shebbattora, hakkallot vehachamurot, ben sheavar bezadon ben sheavar bishgaga, ben shehoda lo ben shello hoda lo, hakkol mitkapper besair hammishtalleach. vehu sheasa teshuva. aval im lo asa teshuva en hassair mechapper lo ella al hakkallot. uma hen hakkallot uma hen hachamurot. hachamurot hen shechayyavin alehem mitat bet din o karet. ushevuat shav vasheker af al pi sheen bahen karet hare hen min hachamurot. ushear mitzvot lo taase umitzvot ase sheen bahen karet hem hakkallot:

Bazzeman hazze sheen bet hammikdash kayyam veen lanu mizbach kappara en sham ella teshuva. hatteshuva mechapperet al kol haaverot. afillu rasha kol yamav veasa teshuva baacharona en mazkirin lo shum davar merisho shenneemar <small>(Yechezkel 33 12)</small> "rishat harasha lo yikkashel bah beyom shuvo merisho". veatzmo shel yom hakkippurim mechapper lashshavim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 30)</small> "ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem":

Af al pi shehatteshuva mechapperet al hakkol veatzmo shel yom hakkippurim mechapper. yesh averot shehen mitkapperim lishatan veyesh averot sheen mitkapperim ella leachar zeman. ketzad. avar adam al mitzvat ase sheen bah karet veasa teshuva eno zaz mishsham ad shemmochalin lo, uveellu neemar <small>(yirmeya 3 22)</small> "shuvu banim shovavim erpa meshuvotechem" vegomer. avar al mitzvat lo taase sheen bah karet velo mitat bet din veasa teshuva, teshuva tola veyom hakkippurim mechapper, uveellu neemar <small>(Vayikra 16 30)</small> "ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem". avar al keretot umitot bet din veasa teshuva, teshuva veyom hakkippurim tolin veyissurin habbain alav gomrin lo hakkappara. uleolam en mitkapper lo kappara gemura ad sheyyavou alav yissurin, uveellu neemar <small>(Tehillim 89 33)</small> "ufakadti veshevet pisham uvingaim avonam". bamme devarim amurim beshello chillel et hashshem beshaa sheavar aval hamechallel et hashshem af al pi sheasa teshuva vehiggia yom hakkippurim vehu omed bitshuvato uvau alav yissurin eno mitkapper lo kappara gemura ad sheyyamut. ella teshuva yom hakkippurim veyissurin shelashtan tolin umita mechapperet shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 22 14)</small> "venigla veaznay Adonai tzevaot vegomer im yechuppar heavon hazze lachem ad temutun":
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 2: E zo hi teshuva gemura. ze shebba leyado davar sheavar bo veefshar beyado laasoto uferash velo asa mippene hatteshuva. lo miyyira velo mikkishlon koach. ketzad. hare shebba al ishsha baavera uleachar zeman nityached immah vehu omed beahavato bah uvechoach gufo uvammedina sheavar bah ufarash velo avar zehu baal teshuva gemura. hu sheshshelomo amar <small>(Kohelet 12 1)</small> "uzechor et borecha bime bechurotecha". veim lo shav ella bime ziknuto uveet shei efshar lo laasot ma shehaya ose af al pi sheenah teshuva meulla moelet hi lo uvaal teshuva hu. afillu avar kol yamav veasa teshuva beyom mitato umet bitshuvato kol avonotav nimchalin shenneemar <small>(Kohelet 12 2)</small> "ad asher lo techshach hashshemesh vehaor vehayyareach vehakkochavim veshavu heavim achar haggeshem" shehu yom hammita. mikkelal sheim zachar boro veshav kodem sheyyamut nislach lo:

Uma hi hatteshuva. hu sheyyaazov hachote cheto visiro mimmachashavto veyigmor belibbo shello yaasehu od shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noah 7)</small> "yaazov rasha darko" vegomer. vechen yitnachem al sheavar shenneemar <small>(yirmeya lo 19)</small> "ki achare shuvi nichamti". veyaid alav yodea taalumot shello yashuv leze hachet leolam shenneemar <small>(Hoshea 14 4)</small> "velo nomar od elohenu lemaase yadenu" vegomer. vetzarich lehitvaddot bisfatav velomar inyanot ellu sheggamar belibbo:

Kol hammitvadde bidvarim velo gamar belibbo laazov hare ze dome letovel vesheretz beyado sheen hattevila moelet lo ad sheyyashlich hashsheretz. vechen hu omer umode veozev yerucham <small>(Mishlei 28 13)</small>. vetzarich lifrot et hachet shenneemar <small>(Shemot 32 lo)</small> "anna chata haam hazze chataa gedola vayyaasu lahem elohe zahav":

Middarche hatteshuva lihyot hashshav tzoek tamid lifne hashshem bivchi uvetachanunim veose tzedaka kefi kocho umitrachek harebe min haddavar shechata bo umeshanne shemo kelomar ani acher veeni oto haish sheasa otan hammaasim umeshanne maasav kullan letova ulederech yeshara vegole mimmekomo. sheggalut mechapperet avon mippene sheggoremet lo lehikkana velihyot anav ushefal ruach:

Veshevach gadol lashshav sheyyitvadde barabbim veyodia peshaav lahem umegalle averot shebbeno leven chavero laacherim veomer lahem amnam chatati lifloni veasiti lo kach vechach vahareni hayyom shav umitnachem. vechol hammitgae veeno modia ella mechasse peshaav en teshuvato gemura shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 28 13)</small> "mechasse feshaav lo yatzliach". bamme devarim amurim baaverot shebben adam lachavero aval baaverot shebben adam lammakom eno tzarich lefarsem atzmo veazzut panim hi lo im gillam. ella shav lifne hael baruch hu uforet chataav lefanav umitvadde alehem lifne rabbim setam. vetova hi lo shello nitgalla avono shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 32 1)</small> "ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa":

Af al pi shehatteshuva vehatztzeaka yafa laolam. baasara hayyamim shebben rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim hi yafa beyoter umitkabbelet hi miyyad shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noah 6)</small> "dirshu Adonai behimmatzo". bamme devarim amurim beyachid aval tzibbur kol zeman sheosim teshuva vetzoakin belev shalem hem naanin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 7)</small> "chaAdonai elohenu bechol karenu elav":

Yom hakkippurim hu zeman teshuva lakkol layyachid velarabbim vehu ketz mechila uselicha leyisrael. lefichach chayyavim hakkol laasot teshuva ulehitvaddot beyom hakkippurim. umitzvat vidduy yom hakkippurim sheyyatchil meerev hayyom kodem sheyyochal shemma yechanek basseudda kodem sheyyitvadde. veaf al pi shehitvadda kodem sheyyochal chozer umitvadde belele yom hakkippurim arvit vechozer umitvadde beshacharit uvemusaf uvemincha uvinila. vehechan mitvadde. yachid achar tefillato usheliach tzibbur beemtza tefillato bivracha reviit:

Havvidduy shennahagu bo kol yisrael aval anachnu chatanu (kullanu) vehu ikkar havvidduy. averot shehitvadda alehem beyom hakkippurim ze chozer umitvadde alehen beyom hakkippurim acher af al pi shehu omed bitshuvato shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 51 5)</small> "ki feshaay ani eda vechattati negdi tamid":

En hatteshuva velo yom hakkippurim mechapperin ella al averot shebben adam lammakom kegon mi sheachal davar asur o baal beila asura vechayyotze bahen. aval averot shebben adam lachavero kegon hachovel et chavero o hamekallel chavero o gozlo vechayyotze bahen eno nimchal lo leolam ad sheyyitten lachavero ma shehu chayyav lo viratztzehu. af al pi shehechezir lo mamon shehu chayyav lo tzarich leratztzoto velishl mimmennu sheyyimchol lo. afillu lo hiknit et chavero ella bidvarim tzarich lefayyeso velifgoa bo ad sheyyimchol lo. lo ratza chavero limchol lo mevi lo shura shel shelosha bene adam mereav ufogin bo umevakkeshin mimmennu. lo nitratztza lahen mevi lo sheniyya ushelishit. lo ratza menicho veholech lo veze shello machal hu hachote. veim haya rabbo holech uva afillu elef peamim ad sheyyimchol lo:

Asur laadam lihyot achzari velo yitpayyes ella yehe noach lirtzot vekashe lichos uveshaa shemmevakkesh mimmennu hachote limchol mochel belev shalem uvenefesh chafetza. vaafillu hetzer lo vechata lo harebe lo yikkom velo yittor. vezehu darkam shel zera yisrael velibbam hannachon. aval haovde kochavim arle lev enan ken ella (veevratan) [veevrato] shemara netzach. vechen hu omer al haggivonim lefi shello machalu velo nitpayyesu vehaggivonim lo mibbene yisrael hemma:

Hachote lachavero umet chavero kodem sheyyevakkesh mechila mevi asara bene adam umaamidan al kivro veyomar bifnehem chatati laAdonai elohe yisrael velifloni ze shekkach vechach asiti lo. veim haya chayyav lo mamon yachaziro layyorshim. lo haya yodea lo yorshin yannichennu bevet din veyitvadde:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 3: Kol echad veechad mibbene haadam yesh lo zechuyyot vaavonot. mi shezzechuyyotav yeterot al avonotav tzaddik. umi sheavonotav yeterot al zechuyyotav rasha. mechetza lemechetza benoni. vechen hammedina im hayu zechuyyot kol yoshveha merubbot al avonotehen hare zo tzaddeket. veim hayu avonotehem merubbin hare zo reshaa. vechen kol haolam kullo:

Adam sheavonotav merubbin al zechuyyotav miyyad hu met berisho shenneemar al rov avonech. vechen medina sheavonoteha merubbin miyyad hi ovedet shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 18 20)</small> "zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba" vegomer. vechen kol haolam kullo im hayu avonotehem merubbin mizzechuyyotehen miyyad hen nishchatin shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 6 5)</small> "vayyar Adonai ki rabba raat haadam". veshikkul ze eno lefi minyan hazzechuyyot vehaavonot ella lefi gadlam. yesh zechut shehi keneged kamma avonot shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 14 13)</small> "yaan nimtza vo davar tov". veyesh avon shehu keneged kamma zechuyyot shenneemar <small>(Kohelet 9 18)</small> "vechote echad yeabbed tova harebe". veen shoklin ella bedato shel el deot vehu hayyodea heach orchin hazzechuyyot keneged haavonot:

Kol mi shennicham al hammitzvot sheasa vetaha al hazzechuyyot veamar belibbo uma hoalti baasiyyatan halevay lo asiti otan hare ze ibbed et kullan veen mazkirim lo shum zechut baolam shenneemar <small>(Yechezkel 33 12)</small> "vetzidkat hatztzaddik lo tatztzilennu beyom risho", en ze ella betohe al harishonot. ucheshem sheshshoklin zechuyyot adam vaavonotav bishat mitato kach bechol shana veshana shoklin avonot kol echad veechad mibbae haolam im zechuyyotav, beyom tov shel rosh hashshana. mi shennimtza tzaddik nechtam lechayyim. umi shennimtza rasha nechtam lemita. vehabbenoni tolin oto ad yom hakkippurim im asa teshuva nechtam lechayyim veim lav nechtam lemita:

Af al pi shettekiat shofar berosh hashshana gezerat hakkatuv remez yesh bo kelomar uru yeshenim mishshenatchem venirdamim hakitzu mittardematchem vechappesu bemaasechem vechizru bitshuva vezichru boraachem. ellu hashshochchim et haemet behavele hazzeman veshogim kol shenatam behevel varik asher lo yoil velo yatztzil, habbitu lenafshotechem vehetivu darchechem umaallechem veyaazov kol echad mikkem darko haraa umachashavto asher lo tova. lefichach tzarich kol adam sheyyire atzmo kol hashshana kullah keillu chetzyo zakkay vechetzyo chayyav. vechen kol haolam chetzyo zakkay vechetzyo chayyav. chata chet echad hare hichria et atzmo veet kol haolam kullo lechaf chova vegaram lo hashechata. asa mitzva achat hare hichria et atzmo veet kol haolam kullo lechaf zechut vegaram lo velahem teshua vehatztzala shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 10 25)</small> "vetzaddik yesod olam" ze shetztzadak hichria et kol haolam lizchut vehitztzilo. umippene inyan ze nahagu kol bet yisrael leharebot bitzdaka uvemaasim tovim velaasok bemitzvot merosh hashshana vead yom hakkippurim yeter mikkol hashshana. venahagu kullam lakum ballayla baasara yamim ellu ulehitpallel bevatte kenesiyyot bedivre tachanunim uvechibbushin ad sheyyeor hayyom:

Beshaa sheshshoklin avonot adam im zechuyyotav en mechashshevin alav avon shechata bo techilla velo sheni ella mishshelishi veelach. im nimtzeu avonotav mishshelishi veelach merubbin al zechuyyotav otam shete avonot mitztarfim vedanin oto al hakkol. veim nimtzeu zechuyyotav keneged avonotav asher meavon shelishi veelach maavirim kol avonotav rishon rishon. lefi shehashshelishi nechshav rishon shekkevar nimchalu hashshenayim. vechen harvii hare hu rishon shekkevar nimchal hashshelishi vechen ad sofan. bamme devarim amurim beyachid shenneemar <small>(Iyov 33 29)</small> "hen kol elle yifal el paamayim shalosh im gaver". aval hatztzibbur tolin lahen avon rishon sheni ushelishi shenneemar <small>(Amos 2 6)</small> "al shelosha pishe yisrael veal arbaa lo ashivennu". ucheshemmechashshevin lahen al derech ze mechashshevin lahen mervii veelach. habbenonim im haya bichlal mechetza avonot shellahen shello heniach tefillin meolam danin oto kefi cheto veyesh lo chelek laolam habba. vechen kol harshaim sheavonotehen merubbim danin otan kefi chataehem veyesh lahen chelek laolam habba shekkol yisrael yesh lahem chelek laolam habba af al pi shechatu shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 60 21)</small> "veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz". eretz zo mashal kelomar eretz hachayyim vehu haolam habba. vechen chaside ummot haolam yesh lahem chelek laolam habba:

Veellu hen sheen lahen chelek laolam habba ella nichratim veovdin veniddonin al godel risham vechattatam leolam uleolme olamim. hamminim. vehaeppikorosin. vehakkofrim battora. vehakkofrim bitchiyyat hammetim uveviat haggoel. hammordim. umachatie harabbim. vehapporshin middarche tzibbur. vehaose averot beyad rama befarhesya kihoyakim. vehammosrim. umattile ema al hatztzibbur shello leshem shamayim. veshofche damim. uvaale lashon hara. vehammoshech arlato:

Chamishsha hen hannikraim minim. haomer sheen sham eloah veen laolam manhig. vehaomer sheyyesh sham manhig aval hen shenayim o yoter. vehaomer sheyyesh sham ribbon echad aval shehu guf uvaal temuna. vechen haomer sheeno levaddo harishon vetzur lakkol. vechen haoved kochav o mazzal vezulato kede lihyot melitz beno uven ribbon haolamim. kol echad mechamishsha ellu hu min:

Shelosha hen hannikraim eppikorsin. haomer sheen sham nevua kelal veen sham madda shemmaggia mehabbore lelev bene haadam. vehammachchish nevuato shel moshe rabbenu. vehaomer sheen habbore yodea maase bene haadam. kol echad mishshelosha ellu hen eppikorosim. shelosha hen hakkofrim battora. haomer sheen hattora meim Adonai afillu pasuk echad afillu teva achat im amar moshe amaro mippi atzmo hare ze kofer battora. vechen hakkofer beferushah vehu tora shebbeal pe vehammachchish maggideha kegon tzadok uvaytos. vehaomer shehabbore hechelif mitzva zo bemitzva acheret uchevar batla tora zo af al pi shehi hayta meim Adonai kegon hahagrim. kol echad mishshelosha ellu kofer battora:

Shenayim hem hammumarim miyyisrael. hammumar laavera achat vehammumar lechol hattora kullah. mumar laavera achat ze shehechezik atzmo laasot otah avera bezadon vehurgal venitparsem bah afillu hayta min hakkallot kegon shehuchzak tamid lilbosh shaatnez o lehakkif pea venimtza keillu batla mitzva zo min haolam etzlo hare ze mumar leoto davar vehu sheyyaase lehacheis. mumar lechol hattora kullah kegon hachozrim ledate haovde kochavim beshaa sheggozrin gezera veyidbak bahem veyomar ma betza li lehiddabbek beyisrael shehem shefalim venirdafim tov li sheeddabbek beellu sheyyadam takkifa. hare ze mumar lechol hattora kullah:

Machatie harabbim ketzad. echad shehechti bedavar gadol kegon yaravam vetzadok uvaytos. veechad shehechti bedavar kal afillu levattel mitzvat ase. veechad haones acherim ad sheyyechteu kimnashshe shehaya horeg et yisrael ad sheyyaavdu avodat kochavim, o shehita acherim vehiddicham keyeshua:

Happoresh middarche tzibbur af al pi shello avar averot ella nivdal meadat yisrael veeno ose mitzvot bichlalan velo nichnas betzaratan velo mitanne betaanitan ella holech bedarko keechad miggoye haaretz ucheillu eno mehen en lo chelek laolam habba. haose averot beyad rama kihoyakim ben sheasa kallot ben sheasa chamurot en lo chelek laolam habba. vezehu hannikra megalle panim battora mippene sheheez mitzcho vegilla panav velo bosh middivre tora:
Shenayim hem hammosrin. hammoser chavero beyad akkum lehargo o lehakkoto. vehammoser mamon chavero beyad akkum o beyad annas shehu keakkum. ushenehem en lahem chelek laolam habba:

Mattile ema al hatztzibbur shello leshem shamayim ze harode tzibbur bechazka vehem yereim umefachadim mimmennu vechavvanato lichvod atzmo vechol chafatzav shello lichvod shamayim kegon malche haakkum:

Kol echad veechad meesrim vearbaa anashim ellu shemmaninu af al pi shehen miyyisrael en lahem chelek laolam habba. veyesh averot kallot meellu veaf al pi chen amru chachamim sheharagil bahen en lahem chelek laolam habba (uchede) [ucheday] hen lehitrachek mehen ulehizzaher bahen. veellu hen. hamechanne shem lachavero. vehakkore lachavero bechinnuyo. vehammalbin pene chavero barabbim. vehammitkabbed biklon chavero. vehamevazze talmide chachamim. vehamevazze rabbotav. vehamevazze et hammoadot. vehamechallel et hakkadashim. bamme devarim amurim shekkol echad meellu en lo chelek laolam habba keshemmet belo teshuva aval im shav merisho umet vehu baal teshuva hare ze mibbene haolam habba sheen lecha davar sheomed bifne hatteshuva. afillu kafar baikkar kol yamav uvaacharona shav yesh lo chelek laolam habba shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 57 19)</small> "shalom shalom larachok velakkarov amar Adonai urefativ". kol harshaim vehammumarim vechayyotze bahen shechazru bitshuva ben begaluy ben bematmoniyyot mekabbelin otan shenneemar <small>(yirmeya 3 14)</small> "shuvu banim shovavim". af al pi sheadayin shovav hu shehare basseter shav velo begaluy mekabbelin oto bitshuva:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 4:
Arvaa veesrim devarim meakkevin et hatteshuva. arbaa mehen avon gadol vehaose echad mehen en hakkadosh baruch hu maspik beyado laasot teshuva lefi godel cheto. veellu hen. 1) hammachti et harabbim uvichlal avon ze hameakkev et harabbim millaasot mitzva. 2) vehammatte et chavero midderech tova leraa kegon mesit umaddiach. 3) haroe beno yotze letarbut raa veeno memache beyado. hoil uveno birshuto illu micha bo haya poresh venimtza kemachtio. uvichlal avon ze kol sheefshar beyado limchot baacherim ben yachid ben rabbim velo micha ella yannichem bechishlonam. 4) vehaomer echta veashuv uvichlal ze haomer echta veyom hakkippurim mechapper:
Umehen chamishsha devarim hannoalim darche hatteshuva bifne osehen. veellu hen. 1) happoresh min hatztzibbur, lefi shebbizman sheyyaasu teshuva lo yihye immahen veeno zoche immahen bizchut sheosin. 2) vehacholek al divre chachamim, lefi shemmachlakto goremet lo lifrosh mehen veeno yodea darche hatteshuva. 3) vehammalig al hammitzvot, shekkevan shennitbazzu beenav eno rodef acharehen velo osan veim lo yaase bamme yizke. 4) vehamevazze rabbotav, sheddavar ze gorem lo ledochofo uletardo kegechazi uvizman shennitrad lo yimtza melammed umore lo derech haemet. 5) vehassone et hattochachot shehare lo hinniach lo derech teshuva. shehattochacha goremet litshuva shebbizman shemmodiin lo laadam chataav umachlimin oto chozer bitshuva kemo shekkatuv battora <small>(Devarim 9 7)</small> "zechor (v) al tishkach". <small>(Devarim 9 7)</small> "mamrim heyitem". <small>(Devarim 29 3)</small> "velo natan Adonai lachem lev". <small>(Devarim 32 6)</small> "am naval velo chacham". vechen yeshayahu hochiach et yisrael veamar <small>(yeshaya 1 4)</small> "hoy goy chote". <small>(yeshaya 1 3)</small> "yada shor konehu". <small>(yeshaya moach 4)</small> "middati ki kashe atta". vechen tzivvahu hael lehochiach lachattaim shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 1)</small> "kera vegaron al tachsoch". vechen kol hanneviim hochichu leyisrael ad shechazru bitshuva. lefichach tzarich lehaamid bechol kahal vekahal miyyisrael chacham gadol vezaken vire shamayim minneurav veahuv lahem sheyyehe mochiach larabbim umachaziran bitshuva, veze shessone et hattochachot eno ba lammochiach velo shomea devarav lefichach yaamod bechattotav shehem beenav tovim: 
Umehem chamishsha devarim haose otan i efshar lo sheyyashuv bitshuva gemura lefi shehem avonot shebben adam lachavero veeno yodea chavero shechata lo kede sheyyachazir lo o yishal mimmennu limchol lo. veellu hen. 1) hamekallel et harabbim velo killel adam yadua kede sheyyishal mimmennu kappara. 2) vehacholek im gannav, shellefi sheeno yodea geneva zo shel mi hi ella haggannav gonev larabbim umevi lo vehu lokeach. veod shehu machazik yad haggannav umachtio. 3) vehammotze aveda veeno machriz aleha ad sheyyachazirah livaleha, leachar zeman kesheyyaase teshuva eno yodea lemi yachazir. 4) vehaochel shor aniyyim vitomim vealmanot. ellu bene adam umlalin hem veenan yeduim umefursamim vegolim meir leir veen lahem makkir kede sheyyeda shor ze shel mi hu veyachazirennu lo. 5) vehamekabbel shochad lehattot din eno yodea ad hechan higgia hattaya zo vechamma hi kochah kede sheyyachazir, shehaddavar yesh lo raglayim. veod shehu machazik yad ze umachtio:
Umehen chamishsha devarim haose otan en chezkato lashuv mehen. lefi shehem devarim kallim beene rov haadam venimtza chote vehu yedamme sheen ze chet. veellu hen. 1) haochel misseudda sheenah maspeket livaleha shezze avak gezel hu. vehu medamme shello chata veyomar kelum achalti ella birshuto. 2) hammishtammesh baavoto shel ani shehaavot shel ani eno ella kegon kordom umacharesha veyomar belibbo enan chaserim vahare lo gazalti oto. 3) hammistakkel baarayot maale al dato sheen bechach kelum shehu omer vechi baalti o karavti etzlah. vehu eno yodea sheriyyat haenayim avon gadol shehi goremet legufan shel arayot shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 39)</small> "velo taturu achare levavchem veachare enechem". 4) hammitkabbed biklon chavero omer belibbo sheeno chet lefi sheen chavero omed sham velo higgia lo boshet velo biyyesho ella arach maasav hattovim vechachmato lemul maase chavero o chachmato kede sheyyerae mikkelalo shehu mechubbad vachavero bazuy. 5) vehachoshed kesherim omer belibbo sheeno chet lefi shehu omer me asiti lo vechi yesh sham ella chashad shemma asa o lo asa vehu eno yodea shezze avon shemmesim adam kasher bedato kevaal avera:
Umehen chamishsha devarim haose otam yimmashech acharehem tamid vekashim hem lifrosh mehen. lefichach tzarich adam lehizzaher mehen shemma yidbak bahen vehen kullan deot raot ad meod. veellu hen. rechilut. velashon hara. uvaal chema. uvaal machashava raa. vehammitchabber larasha mippene shehu lomed mimmaasav vehen nirshamim belibbo. hu sheamar shelomo <small>(Mishlei 13 20)</small> "veroe chesilim yeroa". uchevar bearnu behilchot deot devarim shetztzarich kol adam linhog bahen tamid, kal vachomer levaal teshuva:
Kol ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen af al pi shemmeakkevin et hatteshuva en monin otah ella im asa adam teshuva mehen hare ze baal teshuva veyesh lo chelek laolam habba:
